raw.description:
Trade Specialist | U.S. Customs & Client Care

Take your customs expertise beyond the entry.

At GHY, we don’t just move goods across borders. We help businesses navigate complexity, solve problems, and trade with confidence.

For more than a century, we’ve helped importers and exporters navigate global trade. As a Best-Managed Employer and family-led organization, we’ve built our reputation on expertise, integrity, innovation, and genuinely caring about our clients and one another.

If you know customs, enjoy solving problems, and are ready to take greater ownership of the client experience, this could be your next move.

About the Role:

As a Trade Specialist, you’ll go beyond processing customs entries to help ensure our clients receive accurate, consistent, and knowledgeable support.

Reporting to the Client Care Manager, you’ll oversee day-to-day client needs, audit released shipments, maintain client databases and work instructions, and help resolve issues as they arise. You’ll also share your experience with colleagues and support the release team when additional expertise is needed.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced customs professional who is ready to take more ownership, deepen their technical knowledge, and become a trusted resource for both clients and teammates.

What You'll Do:

  • 🤝 Own the client experience. Support day-to-day client needs, answer questions, troubleshoot issues, and help find solutions when challenges arise.🔎
  • Protect quality and accuracy. Audit customs entries and released shipments to identify errors, inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve.
  • 🧠 Be a customs resource. Stay current on CBP regulations and Partner Government Agency requirements, research questions, and help translate regulations into practical guidance.
  • 📞 Keep everyone connected. Communicate professionally with clients, carriers, vendors, Customs, and internal teams to gather information and resolve issues.
  • 📋 Know the client inside and out. Develop and maintain client work instructions, databases, FTA correlations, annual certificates, and other critical account information.
  • 🚚 Step in when it matters. Support accurate customs entry processing across transportation modes when needed to keep shipments moving.
  • 🌱 Share what you know. Assist, coach, and mentor teammates with transactional processing, client requirements, and customs-related questions.
  • 💡 Solve problems before they grow. Recognize risks, use sound judgment, and make timely decisions that help protect both our clients and GHY.

Who You Are:

You know customs, but you also understand that great brokerage service is about more than getting an entry released.

You’re someone who asks questions, catches details others might miss, and takes ownership when something needs to be resolved. You’re equally comfortable digging into regulations, talking with a client, or helping a teammate work through a challenging entry.

You bring:

  • Strong knowledge of U.S. Customs rules and regulations
  • Advanced understanding of customs entry and commercial invoice requirements
  • Working knowledge of Partner Government Agency requirements and entry data elements
  • Knowledge of tariff classification, the General Rules of Interpretation (GRIs), General Notes, and Explanatory Notes
  • Exceptional client service and relationship-building skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Sound judgment when making time-sensitive decisions
  • Experience navigating different client requirements, nuances, and SOPs
  • The ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment
  • Clear, positive, and professional written and verbal communication
  • Experience with customs brokerage software
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel
  • The ability to work independently while remaining a collaborative member of the team

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of customs brokerage or related industry experience
  • Certified Customs Specialist (CCS) designation
  • U.S. Customs Broker License (REQUIRED for Remote Work)
  • Demonstrated experience applying customs knowledge to client needs and transactional processing

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • ❤️ We CARE: Our values guide how we work: Clients are our focus, Associates matter, Relentlessly serving traders, and Excellence and innovation in all we do.
  • 🏡 Remote Flexibility: Work remotely while staying connected to a collaborative, experienced team.
  • 💰 Competitive Compensation: Fair pay supported by scheduled salary assessments and a performance-based bonus program.
  • 🩺 Excellent Benefits: Comprehensive, subsidized health, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability, and life & AD&D coverage.
  • 📈 Keep Growing: Access ongoing learning through our internal university and leadership development programming.
  • 🤝 More Than Work: Our Giveback Committee, Social Committee, and Cultural Ambassadors create opportunities to connect, contribute, and have some fun along the way.

The Details

📍 Location: We offer flexibility based on experience and location. Candidates within 2 hours of a GHY office may be considered without a U.S. Customs Broker License. For candidates located more than 2 hours from a GHY office, an active U.S. Customs Broker License is required.

🕒 Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week
📅 Holidays: Two statutory holidays per year may be required

💰 Compensation: Based on experience

Know Customs. Own the Details. Make an Impact.

You’ve built the foundation. Now it’s time to use that experience in a role where your judgment, client service, and customs knowledge make a bigger impact.

At GHY, you’ll solve problems, support clients, share what you know, and continue building your expertise alongside people who understand the complexities of international trade.

Ready to take the next step in your customs career? Apply today.

GHY is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Salary: $49,000 - $70,000

raw.excerpt: Why YOU want this positionAt Enverus, we're committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.
raw.description:
Why YOU want this position

At Enverus, we're committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.

We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we're helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy.

The energy industry is changing fast. But we've continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn't be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.

Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

The role

We publish long-term zonal power price forecasts across the North American ISOs. The team builds the view together: the load forecast, the capacity mix and build plan, retirements, fuel, and policy. This seat runs the production cost model that turns that view into hourly hub and zonal prices. How often we can refresh the forecast, and how many questions we can answer with it, depends on this role.

You own the model and help shape the view. You work with the regional analysts on the load, build, and policy assumptions, run the model, validate the output, and explain what it did and why. When the model says something the team did not expect, you are the one who works out whether that is the market or the model.

This is not a client-facing role. You will not be on sales calls or on stage at conferences. You will be in the room when the team forms its view, and your name goes on the research you help shape.

At the Senior Analyst level you run the quarterly cycle without day-to-day supervision. You will have a handover period and Juan to escalate to, but the runs, the diagnostics, and the schedule are yours from the first full cycle.

This role reports to Juan Arteaga, who leads Power Market Fundamentals & Long-Term Forecasting, within the broader Power & Renewables Intelligence group led by Ryan Luther.

This role can be based in any of our North American offices or remote. You will not be in front of clients, but you will be working with our research analysts every single day, so you still need to be someone people want to work with.

A day on the team

Pick up the quarter's updated load forecast from the regional analyst, reconcile it against last quarter, and get it into model-ready shape before the run kicks off.

Launch a full ERCOT run over coffee, then spend the afternoon working out why 2032 summer scarcity hours moved 40% against the last vintage, and which input did it.

Turn around a scenario for an analyst who needs to know what six incremental gigawatts of data center load in PJM does to around-the-clock prices, and have it back to them by Friday.

Work out with the West analyst whether this year's low WECC prices are a durable feature of the renewable build-out or a transitory one, and what the model needs to represent it.

Backcast last year's forecast against what the market actually cleared and work out where the model missed and why.

How we work

Most research shops give ownership of the hardest problems to the most senior person on the team; everyone below executes. We do the opposite. Every analyst, even at entry-level, owns their projects end-to-end and pulls in senior team members for guidance. That hands-on, problem-by-problem ownership is how you build the confidence and judgment to add real value to our clients, and it's the single biggest reason people stay on this team. The modelling is yours in exactly that sense: not a queue of tickets someone else prioritizes for you.

Who thrives in this role

  • You speak well. You can explain what the model did and why, in plain language, to a room that includes people who have never run one, and hold your ground when they push back.
  • You disagree well. When an assumption looks wrong to you, you make the case with evidence and work it through with the team until the view holds up.
  • You're deep where it counts and broad everywhere else. You will know this model better than anyone, and you're just as interested in the market it describes. The best modelers we have worked with can tell you roughly what a result should look like before they hit run.
  • You care more about whether the price is right than how elegant the setup is. You will inherit a model you did not build. The job is to understand it, calibrate it, and improve it, not to replace it with your favourite tool.
  • You ask for help early. You'd rather make ten phone calls and look slightly less smart than struggle alone for two weeks.
  • You understand that excellent and on time outperforms perfect and late.
  • You'd rather write a tight one-pager than a 40-slide deck.
  • You take the work seriously, not yourself.

What you'll own

  • The model. The runs, the inputs, the calibration, and the documentation. When the model produces prices that do not make sense, finding out why is your problem, and when it gets better, that was you.
  • The quarterly cycle. Take the load forecasts and capacity mix build plans the research team produces, integrate them, run the full ISO set, validate the results, and deliver the hub and zonal price files on a published schedule. Every quarter, on time, without a fire drill.
  • Input integration. Turn the team's load, build, retirement, and fuel assumptions into model inputs, on time.
  • Scenario throughput. Run ad hoc scenarios for the research, product, and commercial teams with turnaround measured in days.
  • Validation and diagnostics. Build the checks that catch a bad run before anyone else sees it, and separate the two failure modes cleanly: the model did the wrong thing, which is yours to fix, or the assumption was wrong, which is yours to surface.
  • Explaining the mechanism. When a price view moves between vintages, you are the person who can say which mechanical driver moved it: which units set the margin, which hours, which input changed. Same day.
  • Continuity. Document the model well enough that it survives your vacation, and a different team two years from now.
  • Shaping the view. Work with the regional analysts to build the view: what the assumptions should be and what the model says about them. Co-author the research where your analysis drives the story.

Must-haves

  • 1 to 6 years of hands-on power market modelling, at an IPP, utility, ISO/RTO, consultancy, trading desk, or research/data provider.
  • You communicate clearly and confidently, out loud and in writing. You can walk the team or leadership through why a forecast moved, take hard questions in real time, and leave them understanding the answer.
  • You have been the primary operator of a long-term power price or capacity expansion model in a production setting where other people depended on the output. Consuming someone else's forecast does not count.
  • You bring your own view on supply, demand, and price formation, and you can defend it or change it when the evidence says so.
  • You can calibrate a model to history and tell a real market signal from a model artifact.
  • You understand how a long-term zonal price is actually produced: unit dispatch, marginal units and heat rates, fuel and emissions curves, reserve margins and capacity accreditation, renewable shapes, and how zones trade with each other.
  • Judgment about when a number is wrong, and the instinct to chase it down rather than ship it.
  • You work well with people even though you are not in front of clients. You will take input from half a dozen analysts every cycle, and they need to want to bring you problems.
  • You hit deadlines you did not set. The quarterly cycle has a date on it and clients are waiting on the other side of it.

Helpful, but not required

  • Hands-on experience with a commercial model: Aurora, PLEXOS, EnCompass, GridView, SERVM, Dayzer, or SAInt.
  • Nodal price modelling or power flow experience.
  • Python, SQL, or advanced Excel for handling inputs and outputs.
  • Detailed familiarity with the market design of one or more of ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, and SPP, or with WECC outside CAISO.
  • Exposure to data center and other large-load forecasting.
  • Graduate work in power systems, operations research, statistics, or economics.

What success looks like in your first 12 months

  • You run your first quarterly cycle with handover support and the next ones on your own, all on schedule.
  • Scenario turnaround is measured in days, and the team stops rationing what it asks the model for.
  • You have backcast the model against recent market outcomes and can show the team where it tracks and where it does not.
  • Someone else on the team can run the model from your runbook. You are not a single point of failure.
  • When research or leadership asks why a price view changed, they get a specific mechanical answer the same day.
  • You have made at least one substantive improvement to the model's mechanics that the research team signs off on.

About Enverus & this team

Enverus is the leading energy SaaS company delivering highly technical insights and predictive/prescriptive analytics that empower customers to make decisions that increase profit. We are a strategic partner to more than 6,000 customers in 50 countries, delivering business-critical insights to the global energy industry through a state-of-the-art SaaS platform built on industry-leading data and analytics.

Our Power & Renewables Intelligence team produces research for institutional investors, hyperscalers, IPP developers, utilities, and corporate strategy teams. If you want to shape how the North American grid gets built over the next decade, this is the place to be.

This role also plays a key role in establishing and managing processes that support the transition of services from innovation and launch into steady-state operations.

Global Launch & Scale-Up Enablement

  • Partner with regional stakeholders to facilitate service deployment and adoption while maintaining alignment with global standards.
  • Monitor launch performance and gather feedback to identify opportunities for process improvement and optimization.

Sustaining Product & Service Operations

  • Support prioritization and management of post-launch enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives.

Operational Excellence & Performance Management

  • Analyze program and operational data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support business case development, impact assessments, and value measurement activities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Promote operational discipline, transparency, and execution excellence across initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

  • Global service launches occur with clear operational readiness and stakeholder alignment.
  • Scalable processes, documentation, and governance models are established and maintained.
  • Services transition smoothly into sustaining operations with clear accountability and support structures.
  • Program milestones, timelines, and business objectives are achieved through strong cross-functional coordination.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in project management, product operations, digital health, service operations, or related functions.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional programs in a global environment.
  • Experience launching and scaling products, services, or customer success programs.
  • Strong understanding of operational processes, governance, and organizational design.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.

Preferred

  • Experience developing operating models and sustaining product organizations.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Product Management, and Change Management methodologies.
  • PMP, PgMP, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams and regional markets.

Success Measures


  • Successful delivery of Success Services innovation initiatives on time and within scope.
  • Effective launch and scale-up of global service offerings.
  • Establishment of a sustainable operating model and sustaining product organization.
  • Improved service adoption, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.
  • Achievement of defined business case and performance objectives.
  • High stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional alignment.

Location: Deerfield / Hybrid or Remote


Travel: 5-10% as required to support global initiatives and stakeholder engagement.


We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Vantive, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The estimated base salary for this position is $108,000.00 - 135,000.00 annually. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. We may pay more or less than of the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Individual pay is based upon location, skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors. For questions about this, our pay philosophy, and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.


US Benefits at Vantive

This is where your well-being matters. Vantive offers comprehensive compensation and benefits packages for eligible roles. At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Equipment Engineering organization is seeking a highly skilled Principal Equipment Engineer to support the Adhesion & Assembly engineering team. This role focuses on the hands-on development, integration, and deployment of advanced manufacturing equipment and automation solutions used across multiple enterprise manufacturing sites.

The ideal candidate is an experienced technical contributor with strong capabilities in industrial automation, robotics, controls, and manufacturing equipment development. This engineer will execute equipment development workstreams, collaborate with vendors and integrators, and deliver scalable, reliable, production-ready solutions. This role is execution-focused and supports ownership of technical deliverables, equipment development tasks, and vendor partnerships.

This position is not part of the program management organization. Schedule, budget, and program controls are handled elsewhere; this role is centered on engineering execution and hands-on technical problem solving.

What You Will Do:

  • Develop, integrate, and validate advanced manufacturing equipment and automation solutions for Adhesion & Assembly processes
  • Own execution of assigned equipment development workstreams, including design collaboration, integration, commissioning, and factory acceptance
  • Work closely with equipment OEMs, system integrators, and automation suppliers
  • Manage day-to-day technical engagement with vendors and challenge design assumptions to ensure manufacturability and scalability
  • Support equipment architecture, controls strategy, robotics integration, and functional safety implementation
  • Translate complex manufacturing problems into practical and robust equipment designs
  • Conduct technical evaluations, design reviews, and troubleshooting for automated assembly, adhesive dispensing, bonding processes, and smart torque systems
  • Support development of standardized equipment and process platforms deployable across multiple sites
  • Partner with manufacturing sites, Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, EHS, and other functions to define technical requirements
  • Participate in commissioning, startup, debug, and handoff of new equipment to manufacturing sites
  • Generate engineering documentation, specifications, test plans, and validation reports
  • Provide subject matter expertise to support enterprise automation and assembly initiatives
  • Proactively identify design risks, integration issues, and performance gaps; propose and execute solutions independently
  • May mentor junior engineers and support capability-building within the team

Technical Scope:

The Adhesion & Assembly team supports manufacturing technologies including:

  • Automated and semi-automated assembly systems
  • Industrial and collaborative robotics
  • Smart torque and intelligent fastening systems
  • Adhesive dispensing and application
  • Epoxy, sealant, and bonding processes
  • Thermal interface material application
  • Precision assembly and joining
  • Vision-guided assembly
  • Process monitoring and verification
  • Integrated manufacturing equipment and automation cells

Qualifications You Must Have:

  • Typically requires A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years experience
  • Experience with industrial automation and robotics
  • U.S. Citizen

Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Experience developing, integrating, or deploying industrial manufacturing equipment
  • Working knowledge of industrial controls, PLC-based systems, and equipment integration
  • Knowledge of functional safety and machine safety principles
  • Experience working directly with equipment OEMs, system integrators, or automation suppliers
  • Ability to travel international and domestic up to 30%
  • U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are authorized to access information under this program/contract.
  • Experience developing automated assembly, adhesive application, bonding, or torque-related manufacturing equipment
  • Ability to evaluate and troubleshoot complex engineering solutions
  • Strong background in industrial robotics, automated manufacturing cells, and equipment integration
  • Experience with commissioning, debug, acceptance testing, and production ramp support
  • Experience supporting multi-site equipment deployment
  • Familiarity with machine vision, precision assembly systems, or material dispensing technologies
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with vendors and challenge technical designs
  • Strong hands-on problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and technical execution skills

Are you ready to join a growing team that puts a premium on productivity and has an award-winning culture centered around transforming talented employees into effective business leaders? Then BHG Financial is the place for you.
In 2001, we started with an idea, an opportunity, and $25,000. Back then, our focus was strictly  on serving those in the medical industry. With healthcare in our heritage, we soon expanded  to serve high-earning professionals in many  other industries, providing all with leading-edge financial solutions, including our extensive network of community banks.
Today, BHG Financial has firmly established  its legacy as a leader in the financial services space. Founded on the philosophy of a better way to borrow, we are dedicated to helping accomplished professionals, small businesses, and institutions build upon their success through innovative financial solutions, a hassle-free process, and personalized concierge service.
Our relentless commitment to the success of our customers is part of what has made BHG Financial thrive. We take a 360-degree view of our customers to tailor the best solutions for their financial aspirations. Today's professionals have multiple sources of income, not just their paycheck. Therefore, it is essential to factor those in when making responsible lending decisions. Our continued focus on data, analytics, and proprietary modeling has enabled faster funding for our customers.
From business to personal loans to relationships with community banks, the country’s top professionals and business owners rely on us for our exceptional financial solutions and concierge service to continue their success and legacy.

Who You Are

You are a motivated learning and development professional who is passionate about creating transformative learning experiences. You excel at applying instructional design principles and adult learning theories and have experience designing and developing multimedia content for various learning interventions. You are a creative, innovative, and strategic thinker who thrives in a fast-paced environment where you can translate complex concepts into engaging and interactive learning materials that inspire and empower learners across the organization.

  • Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to gather content and learning objectives for various learning initiatives
  • Apply instructional design methodologies to create engaging and effective learning experiences

  • Utilize authoring tools, learning management systems, and other technologies to create and deliver learning solutions
  • Design and develop multimedia content, including e-learning modules, videos, interactive simulations, and assessments
  • Analyze training needs and performance gaps to identify areas where learning interventions are required
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery within budget and quality standards
  • Incorporate gamification, microlearning, and other innovative approaches to increase engagement and knowledge retention

  • Strong knowledge of instructional design methodologies, adult learning principles, and learning technologies

  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders
  • Creativity and a passion for creating engaging and impactful learning experiences
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making
  • Willingness to stay up-to-date with emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in instructional design and adult learning
  • Travel required for periodic team onsites

At BHG Financial, we work hard and aren’t afraid to take risks. We have a healthy respect for the daily grind, yet we value work/life balance. We believe that all employees should have the opportunity to lead and that good ideas can come from anyone. From the top down, our leaders are actively involved not only in strategic oversight and running the business, but also in the well-being and growth of all employees. We consider people our #1 asset, and help employees realize their full potential, set and exceed their goals, and explore new opportunities for personal and professional development.

Why You Should Join BHG Financial

We strive to offer amenities, opportunities, events, and programming that support the interests of our teams, while furthering the culture that makes us Great Place to Work® certified. Some of the benefits you can expect when you join BHG Financial include:
•Medical/Rx/Dental/Vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members
•Competitive PTO and vacation policies

•Company 401(k) plan with employer contributions after one year
•Company-sponsored training and certification opportunities
•Quarterly award ceremonies where top achievers are celebrated and receive additional bonuses
•Ongoing volunteer opportunities to give back to the community through our BHG Cares program
If you’re ready for a career where you can exercise your passions, be surrounded by co-workers who are relentlessly committed to service, and have a team-player mindset, apply today!

About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to measure, understand, and help optimize Coalition’s insurance business. You’ll use analytics, experimentation, and modern statistical techniques to improve the cyber insurance customer experience and grow revenue safely and efficiently.

You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, and insurance stakeholders to identify emerging trends, prioritize opportunities, and turn complex data into clear, actionable strategies that shape product and operational roadmaps.

Responsibilities

  • Lead cross-functional analytics projects that uncover insights and optimization opportunities across the end-to-end customer journey
  • Support the team’s long term goal of enabling data analytics agents for the business through context engineering support and data analysis
  • Design and analyze experiments, and establish best practices for test design, power, guardrails, and interpretation
  • Define, document, and maintain core funnel metrics, and build automated dashboards and reporting for leadership
  • Synthesize findings from disparate data sources into clear narratives with recommended actions
  • Develop data models and scalable analytical workflows that improve reliability, repeatability, and time-to-insight
  • Influence product and revenue leadership with data-backed recommendations and OKR tracking
  • Mentor junior analysts and scientists, and contribute to team standards for code quality and documentation

Skills and Qualifications

  • 6+ years in analytics or data science, with demonstrated product or revenue impact
  • Expert SQL skills, including complex modeling, performance optimization, and clear documentation
  • Proficiency in Python or R for analysis, experimentation, and reproducible workflows
  • Strong grasp of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, experiment design, causal thinking, and interpretation
  • Experience with BI tools such as Looker or Tableau, and the ability to build reliable, executive-ready dashboards
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences

Bonus Points

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot
  • Domain experience in insurance, insurtech, fintech, or other regulated industries
  • Familiarity with tools like Amplitude, Google Analytics, Marketo, Salesforce, Segment, or Zuora
  • Experience with analytics workflow tools such as dbt or Airflow
  • Exposure to causal inference methods and quasi-experimental designs

Compensation

For all other locations, the base salary for this position ranges from $123,600/year up to $185,300/year.

raw.description:
Caseware combines over 35 years of industry expertise with AI-powered technology to transform how audit and accounting professionals work. Serving organizations across 130 countries, we bring intelligent automation directly into audit and financial reporting workflows—helping professionals reduce manual work, navigate complexity, and focus on informed decisions. Join our global team and help build technology that strengthens trust in financial information.

We’re hiring a Software Developer in Test (SDET) to join the quality engineering team on one of Caseware’s SaaS Platform teams—driving scalable, modern approaches to testing, automation, and developer enablement. Reporting into the Central Quality function and working within the SE Platform team, this role is uniquely positioned to drive the quality strategy across foundational platform areas that underpin our most critical innovations.

What makes this role especially exciting: we’re not just building traditional apps. We’re accelerating delivery of advanced Cloud Engagements and moving toward Agentic development and testing capabilities—systems and harnesses that defy conventional testing and require a new way of thinking around test strategy, verification and validation.

If you’re energized by the challenge of enabling velocity while maintaining trust and quality on an ever-evolving cloud ecosystem, this is the opportunity to shape that future.

📍 Location: This is a fully remote position located in Colombia.

Contact

Maira Russo - Senior Talent Acquisition Partner

What You’ll Be Doing

    • Being part of the Central Quality Engineering Function

    Represent the team of Software Developers in Test (SDETs) who partner closely with product teams to embed quality into every phase of development—through tooling, automation, infrastructure, reporting and best practices.

    • Practice Quality Strategy Across the Platform

    Contribute within a modern quality strategy tailored to the demands of a rapidly scaling SaaS platform. Impact through improvements within the test pyramid, shifting away from sole UI-based validation towards lower levels of testing to increase reliability.

    Contribute to Improving CI/CD and Developer Workflows

    Enhance the stability and speed of our E2E tests by making improvements to test data setup processes, test isolation, and execution reliability. Ensuring quality is built in from development to deployment without sacrificing team velocity and promoting actionable test failure signals to shorten feedback loops and increase developer confidence. Champion tooling and practices that reduce flaky tests and noisy signals.

    • Functional Testing, from Idea to Value delivered

    Work with the test team to ensure timely completion of functionality and enhancements as driven by the roadmaps for the team. Provide horizontal support across the test team where necessary to take the team to the finish line. Participate in all the testing phases to positively impact lead time to value with agentic testing capabilities and leveraging the AI Test Harnesses applied within the QE space.

    • Drive Quality KPIs

    Contribute towards key DORA metrics such as test coverage, defect trends, test effectiveness and execution health, flakiness, and regression rates. Use these insights to continually refine the quality practices and guide investments in automation and infrastructure.

    • Drive Culture and Practice Alignment

    Contribute to our teams by embodying our core values: Uphold Powered by Trust through instilling a quality-first mindset. Reflect Many Voices, One Team by actively engaging in cross-functional initiatives to ensure Quality influences design, planning, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring and incident reviews. Exemplify Innovation with Impact by sharing testing methodologies with developers and fellow SDETs, and by consistently applying a growth mindset to your professional responsibilities with an AI first mindset.

What You Will Bring

    • 2+ years' experience working in Quality Engineering teams within modern SaaS or platform organizations in cloud-native environments (AWS).

    • Expertise in working with scaling automated testing infrastructure, including integration with modern CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Workflows).

    • Knowledge of testing strategies and tools across the pyramid, from unit to E2E, including api contract and integration testing (Cypress, Pact, K6).

    • Solid front-end knowledge and testing fluency in HTML/CSS and JavaScript/TypeScript, enabling effective collaboration across full-stack teams.

    • Familiarity with observability tools and best practices for improving test signal and pipeline feedback loops.

    • Strong communication and coaching skills with the ability to influence fellow engineering and product stakeholders across the org.

At #paid, we’re on a mission to empower creators to do what they love—create. Our marketplace connects vetted creators with some of the world’s most iconic brands, like McDonald’s, Samsung, and Disney, fostering authentic collaborations that drive real business results. We’ve built a marketplace that solves big challenges in the creator ecosystem, from fair pricing to algorithmic matching and content usage rights, ensuring every partnership is seamless and impactful.
With our proprietary technology and an unwavering commitment to trust and transparency, we’re revolutionizing the way brands and creators come together to make magic. Rated #1 for customer support and managed services, #paid is leading the creator marketing space. Through innovative technology and a team of ambitious humans, we're transforming the future of the creator economy.

The Role

Creative Solutions now owns execution from end to end, so strategy has to cover the whole span: pre-sale (discovery, ideation, proposals) and post-sale (kickoff strategy, campaign briefs, post-campaign insights). As a Strategist on this team, you’ll shape the idea that wins the pitch and stay with it until it ships, performs, and turns into a renewal. Our goal is simple: the idea that wins the pitch is the idea that ships.

Role Title: Digital Artist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote - US only

micro1 is engaging Digital Artists to contribute their creative and technical expertise to a unique project focused on evaluating and enhancing AI-generated images. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is ideal for those who excel in visual analysis, detailed critique, and clear communication, leveraging both original creations and digital photography skills to advance the state of AI image modeling.

Scope of Work

  1. Upload your own original digital images or photographs in line with provided project specifications.
  2. Conduct side-by-side evaluations of your artwork against AI-generated counterparts, documenting every visible difference and deviation.
  3. Identify and articulate issues related to anatomy, color, lighting, perspective, texture, and fine detail.
  4. Detect and describe common AI artifacts, including warped anatomy, smeared or broken textures, inconsistent shadows, and irregular reflections or text.
  5. Compose concise, visually precise written feedback using industry-standard terminology to describe each flaw, referencing specific locations within images.
  6. Deliver thorough, methodical reviews, prioritizing accuracy and visual detail over speed to maintain consistent quality across all assignments.
  7. Collaborate with project coordinators and other contributors to ensure comprehensive image assessment and feedback alignment.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Located in the United States, with valid authorization to contract within the country.
  2. Minimum of 2 years’ experience in digital art, retouching, compositing, 3D rendering, graphic design, color grading, or photography, with a portfolio of original works.
  3. Proficiency in image editing and creation tools such as Photoshop, Lightroom, Procreate, Blender, or similar platforms.
  4. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with emphasis on descriptive and technical visual vocabulary.
  5. Demonstrated ability to detect subtle differences and accurately identify artifacts unique to AI-generated images.
  6. Basic understanding of AI image generation processes and knowledge of typical failure points (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Firefly, Flux experience is a plus).
  7. Experience in image evaluation, data annotation, or quality assurance in creative or technical projects is advantageous.

raw.description:
About the company

At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”

By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.

With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.

Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.

Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

About the role

Remote in Europe, or hybrid in Barcelona, Dublin, London, or Palma.

Want to help build a new kind of engineering team?

At Nuitée, you'll work across a complex travel marketplace, from pricing and inventory to hotel mapping and booking systems. You'll identify what's limiting performance, decide what needs improving, ship the changes yourself, and see the impact on bookings, market share, and margin.

As one of the first engineers in our new Field Engineering team, you'll work closely with Account Management to tackle the technical challenges behind the growth of our largest enterprise accounts. That might mean optimising pricing to win more hotel bookings without sacrificing margin, improving availability across thousands of properties, or building better recovery mechanisms for failed bookings.

You'll follow problems across the platform rather than staying within one service. When something works, you'll help turn it into a reusable capability across Nuitée.

You'll build on an approach that's already delivered results for a major partner, bring it to more accounts, and help shape the function from its early days.

What makes it interesting for you

  • You can ship while it matters. Account-specific changes can go live the same day, and you can immediately track whether the numbers move.

  • You get the full picture. AMs bring customer context and market-share data; you decide which engineering changes can make the biggest difference.

  • You'll shape how Field Engineering scales. As an early hire, you'll help develop the playbook, share fixes, and turn repeatable solutions into product capabilities.

Your offer comes with meaningful equity. Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre.

The kind of problems you'll work on

  • Why are we losing bookings to competing suppliers, and what changes to pricing, availability, or mapping would win more without sacrificing margin?

  • How do we keep a hotel rate shown in search available at that price when the customer books?

  • How can better prebook and booking recovery mechanisms increase successful transactions?

  • Which solutions developed for one account should become reusable capabilities across the platform?

This role fits if you

  • Are a deeply hands-on, Staff-level software engineer with a track record of building complex production systems.

  • Can trace problems across backend services, APIs, data flows, and external dependencies, then implement solutions yourself.

  • Understand how technical decisions affect customers, product performance, and commercial outcomes.

  • Have taken ambiguous engineering problems from diagnosis through production and measured the impact.

  • Explain complex technical topics clearly and work well with Product and commercial teams.

Experience with marketplaces, pricing, transactional platforms, or complex API products is particularly relevant. Go experience is a plus, but not required for experienced engineers. Travel industry experience isn't necessary either.

Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your work actually delivers.

If this sounds interesting, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes ~3 weeks.

Why Nuitee?

At Nuitée, we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.

  • Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale.
  • World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally.
  • Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.
  • Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others
  • AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions.

By joining Nuitée, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us—Nuitée is the place for you.

By submitting your application, you consent to Nuitée processing your personal data for the purposes of assessing your suitability for employment. Root was founded on the belief that car insurance is broken, and we set out to change it. We’re harnessing the power of technology to revolutionize this archaic, complicated industry. Using machine learning and mobile telematic platforms, we’ve built one of the most innovative insurtech companies in the world.

The Opportunity

We believe that a disruptive insurance company must have a principled quantitative framework at its foundation. At Root, we are committed to the rigorous development and effective deployment of modern statistical machine learning methods to problems in the insurance industry.

As a Lead Actuary I, you will own complex pricing work from problem definition through implementation. In this role, you will lead the development of tools and frameworks to file and deploy auto pricing and product updates more efficiently. You will work cross-functionally with State Product Management and Engineering, and regularly engage with Root’s executive team to align technical insights with strategic priorities.

At Root, we are building a more efficient, data-driven approach to insurance pricing. Our Actuarial Pricing team supports regulatory filings, develops rate indications, evaluates pricing performance, and partners across the organization to help Root make well-informed decisions about risk, growth, and profitability. To advance this work, we are looking for a Lead Actuary I who can improve and automate existing processes, utilizing AI technologies where appropriate while maintaining rigor and regulatory compliance.

Salary Range: $107,800 - $134,700(Eligible for competitive bonus and equity offering)

Root is a “work where it works best” company. Meaning we will support you working in whatever location that works best for you across the US. We will continue to have our headquarters in Columbus, Ohio.

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Prepare, review, and support end-to-end rate filings, including actuarial exhibits, supporting documentation, implementation requirements, and responses to regulatory objections.
  • Own complex actuarial pricing projects, including rate level indications, pricing analyses, state expansion work, refunds, and other initiatives that support Root’s growth and profitability.
  • Serve as a filing manager or technical reviewer for filings prepared by other actuaries, providing clear feedback and ensuring that work is accurate, complete, well-supported, and ready for submission.
  • Develop and communicate actuarial recommendations by evaluating data, methodologies, assumptions, business context, and regulatory considerations.
  • Act as a subject-matter expert in one or more areas of actuarial pricing, such as rate level indications, state-specific pricing, rate level analysis, refunds, predictive-model implementation, or filing operations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the filing process and pricing workflow through better documentation, reusable frameworks, automation, and effective use of data and technology, including GenAI.
  • Partner with Product, State Management, Regulatory, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, and other teams to translate technical analysis into clear business decisions.
  • Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and missing information that could affect filing, launch, or implementation timelines.
  • Communicate complex actuarial concepts and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders.
  • Coach and support other actuaries through technical collaboration, review, knowledge sharing, and development of team standards.
  • Balance independent execution with effective prioritization, escalating decisions and risks when appropriate while maintaining forward momentum.

What You Will Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years of experience in the insurance industry, including 3+ years of experience in actuarial pricing, ratemaking, or a related discipline.
  • Experience with personal lines property and casualty insurance, preferably auto insurance.
  • Experience developing or reviewing rate level indications and supporting regulatory rate filings.
  • Experience building actuarial automation, filing tools, or scalable pricing processes.
  • Independently frames complex problems, evaluates options, and communicates clear recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong actuarial judgment and the ability to evaluate methodologies, assumptions, data limitations, and business tradeoffs.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently frame problems, assess options, recommend a path forward, and deliver results across multiple workstreams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly and concisely.
  • Experience with SQL, R, Python, or similar analytical tools.
  • Demonstrated ownership mentality, including proactively identifying opportunities, risks, and process improvements.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.
  • Successful completion of at least five actuarial exams.
  • Preferred but not required:
    • ACAS designation.
    • Experience with more complex regulatory jurisdictions.
    • Experience with predictive modeling, machine learning, or model implementation.
    • Experience with Git, cloud computing, or production-oriented analytical workflows.

WHO YOU ARE:

In response to ongoing and industry-wide fraudulent recruitment activities (i.e., job scams), Rightway wants to inform potential candidates that we will only contact them from the @ email domain. We will never ask for bank details or deposits of any kind as a condition of employment.

ABOUT RIGHTWAY:

Rightway is on a mission to harmonize healthcare for everyone, everywhere. Our products guide patients to the best care and medications by inserting clinicians and pharmacists into a patient’s care journey through a modern, mobile app. Rightway is a front door to healthcare, giving patients the tools they need along with on-demand access to Rightway health guides, human experts that answer their questions and manage the frustrating parts of healthcare for them.

Since its founding in 2017, Rightway has raised over $300mm from investors including Khosla Ventures, Thrive Capital, Francisco Partners, and Tiger Global. We’re headquartered in New York City, with satellite offices in Denver and Dallas. Our clients rely on us to transform the healthcare experience, improve outcomes for their teams, and decrease their healthcare costs.

HOW WE LIVE OUR VALUES TO OUR TEAMMATES:

We’re seeking those with passion for healthcare and relentless devotion to our goal. We need team members that embody our core values:

1) We are human, firstOur humanity binds us together. We bring the same empathetic approach to every individual we engage with, whether it be our members, our clients, or each other. We listen to—and hear—each other, we celebrate our differences and similarities, we are present for each other, and we strive for mutual understanding.

2) We redefine what is possibleWe always look beyond the obstacles in front of us to imagine new solutions. We approach our work with inspiration from other industries, other leaders, and other challenges. We use ingenuity and resourcefulness when faced with tough problems.

3) We debate then commitWe believe that a spirit of open discourse is part of a healthy culture. We understand and appreciate different perspectives and we challenge our assumptions. When working toward a decision or a new solution, we actively listen to one another, approach it with a “yes, and” mentality, and assume positive intent. Once a decision is made, we align and champion it as one team.

4) We cultivate gritChanging healthcare doesn’t happen overnight. We reflect and learn from challenges and approach the future with a determination to strive for better. In the face of daunting situations, we value persistence. We embrace failure as a stepping stone to future success. On this journey, we seek to act with guts, resilience, initiative, and tenacity.

5) We seek to delightHealthcare is complicated and personal. We work tirelessly to meet the goals of our clients while also delivering the best experience to our members. We recognize that no matter the role or team, we each play a crucial part in our members’ care and take that responsibility seriously. When faced with an obstacle, we are kind, respectful, and solution-oriented in our approach. We hold ourselves accountable to our clients and our members’ success.

Rightway is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in the strength of diverse thought, beliefs, backgrounds, and education. We foster an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated to drive the best business decisions possible. We do not discriminate on any basis protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, need, and performance.

raw.description:
About MMRO
Managed Medical Review Organization (MMRO) is a nationally recognized, URAC-accredited Independent Review Organization (IRO) specializing in objective, evidence-based medical peer reviews and disability evaluations. For more than 30 years, MMRO has partnered with government agencies, health plans, employers, and disability systems across the United States to deliver high-quality, clinically sound, and impartial medical reviews.
Our mission is to support fair and accurate healthcare and disability-related decisions by leveraging the expertise of experienced practicing physicians. MMRO is committed to integrity, clinical excellence, quality assurance, and timely service, providing an environment where physician expertise directly impacts important healthcare determinations.
We are currently seeking Board-Certified Pain Medicine, to join our nationwide network of independent Physician Reviewers.
Position Overview
As an Independent Physician Reviewer, you will perform objective medical record reviews and provide evidence-based opinions regarding diagnosis, treatment, disability, impairment, and medical necessity questions. Reviews are conducted remotely and do not require direct patient interaction.
This role is ideal for physicians seeking flexible consulting opportunities that allow them to apply their clinical expertise while maintaining control over their schedule and workload.
Responsibilities
  • Conduct thorough, unbiased medical chart reviews in accordance with accepted clinical standards and evidence-based guidelines.
  • Analyze medical records and supporting documentation to formulate clear, well-reasoned clinical opinions.
  • Prepare concise, accurate, and defensible written reports that clearly support review determinations.
  • Complete reviews in accordance with MMRO's quality standards and established turnaround times.
  • Utilize MMRO review templates and ensure all required elements are addressed completely and accurately.
  • Maintain professionalism, objectivity, and confidentiality throughout the review process.
  • Respond promptly to communications from MMRO clinical and operations staff.
  • Participate in required reviewer orientation and ongoing training activities.
  • Incorporate quality feedback provided by MMRO's Medical Director, Associate Medical Director, and clinical team.
  • Support continuous quality improvement initiatives through constructive suggestions and collaboration.
Qualifications
Required
  • Current, unrestricted M.D. or D.O. license to practice medicine in the United States.
  • Active Mississippi state medical license.
  • Board Certification through an American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) or American Osteopathic Association (AOA) recognized specialty board.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of full-time equivalent clinical practice providing direct patient care.
  • Active clinical experience within the past three (3) years.
  • Strong written communication skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to meet established review deadlines consistently.
Preferred
  • Prior experience performing peer reviews, independent medical reviews, disability evaluations, utilization review, or expert medical opinions.
Why Partner with MMRO?
  • 100% remote independent contractor opportunity
  • Flexible scheduling with the ability to accept cases based on your availability
  • No patient appointments, call coverage, or administrative practice responsibilities
  • Competitive per-case compensation
  • Opportunities to review cases aligned with your specialty expertise
  • Dedicated clinical and operational support team
  • Work with a respected, URAC-accredited organization committed to quality and clinical integrity
  • Make a meaningful impact on healthcare and disability-related decision-making nationwide

You will be part of the EMEA Sales organization and work closely with the Head of Inside Sales, EMEA, Field Sales teams, Technical Service teams, Marketing, and Customer Support. In this role, you will collaborate with colleagues across Europe to develop customer relationships, identify growth opportunities, and deliver customer-focused solutions. You will also engage daily with customers, supporting them throughout the sales journey and contributing to long-term business success.

How will you make a difference?

As an Inside Sales Specialist (m/f/d), Germany, you will report directly to the Head of Inside Sales, EMEA. You will be responsible for developing and growing an assigned customer portfolio by building strong customer relationships and driving sales opportunities in close collaboration with Field Sales teams. Through a proactive, customer-centric approach, you will manage the entire sales cycle, identify new business opportunities, and support customers with tailored technical solutions. Your ability to combine technical expertise with commercial awareness will contribute to business growth, customer satisfaction, and long-term success within the German market and the wider EMEA region.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Solid technical background in Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) with strong knowledge of UT and ET technologies and their practical applications.
  • NDT Level 1+ certification preferred or equivalent technical expertise.
  • Knowledge of Industrial Visual Endoscopy (RVI) is an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of technical products including ultrasonic testing equipment, flaw detectors, phased array systems, and visual inspection technologies.
  • 3–5 years of experience in an industrial B2B environment, such as inspection, technical service, training, sales, or aftersales roles.
  • Ability to identify customer needs and transform technical requirements into business opportunities.
  • Experience working with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and digital sales tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365.
  • Fluent German and English language skills; additional languages are a plus.
  • Strong communication, customer relationship, and stakeholder management skills.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Manage the complete sales cycle for your assigned customer portfolio, from initial contact through order confirmation.
  • Drive business growth through cross-selling, upselling, and proactive customer engagement.
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities through market research, prospecting activities, and targeted sales campaigns.
  • Promote and sell Technical Service Solutions tailored to customer needs and installed equipment.
  • Qualify inbound leads and ensure effective customer segmentation and opportunity management.
  • Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and customer records within the CRM system.
  • Deliver virtual customer presentations, demonstrations, and solution-focused discussions.
  • Develop innovative approaches to solve customer challenges and create value-added solutions.
  • Continuously expand your technical and commercial expertise through training and collaboration with Field Sales teams.

Legal authorization to work in the European Union is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

It’s not just about your career… or your job title…it’s about who you are and the impact you are going to make on the world. Do you want to go into uncharted waters…do things that haven’t been done to make yours and someone else's life better? Wabtec has been doing that for decades and we will continue to do so! At Accuray, we make a direct and powerful impact on the lives of cancer patients every day — helping them live longer, better lives. But our commitment to innovation offers a truly unique opportunity: the chance to change the fight against cancer — helping to develop, introduce and support new treatment delivery systems and software that will give new hope and new health to cancer patients and cancer survivors around the world.

Accuray develops, manufactures and sells radiotherapy systems for alternative cancer treatments. Our radiation therapy for cancer makes treatment shorter, safer, personalized and more effective, ultimately enabling patients to live longer, better lives.

Job Description

Territory Operations Manager - India & Subcontinent

SUMMARY:

The Territory Operations Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating multiple Operations functions in the Territory and supporting the development and execution of policies, plans and programs to meet anticipated organizational needs under applicable regulatory requirements.

Cooperating with the Territory managers and the Director of Field Service - APAC & China, this individual will achieve success by providing leadership, alignment and mentoring across the diverse Operations teams in the Territory. (i.e. Project Management, Service Delivery, Service Support, Clinical Training & Education, …)

This position will require a high degree of independence and initiative to embody the unified vision of APAC Operations, skillfully integrated within the unique cultural and market specificities of the Territory.

REPORTING TO/DEPARTMENT:

This position reports to the Director of Field Service - APAC & China

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

LEADERSHIP & MANAGEMENT

  • Participate to the development and lead the execution of the customer support strategy in the Territory to maximize long-term installed base customer loyalty, creating a “Best-in-Class” organisation and/or Distributors network focusing on Customer satisfaction for our current and future Installed Base.
  • Lead highly effective teams including organizational development. Recruit, develop and coach functional leaders while providing common directions to the Operations employees in the Territory.
  • Promote employee learning & development and succession planning methodologies resulting in committed, loyal and high performing organization.
  • Coordinate with his/her teams and TSM - S&W the selection and continuous evaluation of Distributors (including transitions from one Distributor to another).
  • Develop and implement a long-term Customer & Distributor fulfillment strategy; assist in building the future organization structure in the Territory; embed a (internal and external) Customer-oriented perspective and approach across all functional areas of the business.
  • Foster a culture of trust and build a valued, credible, positive and collaborative relationship with the APAC regional Operations leaders and regional functions Heads.
  • Partner with the Business Management & Development and Marketing teams in the Territory to build a collaborative, Customer-focused relationship with our Customers and Distributors to meet Systems and Upgrades sales and profitability objectives in the Territory.
  • Develop and drive a work culture committed to safety, compliance and quality in alignment with Accuray Quality Management System while promoting Health and Safety programs.

OPERATIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Collaborate with the Director of Field Service - APAC & China and Global functional leaders to establish operating and capital budgets for his/her team. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve overall financial and operational performance in the Territory.
  • Secure service revenues (including service contracts, installations, training and spare parts sales) and profitability. Coordinate with regional Operations management to ensure smooth implementation and utilization of our products.
  • Collaborate with the territory managers to drive Service performance in Territory, setting and improving processes, while ensuring compliance. Validate Distributor Service capabilities and strengths prior to enrollment. Evaluate and implement changes in Distributor Agreements.
  • Collaborate with the APAC department leadership teams to deploy effective account management practices to minimize Customers and Distributors disputes or concerns while fostering proactive and predictive account management.
  • Interface with Director of Service Delivery & Revenue and Distributors to provide input on pricing, support programs, marketing and sales activities in the Territory. Formulate a Service Marketing plan to maximize service value and achieve business goals for service growth in collaboration with Marketing.
  • Coordinate with regional resources, including Training Centers, for technical and clinical trainings’ needs in the Territory.
  • Work with the Director of Service Support & Infrastructure to verify the efficiency and effectiveness of the Territory call center administered by the Customer & Logistics Support team.
  • Monitor performance, network and warehousing of the 3PL partner in the Territory. Interface with Director of Service Support & Infrastructure to maximize spare part management and related logistic processes in the Territory.

PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT

  • Develop cross-functional relationships to influence key business criteria (e.g. Spare part consumption) and coordinate process changes.
  • Define programs with other departments to increase Installed Base technical performance in the Territory (e.g. Uptime, MTBD). Execute continuous improvement plans.
  • Lead efforts to develop and improve business practices, systems and processes; maximize resources and achieve operational excellence in the Territory (e.g., cost effectiveness, Customer satisfaction, account management, sustainability).
  • Develop, market and execute a Territory strategy driving continuous favorable trending (quarter-over-quarter) to service profitability.
  • Partner with the Business Management & Development department for effective contracts negotiation, being accountable for profitable execution of those service agreements.

PERFORMANCE METRICS

  • Employee retention and Engagement Score
  • Installed base customer retention and replacement system sales.
  • Installed base Customer Loyalty (survey results) and Accuray Net Promoter Scores
  • Service contract adoption rate, revenue, and profitability.
  • Service execution (uptime, MTBD, Work Order management, Cycle Count, ageing inventory) and service support (parts returns, inventory accuracy, LMS training records) effectiveness.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BS/BA degree required: MBA highly desirable.
  • 5+ business experience in related operations functions within multinational companies with broad-based Medical Device or Capital Equipment operating experience
  • Senior management experience in customer-centric commercial role. Experience in sales or marketing role a plus.
  • Strong leadership with the ability to build high-performance teams through change and cultivate strong internal relationships at all levels. Skilled to hire great talent and provide constructive feedback for continuous people development.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and navigate in a matrix environment within a culturally diverse environment.
  • Ability to work independently; deal with ambiguity; grasp and retain complex concepts.
  • Ability to think strategically and contribute directly to the regional growth plan.
  • Executive presence, ability to develop C-suite customer relationships.
  • Proven experience in process engineering and productivity gain, 6 Sigma black belt a plus
  • Ability to drive process improvement, new business and cost savings initiative.
  • Self-sufficient with Advanced Microsoft office and ERP databases
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills along with strong presentation skills in English.

To qualify for this position, candidates must be able to furnish proof that they are authorized to work in the country they are applying on a permanent basis without sponsorship.
