raw.description:
Why This Role Exists

We’re looking for a hands-on, commercially minded Tax Manager to build and strengthen the group’s internal tax capability as our international business continues to grow.

Working directly with the Group CFO, you’ll take ownership of our tax compliance, risk management and strategy across multiple entities and jurisdictions. Your immediate priority will be indirect tax, including VAT, GST and sales tax, while also improving oversight of corporation tax, employment tax and cross-border obligations.

Beyond compliance, you’ll help shape our international corporate structure, identify opportunities to improve tax efficiency and support M&A activity. This is an opportunity to establish a clear, documented view of the group’s tax position and influence how tax is managed across the business.

What You’ll Own

  • Tax compliance and risk: Oversee international tax obligations, prioritising VAT, GST and sales tax while managing corporation tax, payroll tax and cross-border employment considerations.

  • Tax review and exposure management: Assess the existing tax position across jurisdictions, identify compliance gaps and potential liabilities, and establish clear processes for monitoring and mitigating risk.

  • International tax strategy: Partner with the Group CFO to evaluate tax-efficient structures and business decisions across jurisdictions, including Ireland, the UK, Malta, Romania and the US.

  • M&A and corporate structuring: Support tax due diligence, assess acquisition-related liabilities and opportunities, and contribute to post-acquisition structuring.

  • External advisor management: Oversee external tax advisors and service providers, critically evaluate their recommendations and reduce unnecessary reliance on outsourced expertise.

  • Research and problem-solving: Investigate unfamiliar tax rules, assess legislative changes and develop evidence-based recommendations for the business.

  • Process improvement: Build consistent, well-documented tax processes and improve the visibility and accuracy of tax information across entities.

  • Stakeholder partnership: Work with Finance, Technology, Data and business leaders to ensure tax implications are considered in commercial and operational decisions.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

  • Build an understanding of the group’s businesses, entities, revenue flows and existing tax arrangements.

  • Establish relationships with the Group CFO, Finance team and external tax advisors.

  • Identify the most immediate tax compliance priorities and areas requiring further investigation.

First 90 days

  • Complete an initial review of the group’s tax position across key jurisdictions.

  • Identify and prioritise known exposures, compliance gaps and indirect tax risks.

  • Recommend practical improvements to filing reviews, reporting, documentation and advisor oversight.

Within 12 months

  • Establish a clear, documented and defensible view of the group’s tax position across its entities and jurisdictions.

  • Ensure effective tax compliance and review processes are in place, with material risks identified and appropriately addressed.

  • Introduce a proactive approach to monitoring tax legislation and assessing its impact.

  • Demonstrate measurable improvements in risk management, advisor oversight and cost efficiency.

  • Contribute to the group’s longer-term tax strategy, international structuring and M&A opportunities.

What We’re Looking For

Experience and qualifications

  • Approximately 7 years of relevant tax experience, with progression towards Tax Manager-level responsibility.

  • A recognised professional tax qualification, such as CTA, AITI CTA or an equivalent. ACCA, ACA/CAI or ADIT may also be relevant when supported by appropriate tax expertise.

  • Broad experience across indirect tax, particularly VAT/GST and sales tax, alongside corporation tax and employer/payroll tax.

  • Experience managing tax obligations across multiple entities and international jurisdictions.

  • A track record of reviewing tax positions, identifying potential exposures and developing practical solutions.

  • Experience managing external tax advisors and evaluating their recommendations.

Technical and commercial skills

  • Strong technical knowledge of indirect tax and the ability to investigate complex or unfamiliar tax issues.

  • An understanding of international taxation, corporate structuring and cross-border transactions.

  • Strong analytical and research skills, with the confidence to develop an independent view before engaging external specialists.

  • The ability to interpret financial information and understand how commercial activities and revenue flows affect tax obligations.

  • Familiarity with accounting systems such as Microsoft Dynamics and indirect tax platforms such as Sovos, or equivalent tools.

  • Confidence using modern research and AI tools to support analysis and investigate jurisdiction-specific requirements.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tax matters in practical business terms.

Who Thrives Here

You’ll thrive in this role if you are:

  • Self-directed: You take ownership, identify what needs investigating and move problems forward without waiting for detailed instructions.

  • Curious: You ask questions, explore unfamiliar areas and look beyond the immediate issue to understand the wider implications.

  • Commercially minded: You balance compliance and risk management with the practical needs and growth ambitions of the business.

  • Comfortable challenging assumptions: You test external advice, question recommendations and support your conclusions with evidence.

  • Pragmatic: You know when to investigate an issue yourself and when specialist external advice is warranted.

  • Collaborative: You build strong relationships across Finance and the wider business, ensuring tax considerations are factored into decisions early.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: You can work across multiple entities and jurisdictions, prioritise competing demands and establish structure where processes need improvement.

Why People Stay and Love Working Here

At Yomali, we value ownership, autonomy and the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution.

You’ll work in an international, decentralised group where teams have the freedom to make decisions, solve problems and take responsibility for outcomes. Rather than operating within a rigid, established tax function, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how the group approaches tax management as the business grows.

You’ll also work closely with senior leadership, gaining visibility into decisions that span multiple businesses, international expansion and acquisitions.

What’s In It For You

  • Build something meaningful: Develop the group’s internal tax capability and establish processes that support long-term growth.

  • Work directly with the CFO: Influence decisions and provide recommendations that have a tangible impact on the business.

  • Gain strategic exposure: Combine hands-on tax management with international structuring, commercial decision-making and M&A.

  • Own your approach: Have the autonomy to investigate problems, challenge assumptions and implement improvements.

  • Make a measurable difference: Reduce tax risk, improve efficiency and identify opportunities to deliver value.

  • Competitive compensation: Receive a salary aligned with your location and experience, plus an annual performance-based bonus of 10–15%.

Interview Process

The interview process will assess your technical tax knowledge, commercial judgement, problem-solving approach and ability to take ownership.

  1. Initial screening: Discuss your experience, motivations, qualifications and alignment with the role.

  2. Technical and competency interview: Explore your experience across indirect tax, international compliance, risk management and working with external advisors.

  3. Practical problem-solving discussion: Assess how you investigate unfamiliar tax issues, evaluate potential exposures and develop recommendations.

  4. Group CFO interview: Discuss your approach to tax strategy, international structuring, stakeholder management and building the internal tax function.

About the Company

Yomali is a privately held group that helps businesses sell more online. We build, grow and acquire software businesses with a long-term ownership mindset, focusing on sustainable growth and maximising human potential.

Our decentralised model gives business units the autonomy to operate effectively while benefiting from the wider group’s experience, resources and capital. We prioritise ownership, results and meaningful contributions over simply measuring hours worked.

Joining Yomali means working across an international group of businesses where you can contribute directly to operational improvements, strategic decisions and long-term value creation.

raw.excerpt: At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth.
raw.description:
At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone’s contribution is welcomed.

We are looking for a Middle ML & AI Engineer to join us as part of our team.

About the role

PitchBook’s Machine Learning Engineer is responsible for using machine learning, statistical modeling, and natural language processing (NLP) to collect a high volume of data for the PitchBook Platform and surface insights for the capital markets. This role will also serve as a resource and mentor for junior members of the team. A strong motivation to succeed is critical, and everyone has the opportunity to shape the long-term direction of our team.

About the project

PitchBook — a platform for investment professionals. Our software provides access to data and the analytical tools to get answers fast and discover promising opportunities. Uncovers actionable insights and trends hidden within the financial data of more than three million companies. Users all over the world include large corporations, start-ups, venture capital and private equity firms, investment banks, and many others. Features of PitchBook: Advanced search / Discovery & insights / Company profiles / Workflow & efficiency / Financials, and many more.

Team: Engineering Manager, 6 MLE’s.

Work Environment: The role offers a flexible work schedule, allowing you to adapt your working hours with the requirement to attend all team meetings. The team follows a Scrum-based Agile methodology.

Technical Stack: Python, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, Spacy, LangChain, LangGraph etc.

As a qualified expert, You will

  • Work with GenAI & LLMs: Design, develop, and fine-tune generative AI models using transformer architectures. Implement advanced techniques to create practical solutions for real-world challenges.
  • Use Modern Toolkits: Leverage frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith to build automated pipelines and intelligent agents. Integrate these tools with vector databases for efficient similarity search and real-time analysis.
  • Extract Data Insights: Process and analyze large volumes of unstructured data using embeddings and statistical modeling to identify meaningful insights.
  • Build Scalable Systems: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create production-grade ML systems that handle real-time, high-volume data processing.
  • Mentor & Lead: Act as a mentor for junior team members and stay updated on trends in Agentic AI, transformer models, and generative systems.
  • Collaborate & Communicate: Work with Product and Engineering teams to improve data management and support innovation. Present complex analyses clearly and effectively.
  • Tech Stack & Focus Areas: Work with generative AI and transformer models, integrating frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith to automate workflows and build intelligent systems. Use PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and Spacy to build NLP pipelines. Implement vector databases for high-dimensional data embeddings and develop hybrid models to extract insights from diverse data sources.

We’re looking for you if you have

  • Educational Background: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Experience: You bring 4+ years of production experience in the ML field, with a track record in developing transformer-based models and deploying them in scalable systems.
  • Technical Expertise: Proficient in Python and machine and deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, ScikitLearn, Spacy, or others; experienced in natural language processing and modern LLM-based techniques; experience with full ML lifecycle, data preprocessing, training, evaluation stage, and monitoring techniques; skilled with SQL and data extraction methods.
  • Innovative Thinker: You thrive on solving complex problems and are always exploring new trends in Generative AI.
  • Collaborator & Communicator: You’re an excellent communicator able to collaborate and professionally express your thoughts to team members, other engineering teams, and stakeholders.
  • Domain Knowledge: Exposure to financial services, investment banking, venture capital, or private equity is nice to have.
  • Languages: English —Upper-Intermediate or higher; Ukrainian —fluent/native.

What’s in it for You

Reveal great tech solutions

Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling clients growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships with our clients.

Experience an agile and flexible working environment

Work fully remote around the globe, or in a hybrid work model from our office hubs which are equipped with everything needed for comfortable work. Enjoy a flexible working schedule and create work and rest balance for yourself. Empower yourself with a stable workload and a stable income, focusing on lasting cooperation and high-performance culture.

Embrace the opportunity for personal and professional growth

Take advantage of performance review and career path. Elevate your skills with mentorship program, personal development plan, and individual learnings through the corporate library, public speaking support, and more.

Feel cared about

Be among like-minded people and feel supported with collaboration, open communication and mutual respect. Join company-wide tech and cultural events, and contribute to meaningful CSR initiatives that resonate with your values.

Interview steps

  • Pre-Screening with the recruiter
  • Technical interview (up to 90 min)
  • System Design interview (up to 45 min)
  • Final interview with Engineering Manager (60 min)

This position will own the end-to-end growth pipeline for a defined geographic region and will be responsible for identifying, qualifying, and securing new contracts while deepening relationships with existing programs. They will lead at the convergence of market intelligence, solution selling, customer relationships and partnership development. Success is measured by revenue growth, win-rate against strategic targets, and the expansion of the TacCIS ecosystem of channel and technology partners.

Market & Opportunity Analysis

  • Conduct continuous market size, trend, and competitor analysis.
  • Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation
  • Build and maintain a strategic opportunity pipeline.
  • Identify emerging defence budget programs, procurement cycles, and policy shifts that create new addressable opportunities.
  • Developing business cases and strategic plans for each pursuit or capture activity; strategic importance/relevance to GDMS-I, price to win analysis, teaming recommendations and expansion plans.

Partner and Ecosystem Development

It is a requirement that General Dynamics Mission Systems-Canada be registered with the Canadian Controlled Goods program and that all of its workforce be security assessed. Applicants may be required to meet additional security requirements in order to gain access to technical data, classified areas or information that is subject to international regulations. You must be eligible to work in Canada.

The hiring range for this position is $140,000-$165,000. This position is also eligible for a management incentive plan. Our goal is to provide a fair and competitive offer based on an assessment of internal equity and your qualifications, including:

Benefits

Why join us?

  • Purposeful Innovation: You’ll work on innovations that genuinely make a difference. You’ll apply advanced thinking, design expertise, and practical problem-solving to help equip military and allied forces with leading-edge systems. You’ll be surrounded by some of the brightest minds in the defence sector, contributing to next-generation technologies in an environment that celebrates creativity, new ideas, and modern solutions.
  • Connection: We believe people do their best work when they feel they belong, and their ideas can flourish. Different perspectives, experiences, and ways of thinking help us innovate and grow. Strong relationships with our teammates help us unite, overcome challenges, and deliver the world-class quality we’re known for. Here, we are committed to inclusivity and ensures every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.

From mentorship and regular check-ins with your leader to educational support, professional certifications, and continuous training, you’ll have the resources you need to thrive. We encourage internal mobility so you can explore different business areas, broaden your skillset, and expand your network. You’ll be working on high-profile, impactful projects that challenge your skills, expand your expertise, and allow you to both learn from mentors and guide others along the way.

If you require accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact Human Resources via .

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

At General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada, our focus extends beyond engineering technology solutions—we are dedicated to cultivating careers. If you seek a purpose-driven career solving some of the world’s most critical problems, alongside some of the brightest engineering minds, your application is welcome. Join a community where your unique perspective propels innovation.

raw.excerpt: For the curious writers and search obsessed. You know that feeling when you search for something and find an article that actually answers your question, no robotic filler, no keyword stuffing, just great taste and genuine utility?
raw.description:
For the curious writers and search obsessed.

You know that feeling when you search for something and find an article that actually answers your question, no robotic filler, no keyword stuffing, just great taste and genuine utility? That’s the exact energy we care about.

We’re looking for an Editorial Content Specialist who loves the sweet spot where storytelling meets search intelligence. Someone who crafts pieces creative pros actually want to read, while understanding how modern search and answer engines discover and surface that work.

A little about us

Envato is an all-in-one creative toolkit, bringing together world-class creative assets and purpose-built AI tools to help people make their ideas real.

Our community is made up of designers, filmmakers, editors and creators who care about craft, love experimenting and are always looking for the next tool, technique or spark of inspiration to make better work.

What’s the gig?

You’ll be creating and editing tutorials, guides, and articles that solve real problems for creative pros. You’ll be digging into search trends and AI search behaviours to find untapped content gaps, producing fresh pieces that rank in traditional search and get cited in AI answer overviews.

You’ll be using generative AI daily to speed up your ideation and drafting, always backing it up with your sharp editorial eye so everything sounds human, clear, and on-brand.

You’ll also be publishing directly in WordPress, curating visuals from Envato, optimising internal links, and checking performance data to iterate on what works best alongside our Search Visibility team and external contributors.

Sound like you?

You have 5+ years of experience in writing, content marketing, or editorial roles, ideally within creative tools or tech. You know organic search inside out and already understand how answer engine optimization (AEO) and AI summaries work.

Generative AI is a natural part of your daily creative workflow, you’re confident managing content in WordPress, and you communicate fluently in both English and Spanish. Most of all, you bring strong editorial judgement and take pride in work that real humans enjoy reading.

Show us what you’ve got

Send us 2–3 writing samples or live links you’re proud of that showcase your editorial tone, storytelling skills, and how you explain creative concepts clearly.

Life at Envato

We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.

Our benefits in Mexico include 30 days of Christmas bonus pay, 12 days of vacation in your first year, a 100% vacation bonus, monthly grocery vouchers, a 5% savings fund, private health insurance, home office, team connection & learning budgets, wellbeing and study support, volunteer leave, generous paid parental leave, access to all our products, the option to apply to work from another remote location for up to 3 months per year, plus our Conoce México benefit to help you explore more of Mexico.

A few things before you apply

We embrace diversity at Envato and want to ensure that everyone who applies for a role with us has an inclusive experience. Hiring for us isn't a tick box exercise, we want to know what you're passionate about, what our lived experiences are and what you think you can add to the team. We're also big believers in using AI, and that includes how we hire. We may use AI tools to help support our recruitment process, but they don't replace human judgement. Our people always make the final hiring decisions.

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy. We encourage you to read it before applying to understand how we collect, use and handle your personal information. We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

raw.title: Implementation Lead
raw.excerpt: Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces.
raw.description:
Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We’re looking for an Implementation Lead to perform a pivotal role in driving a customer and value proposition centric approach to implementing and configuring our investigative case management SaaS offerings.

In this role, you will be the main point of contact for our customers during the implementation process and you will oversee project management, product configuration, integration and migration requirements gathering/documentation, user training, and post-launch adoption tasks for some of our largest customers. You will become a product and investigative process expert and leverage that knowledge to plan and execute high quality customer onboardings to ensure successful delivery of value to our customers.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full implementation lifecycle from contract signing through go-live and early adoption for new and existing customers
  • Lead multiple concurrent implementation projects, maintaining clear timelines, milestones, and documentation
  • Gather and translate customer requirements into scalable configuration, integration, and migration solutions
  • Configure and support integrations (APIs, webhooks, batch data transfers) and oversee data migration processes
  • Develop deep expertise in our product and investigative workflows to guide customers toward best practices
  • Deliver engaging user training and enablement to drive successful adoption and long-term value
  • Act as a trusted advisor to customers, proactively identifying risks, challenges, and opportunities
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Support to resolve issues and improve delivery
  • Provide structured feedback on product gaps, contribute to requirements, and support testing of new features
  • Analyze implementation performance and customer outcomes, surfacing insights and improvement opportunities
  • Continuously refine implementation processes to increase efficiency, scalability, and customer impact
  • Maintain and promote high standards of security, confidentiality, and compliance while handling company systems, customer information, and internal processes.

What Success Looks Like

  • 45 days: Complete onboarding, role-specific training, and required security/compliance expectations. Build context on Case IQ's products, customers, systems, team processes, and role priorities.
  • 60 days: Shadow or support active customer implementations, learn delivery tools/templates, and begin owning defined workstreams with support.
  • 90 days: Manage implementation tasks or projects with increasing independence, clear customer communication, and accurate documentation
  • 6 months: Contribute to predictable delivery, cleaner handoffs, reduced rework, and improved customer readiness for launch or adoption.
  • 1 year: Serve as a trusted implementation partner who helps customers achieve successful launches and supports continuous improvement of delivery practices.

Who You Are

  • 2-3 years experience in implementation, project delivery, business analysis, customer onboarding, training, or a related customer-facing role.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to translate requirements into clear plans, workflows, documentation, or customer enablement materials.
  • Comfort managing timelines, risks, competing priorities, and customer expectations.
  • Solid understanding of data migrations and integration models (APIs, webhooks, batch processing)
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with strong stakeholder management abilities
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
  • Collaborative team player who can also operate independently
  • Growth-oriented mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement
  • Experience in a B2B SaaS, technology, professional services, GRC, compliance, HR, legal, investigations, or risk-related environment (an asset!)

Perks and Benefits

  • Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans 7 countries!)
  • Generous professional development budget
  • Benefits program through our Employer of Record.
  • Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through BambooHR (please check your junk mail).

Case IQ is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, color, gender, sex,

age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at .

raw.title: Lead Counsel, Commercial and Marketing, APAC and Americas
raw.excerpt: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential.
raw.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Reporting to the Principal Counsel, Director of Commercial and Healthcare this role will serve as Lead Counsel, Commercial & Marketing for APAC and the Americas and be a key member of Oura’s Legal Team. The role will partner closely with the APAC and US Commercial, Sales, Partnerships, Retail and Marketing teams, along with other cross-functional leaders, to support Oura as the company grows and scales internationally.The ideal candidate is a seasoned commercial lawyer with substantial in-house and law firm experience advising on and negotiating complex B2B sales, strategic partnerships, data and technology licensing, and retail and distribution arrangements across APAC. Beyond commercial transactions, the right candidate will have hands-on experience advising marketing teams on advertising, promotions and consumer-facing campaigns in Asia and ANZ, including markets with distinct regulatory regimes such as Singapore, Australia, Japan, South Korea and China. The successful candidate will bring strong judgment, credibility with senior stakeholders, and the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, actionable guidance in a fast-paced, evolving environment

What You Will Do:

  • Review, draft and negotiate complex commercial agreements as the lead lawyer supporting the APAC Commercial and Marketing functions, including enterprise and corporate sales agreements, B2B and channel partnerships, strategic alliances, co-marketing arrangements, and data sharing and licensing agreements.
  • Structure and negotiate retail, distribution, reseller, marketplace and e-commerce agreements across APAC markets.
  • Counsel and advise stakeholders on legal issues affecting APAC business, supporting alignment, efficiency and excellence in execution of commercial and marketing initiatives.
  • Serve as a strategic thinker who helps shape company-wide risk strategy while driving key initiatives and applying a solutions-focused approach.
  • Operate as a hands-on practitioner, comfortable managing high volumes of complex transactions.
  • Build and refine internal transactional and marketing review processes, templates, playbooks and tools that can scale efficiently with company growth.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior executives, providing clear, business-oriented judgment and actionable recommendations.
  • Coordinate with US Legal, Privacy, Product and outside counsel in key APAC jurisdictions to deliver consistent global positions adapted to local law, and manage outside counsel where local qualification is required.

This is a remote role based in the US.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years of combined law firm and in-house PQE, with at least 4 years supporting commercial transactions and marketing in a consumer products, consumer technology, digital health, or retail business.
  • Qualified and admitted to practice in at least one major common law jurisdiction (e.g. US (any state), Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia or New Zealand). Admission in a US state and/or an APAC jurisdiction is preferred. Experience working with local counsel in non-common-law markets in Asia is expected.
  • Working knowledge of competition law as it applies to distribution and retail arrangements across the US and APAC, including vertical agreements, selective distribution and resale price maintenance.
  • Deep working knowledge of US and APAC consumer protection, advertising and e-commerce frameworks, with the ability to apply them pragmatically to business objectives.
  • Exceptional drafting skills, with experience negotiating and preparing sophisticated sales, partnership, technology and data licensing, and distribution and retail agreements.
  • Familiarity with APAC and US privacy and data protection regimes as they apply to marketing, partnerships and data sharing, including structuring data use rights and restrictions in commercial agreements.
  • Proven ability to identify and mitigate legal and regulatory risk while enabling scalable, innovative go-to-market models across multiple markets.
  • Strong judgment and comfort operating as a trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.
  • Clear, practical communicator who can translate complex legal issues into actionable guidance.
  • Excels at working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with a track record of efficient business support.

Nice to have:

  • Fluency in an additional Asian language (e.g., Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Hindi) is a plus.

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

CrowdStrike’s Counter Adversary Operations (CAO) Elite is looking for a highly motivated, self-driven, detailed-oriented, and experienced Senior Analyst dedicated to making a difference in global security by protecting organizations against the most advanced attackers in the world.

In this role, you will leverage CrowdStrike CAO's extensive resources to provide advanced threat hunting expertise and intelligence analysis to safeguard our customers' environments. You will develop a trusted partnership by helping customers identify and operationalize timely, actionable, and relevant threat intelligence and threat hunt findings.

This position offers exceptional growth opportunities, blending technical mastery with strategic advisory services, all powered by CrowdStrike's world-class intelligence and hunting capabilities.

After a period of learning our custom-built tool suite, workflows, and methodologies you will join other CAO Elite Analysts protecting our customer's networks by performing tailored threat hunting and customer specific threat intelligence operations, including:


  • Executing sophisticated threat hunting operations
  • Providing high value, actionable, threat intelligence aligned to the customer's requirements using your expertise and knowledge of the threat landscape
  • Delivering high-impact briefings and recommendations spanning threat hunting, dark web, and intelligence information relevant to your customer
  • Responding to customers’ ad hoc requests for information and support
  • Building lasting partnerships with customers

As you grow in the role you will have opportunities to undertake research, improve our threat hunting service, develop specialized intelligence knowledge, and work with other CrowdStrike teams across a broad range of topics and projects.


Am I a CAO Elite Analyst?

  • Are you passionate about threat hunting, threat intelligence, and dark web monitoring?
  • Do you love working with customers and interacting with stakeholders from SOC analysts to CISOs?
  • Are you a skilled communicator who enjoys crafting and delivering targeted presentations?
  • Do you crave new and innovative work that leads the way?

What You’ll Do:

  • Maintain ownership of assigned customer accounts, facilitate high levels of customer satisfaction, and be a trusted advisor for CAO Elite customers
  • Perform threat hunting, research dark web data, and research tailored threat intelligence for CAO Elite customers based on their specific requirements and environment
  • Prepare and deliver customer presentations relating to intelligence reports, dark web alerts, and threat hunting findings on a regular basis
  • Respond to customer requests relating to threat intelligence, threat hunting, and dark web monitoring

What You’ll Need:

All candidates must possess the following qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in two (or more) of the following areas:
    • Incident response or security operations
    • Threat hunting
    • Cyber Threat intelligence
    • Dark web monitoring

  • Exemplary organizational skills with the ability to communicate both executive and detailed level findings to clients; ability to effectively communicate tasks, guidance, and methodology with internal teams.

  • Presentation Delivery: a background in presenting, briefing, and delivering reports to stakeholders ranging from individual contributors to executives.

  • Incident Handling: experience conducting threat hunting or managing incident response for organizations, investigating targeted threats such as the Advanced Persistent Threat, Organized Crime, and Hacktivists.

  • Intelligence Tradecraft: knowledge of cyber threat intelligence terminology and data communication concepts and technologies.

  • Ability to travel on short notice, up to 5% of the time.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Understanding of contemporary scripting languages
  • Familiarity with application programming interfaces (API)




Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.


CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. raw.description:
Senior Project Manager / Scrum Master – VR & Immersive Training

Location: Vancouver, BC preferred | Remote within Canada
Employment: Full-time, permanent
Salary: CAD $110,000–$130,000 annually
Company: Aequilibrium Software Inc.
Practice: Innovation | XR & AI
Program: VR4Health

About Aequilibrium

At Aequilibrium, our mission is to enrich lives by crafting remarkable experiences. We combine strategy, design, technology, and innovation to help organizations solve complex challenges and create meaningful impact. Our immersive technology practice develops virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and AI-powered experiences for enterprise learning, simulation, and digital transformation.

We're leading VR4Health, a three-year, funded, international R&D initiative exploring how AI-powered immersive experiences can transform healthcare education and professional training. We're looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager / Scrum Master to lead the day-to-day delivery of our VR4Health program and help us scale our immersive training capabilities.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on delivery leadership role at the intersection of immersive technology, AI, professional services, and healthcare education.

You'll work with a multidisciplinary team comprising a Product Owner, Technical Lead, Unity Developer, Full-Stack Developer, and Designer, alongside research partners, clinical subject-matter experts, and international collaborators. You'll ensure the team delivers high-quality, measurable outcomes through effective Agile execution, proactive risk management, and strong stakeholder coordination.

The ideal candidate has managed enterprise XR or real-time 3D projects, preferably within a professional services or consulting environment, and understands the complexities of delivering immersive training solutions. Experience with organizations such as Unity Professional Services, Capgemini Engineering, or comparable XR consulting and development teams would be particularly relevant.

Key Responsibilities

1. Agile Delivery & Scrum Leadership

  • Lead Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Partner with the Product Owner to translate product priorities and research objectives into actionable sprint plans and delivery milestones.

  • Maintain delivery plans, sprint commitments, dependencies, and release schedules.

  • Identify and resolve impediments while promoting team autonomy and accountability.

  • Track delivery metrics, including sprint predictability, throughput, quality, and milestone completion.

  • Adapt Agile practices to the realities of R&D, experimentation, and evolving technical requirements.

2. XR & Immersive Training Delivery

  • Coordinate the development and delivery of immersive training experiences using Unity and related technologies.

  • Manage workflows across Unity development, backend services, AI integrations, UX/UI design, testing, and deployment.

  • Coordinate scenario development, prototyping, user testing, and iterative improvements.

  • Understand XR-specific delivery challenges, including device compatibility, performance optimization, interaction design, and user experience.

  • Help establish repeatable processes for developing, testing, and deploying immersive training scenarios.

  • Ensure appropriate quality assurance, accessibility, usability, and performance standards.

3. VR4Health Program Coordination

  • Manage project plans, deliverables, milestones, risks, and dependencies across the VR4Health workstreams.

  • Coordinate with international consortium partners, academic institutions, healthcare professionals, and research collaborators.

  • Support the preparation of project reports, demonstrations, milestone reviews, and documentation required by research and funding partners.

  • Maintain traceability between research objectives, technical deliverables, and measurable outcomes.

  • Coordinate validation activities, including usability studies, pilot deployments, and learning effectiveness assessments.

  • Support planning and delivery of AI-powered training capabilities, including adaptive virtual patients, conversational AI, and personalized feedback.

4. Professional Services & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day delivery contact for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Manage scope, schedules, budgets, resource allocation, and delivery expectations.

  • Communicate project progress, risks, decisions, and dependencies clearly to leadership and partners.

  • Facilitate workshops, demonstrations, stakeholder reviews, and executive presentations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, reusability, and scalability.

  • Support proposals, estimates, statements of work, and planning for future XR engagements.

  • Balance client and partner expectations with team capacity, technical feasibility, and commercial objectives.

5. Continuous Improvement & Delivery Operations

  • Establish lightweight, scalable project management practices appropriate for a multidisciplinary innovation team.

  • Improve collaboration across product, engineering, design, QA, and research.

  • Maintain clear documentation, decision logs, and delivery reporting.

  • Support release readiness, acceptance criteria, defect management, and lessons learned.

  • Help build delivery capabilities that can support future immersive training clients and programs beyond VR4Health.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software project management, technical production, or program delivery, including substantial hands-on Agile/Scrum leadership.

  • 3+ years delivering XR, VR, AR, real-time 3D, simulation, or similarly complex interactive applications.

  • Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary teams involving software engineers, designers, technical artists, and product stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile delivery, backlog management, estimation, and release planning.

  • Experience delivering technology projects in a professional services, consulting, agency, or client-facing environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage project scope, budgets, timelines, risks, and stakeholder expectations.

  • Familiarity with Unity development workflows and the technical considerations of immersive applications.

  • Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or equivalent project management and collaboration tools.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with distributed teams and external partners.

  • Eligible to work full-time in Canada.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience developing or delivering VR training, enterprise simulation, immersive learning, or digital learning solutions.

  • Previous experience with Unity Professional Services, Capgemini Engineering, or another enterprise XR consulting organization.

  • Experience working with healthcare education, clinical simulation, medical training, or regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with instructional design, learning objectives, competency assessment, and measuring training effectiveness.

  • Experience coordinating AI/ML capabilities, conversational AI, virtual characters, or intelligent simulation systems.

  • Experience managing government-funded R&D initiatives, academic collaborations, or international research consortia.

  • Familiarity with Meta Quest, OpenXR, Unity XR Interaction Toolkit, or similar immersive technology ecosystems.

  • Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM), PMP, or equivalent credentials.

  • Experience supporting pre-sales activities, proposals, estimates, and client demonstrations.

Why Join Aequilibrium?

  • Meaningful impact: Help advance immersive healthcare training with the potential to improve professional readiness and patient care.

  • Innovative technology: Work at the intersection of VR, AI, simulation, and experiential learning.

  • International collaboration: Participate in a multi-year R&D initiative involving technology and research partners.

  • Ownership and autonomy: Play a central role in shaping how we develop and deliver our immersive training products.

  • Growth opportunity: Help establish scalable delivery capabilities for our expanding XR and AI practice.

  • Flexible work: Join a collaborative, remote-first Canadian technology company.

Compensation & Location

Annual base salary: CAD $110,000–$130,000, depending on qualifications and experience.

This is a full-time, permanent position open to candidates based in Canada, with a strong preference for Vancouver, British Columbia. Remote candidates elsewhere in Canada will be considered.

How to Apply

Please submit your résumé and cover letter with a brief description of one or two XR, simulation, or immersive training projects you've delivered. We'd particularly like to understand your role in managing multidisciplinary teams, your experience with Unity-based development, and how you've balanced Agile delivery with client expectations, technical complexity, and evolving requirements.

Join us in shaping the future of immersive healthcare training.

The Adjunct Faculty member delivers high-quality online instruction, fosters an engaging virtual learning environment, and supports student success in assigned courses. Responsibilities include synchronous and asynchronous teaching, timely feedback, academic advisement, guidance on research methodology, and active participation in program meetings and professional development. The role requires mastery of the subject area, proficiency with Microsoft Office suite and the institution’s Learning Management System (LMS), and a commitment to continual scholarly growth.

  • Attend scheduled training, curriculum reviews, and faculty meetings to align with program goals and regulatory standards.

  • Ability to provide effective, empathetic feedback.
  • Commitment to academic integrity and inclusive teaching practice.

Job Title: Tier 2 Helpdesk AnalystJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: NoneType of Travel: None* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking an experienced Service Desk (Helpdesk) Tier 2 Analyst to join our team supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs. Applicants must have prior work experience working on Momentum Financials. We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical skills and a desire to enhance those skills in a challenging, high visibility environment.


Responsibilities:


  • Provide advanced customer support in a production environment for Momentum Financials
  • Maintain and resolve a workload of tickets and communicate statuses and impediments within project tracking tools.
  • Analyze project documentation and test in non-production environments to provide complete resolutions to stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Facilitate meetings, workshops, and interviews with stakeholders to gather, validate, and review ticket issues.
  • Collaborate with government employees, developers, testers and Momentum SMEs to ensure requirements are clearly understood and implemented correctly.
  • Support system configuration, testing, validation activities, and execution support.
  • Experience supporting Momentum enhancements and defect tracking and fixes.
  • Perform impact analyses for proposed system changes, releases, and patches.
  • Utilize SQL queries for data extracts
  • Assist in troubleshooting Momentum production issues by analyzing system behavior, reviewing data, and coordinating with technical team to identify root causes and recommend solutions.
  • Ensure deliverables comply with project standards, governance processes, and documentation requirements.
  • Provide status updates, risks, and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Contribute to continuous process improvement and help identify opportunities to optimize Momentum functionality and reporting.
  • Maintain Knowledge Articles for Tier 1
  • Utilize Artificial Intelligence to streamline processes, improve communication and reduce costs

Qualifications:


Required:


  • US citizen with the ability to pass a Tier 2 MBI background investigation upon hire.
  • 5 years’ experience working with the Momentum Financials front-end and preferably database.
  • Minimum of 5 years supporting Momentum Financials implementations or operations.
  • Knowledge of federal financials processes such as General Ledger, Budgeting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and financial reporting.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and oral communication skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and with a team to solve problems.
  • Ability to eﬃciently and eﬀectively handle multiple and shifting priorities while meeting deadlines.
  • Flexibility to put in hours needed to meet tight deadlines.

Desired:


  • Experience working in a government environment.
  • Experience with Agile, SAFe, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or related field.
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$63,300-$129,700

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

raw.title: Senior Contract Associate
raw.excerpt: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals.
raw.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:


The Senior Contract Associate is responsible for drafting, negotiating, and finalizing complex Clinical Site Contracts related to clinical trials throughout the lifecycle of the study, with focus on the United Kingdom market. Performs timely and accurate data entry into all Clinical Business Operations operating systems, including but not limited to the company Contract Management System (CMS). The Contract Associate is also responsible for meeting deliverables with high quality and within the project timelines. The contracting activity supported by the CBO team is fast-paced, with short deadlines and quick turnaround times therefore Contract Associate must be capable of managing priorities effectively, proactively communicating issues and working in a fast-paced environment.


Essential Functions of the Job:


  • Prepare, negotiate, and finalize clinical trial agreements, ancillary agreements and amendments of company sponsored studies through direct communication with sites.
  • Responsible for execution of contracts against planned timelines and targets.
  • Manage budget grid in the contract. Ensure the cost calculation are consistent with protocol and agreed with site
  • Demonstrates an understanding of records management requirements for contract documents
  • Complete quality check (QC) of final approved contract and budget documents, and initiates signature process of assigned contracts to the responsible signing parties.
  • Ensure final contracts are delivered to agreed timelines, within Fair Market Value & in compliance with relevant legal and regulatory requirements
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between CBO and Global Clinical Operations (GCO), Legal,
  • Investigator Sites and external service providers in accordance with the study related activities to meet business needs;
  • Collect and maintain country and site intelligence information for each country and/or site, and prepares country/site specific contract process flows as needed;
  • Forecast, set, track and communicate fully executed contract planned dates, and make all efforts to achieve the set planned date, ensuring the CM and study teams are proactively informed of changes and/or risks to the projected dates;
  • Liaise with CM and BeOne Medicines legal to review and update contract template(s) as needed, including Master Clinical Trial Agreements/Clinical Trial Agreements/Project Agreements or any other Site agreement template(s);
  • Liaise with CM and BeOne Medicines legal to contribute updates to the BeOne Medicines Legal Playbook guidance document as needed;
  • Liaise with Clinical Site Budgets and Payment team to ensure site contracts, including investigator site budgets, are approved and executed in accordance with CBO guidelines and BeOne Medicines policies;
  • Ensure all investigator contracts are reviewed and approved by legal and/or delegate prior to execution, and in accordance with CBO and BeOne Medicines legal guidelines;
  • Communicate legal and budgetary issues to internal and external parties per department guidelines, as needed;
  • Perform legal translation of contract language for Sites, as needed;
  • Maintain active and regular communication with site personnel and internal BeOne Medicines partners, with regular progress tracking and updates provided throughout the contract lifecycle;
  • Prepare subsequent contract amendments, note to files and other related contract documents, as needed;
  • Escalates contracting issues and/or potential delays to internal and external stakeholders, as necessary;
  • Attend and actively participate in Investigator Site, project related, CBO, and other meetings, as necessary;
  • Update and maintain CBO trackers with real-time updates on a regular basis, complete CBO related filing and distribution of contract documents, and maintain Contract Management System (CMS) records, in accordance with CBO and BeOne Medicines policies;
  • Provides a handoff to the project/payment team upon execution of a site’s final contractual documents
  • Coordinate UK costing and contracting activities through NIHR Central Portfolio Management System (CPMS) and interactive Costing Tool (iCT), within delegated company representative access. Coordinate required service requests, accurate study identifiers and contacts, and corrections with authorised record owners.
  • With Budgets and Payments and study teams, quality-check protocol-based iCT resource requirements and coordinate National Contract Value Review (NCVR) submissions, lead-site queries and national sign-off tracking. Use current national escalation pathways rather than routine site-by-site renegotiation of nationally agreed resources or prices.
  • Ensure contracts include the approved iCT site-specific financial appendix and payment arrangements; reconcile protocol/costing versions, site legal entities and schedules, and coordinate revised costing approvals and contract amendments when required.
  • Prepare the current applicable UK model agreement, including mCTA or CRO-mCTA, without modification except as permitted by its guidance. Complete study/site particulars and escalate deviations or side agreements to the Contract Manager and Legal for any required formal waiver.
  • Liaise with NHS/HSC R&D and contracting teams, NIHR and devolved-nation contacts to resolve dependencies. Maintain costing/contract audit trails, reconcile assigned CPMS/iCT data with CMS/CTMS, and hand over payment terms. Distinguish execution from regulatory approval and sponsor green light; study-record ownership and recruitment reporting remain with designated teams unless expressly delegated.

Education Required:


  • Bachelor's degree with 3 or more years of contract/budget experience (legal or administrative management education background preferred) with evidence of increasing responsibility within a pharmaceutical company, CRO or relevant industry vendor or
  • Up to four (4) years in clinical operations, preferably within the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and/or CRO industry

Computer Skills:


  • Microsoft Office apps, CTMS, Contract Lifecycle Management System, Veeva, Jira, Sharepoint etc.
  • Practical proficiency in NIHR CPMS and the UK interactive Costing Tool (iCT), including authorised company representative access, submission tracking, costing version control and retrieval of site-specific financial appendices; ability to reconcile these records with internal contract and study-management systems.

Other Qualifications:


  • Good knowledge of ICH-GCP, pharmaceutical related regulations and laws;
  • Good understanding of clinical trial contracting process, and relevant clinical operation
  • practices;
  • Awareness and understanding of compliance and regulatory matters in clinical research
  • Proven negotiation, interpersonal and business skills
  • Strong planning and organizational skills and the ability to work independently and effectively in a dynamic environment with competing priorities
  • Sense of urgency and strong goal orientation; track-record of meeting deadlines and goals
  • Native-level written and verbal proficiency in English is required, together with strong written and verbal communication skills in English. In-depth knowledge of the UK clinical trial contracting market, including local contracting practices, is also required.
  • Proactive and positive team player. Able to maintain high performance during times of ambiguity and change in the work environment.
  • Experience in financial, budget, cost management/analysis, accounting, and/or financial planning skills are desirable
  • Has knowledge of Intellectual Property issues, Publication issues, Indemnification issues and other standard issues of site contracts within the clinical research area.
  • Must be willing to work in a fast-paced environment with time-sensitive material.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively at all levels of an organization.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting UK commercial clinical trial contracts with NHS/HSC organisations, with working knowledge of NCVR, protocol-based iCT costing, national review/sign-off requirements and the appropriate use of current unmodified UK model agreements. Ability to distinguish national costing requirements from permitted site-specific completion and to identify and escalate exceptions.
  • Working knowledge of UK research governance and contracting interfaces, including HRA/HCRW requirements and relevant arrangements in Scotland and Northern Ireland, UK data protection requirements and NHS/HSC institutional sign-off. Strong attention to protocol-to-budget consistency, document quality and audit trails; ability to coordinate across Contracts, Budgets and Payments, Legal and study teams, and keep CPMS/iCT and NCVR training current as national processes evolve.

Travel: Yes, 10%

Salary Range UK: 52,000.00 GBP - 65,000.00 GBP

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity, and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Title:Bids & Tenders Specialist UK & Nordics

Location: Remote, Europe

Languages: English and Swedish

The Bids & Tenders Specialist UK & Nordics will manage tenders, quotations, contracts, and pricing as well as other ad-hoc activities in UK and Scandinavia and potentially other regions in EMEA should there be a business need.

Under limited supervision, general direction and in accordance with all applicable government laws, regulation and ASP policies, procedures and guidelines, the Bids & Tenders Specialist UK & Nordics will:

  • Lead pre-tender monitoring activities, requirement assessment and liaise with Commercial, Legal, Marketing, Tax/Finance, HR, Quality, Regulatory and Compliance teams to gather required documentation to participate, work with Sales to develop pricing strategy, submit tenders and lead post-tender monitoring.
  • Cooperate with Commercial, Customer Service and Finance departments on Price Governance – this includes managing approvals for different type of deals as well contract compliance.
  • Show an understanding that B&T actions can directly impact SOX and engage in active collaboration towards it.
  • Manage Bids and Tender Tracking, Contracts, and Price reporting
  • Independently drive the development of tender responses in close cooperation with mainly the Commercial as well as other departments.
  • Ensure on-time approval of economic and technical proposals part of the tender packages.
  • Manage all relevant administrative documents.
  • Manage direct contact to customers to clarify tender questions and ad-hoc requests
  • Manage SalesForce & SAP systems to create quotes & execute customer-related actions
  • Manage continuous improvement of reporting tools and review processes.
  • Ensure accurate update of systems and data bases.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional departments to drive continuous improvement.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Certifications/Licenses, and Affiliations:

  • Fluency in English and Swedish. Other language skills are also a strong asset.
  • Strong experience with commercial departments (Sales, Marketing and Finance)

  • Knowledge of Customer Relationship Management tools, especially Salesforce and SAP

    Highly Valued:

  • Tender & Bid Management
  • Public Procurement & Compliance
  • Tender Portal Management
  • Contract & Commercial Review
  • Stakeholder Coordination
  • Project Management

  • Strong analytical and structured mindset

Here are a few examples of the traits we value for this role:

  • The ability to gather data, perform analysis, and clearly articulate conclusions and recommended strategy.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong sense of urgency.
  • Ability to thrive within environment of deadlines and pressure
  • Personal integrity and strong ethics are critical to success in this position
  • A strong work ethic and passion for commercial success.
  • Ability to establish and maintain trust internally with many departments and externally with customers.
  • Strong sense of teamwork and satisfaction with success of team.
  • Passion for Continuous Improvement.
  • Flexibility and willingness to support other regions if required
  • Be familiar with and able to thrive in a multinational and multicultural environment
  • Ability to work independently as well as remotely

The below salary ranges apply only to candidates who are located in Italy and employed under Italian local terms and conditions.

The salary range for this position is €38,600 - €64,400. This position is also eligible for bonus as part of the total compensation package.

Base pay offered may vary depending on various factors, including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other eligibility factors such as geographic location. Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

ASP is a leading global provider of innovative sterilization and disinfection solutions, and a pioneer of low-temperature hydrogen peroxide sterilization technology.ASP’s mission is to protect patients during their most critical moments. Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring an Associate Medical Director, Regulatory Management to join our Clinical Affairs team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

The Associate Medical Director, Regulatory Management provides strategic and operational leadership for provider clinical regulatory programs and credentialing operations. This role drives clinical policy guidance, ensures enterprise compliance with NCQA, CMS, state, and accreditation standards, and leads continuous process improvement. Partnering cross-functionally across Quality, Network Management, and Compliance, this leader optimizes provider onboarding to deliver a high-quality, compliant network that supports member access and organizational growth.

Work Location: This position is fully remote and open to candidates residing in the U.S., excluding Alaska; Delaware; Hawaii; Louisiana; Montana; North Dakota; Oklahoma; West Virginia; Wyoming; and U.S. Territories. Daily work is completed from your home office, with occasional travel required for team meetings and company events.

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $216,108 - $283,642 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and lead the Clinical Policy Compliance team and the Clinical Coding Center of Excellence, driving high-impact compliance, quality, and regulatory strategy across the organization.
  • Direct the development of clinical regulatory policies, Benefit Interpretation Policies (BIPs), and operational SOPs to ensure full alignment with state and federal laws, in partnership with other SMEs in the Office of Clinical Affairs.
  • Chair the Credentialing, Peer Review, and Population Health Management sub-committee, driving individual case reviews and reporting key performance metrics to quarterly Quality Improvement meetings.
  • Oversee practitioner and facility credentialing to guarantee compliance with NCQA standards, CMS requirements, and state regulations - verifying licenses, board certifications, and sanction histories.
  • Partner with Network and Market Management executives to accelerate provider onboarding and strategically resolve network gaps while maintaining strict credentialing integrity.
  • Collaborate on Quality Improvement for Clinical Review Operations, optimizing Inter-Rater Reliability (IRR) processes, clinical delegate audits, and Potential Quality Issue (PQI) workflows.
  • Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks to streamline processes, eliminate delays, and enhance member and provider satisfaction without compromising quality or compliance.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on state and federal healthcare regulations, continuously monitoring legal developments and translating regulatory changes into proactive operational updates to maintain ongoing compliance.
  • Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of progressive healthcare experience, including leadership responsibility.
  • 3+ years experience managing provider credentialing within a health plan, managed care organization, or large healthcare system.
  • 3+ years knowledge of NCQA credentialing standards, CMS health plan regulatory requirements, and applicable federal and state regulations.
  • 1+ years experience managing and working with clinical coding taxonomies.
  • Demonstrated experience leading operational improvement initiatives and managing cross-functional partnerships.
  • Strong knowledge of provider data management, credentialing systems, and primary source verification processes.
  • Proven ability to lead teams, manage competing priorities, and lead measurable operational results.
  • Education:
    • MD or DO with a current unrestricted license to practice medicine is required.
    License and Certification:
    • Reviewers must maintain necessary credentials to retain the position including maintaining active board certification.
    • Willing to obtain additional state licensure (with Oscar's support).

Bonus points:

  • Licensure in multiple Oscar states.
  • Masters degree or advanced certificate.
  • Prior experience with Utilization management.

This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity.

At Oscar, being an Equal Opportunity Employer means more than upholding discrimination-free hiring practices. It means that we cultivate an environment where people can be their most authentic selves and find both belonging and support. We're on a mission to change health care -- an experience made whole by our unique backgrounds and perspectives.
