OpenWorks is a national facilities services company with more than 40 years of experience helping multi-location businesses create cleaner, healthier, and more efficient workplaces.

We're a people-first organization that believes our success starts with our employees. By investing in our team, embracing continuous improvement, and building strong partnerships with customers and franchise owners, we're creating innovative solutions that drive lasting results.

About the Role

The Major Account Executive is a high-impact, full-cycle sales role responsible for driving new customer revenue through strategic prospecting and disciplined execution. This is a true hunter position, focused on landing and growing mid-market, multi-site, and national accounts across OpenWorks’ core industries, including Medical, Education, Logistics, Manufacturing, and other recession-resistant verticals.

In this role, you will own the entire sales process, from outbound prospecting and discovery through proposal development, negotiation, and close while partnering closely with internal teams to ensure long-term client success. Success requires strong prospecting skills, comfort engaging senior decision-makers, experience navigating RFP and procurement processes, and the ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full national sales cycle, from prospecting through close, within OpenWorks’ ideal customer profile
  • Drive both new logo acquisition and expansion within existing national accounts (land-and-expand model)
  • Use the OpenWorks “OW Way” – a consultative, customer-first sales approach – to uncover needs and deliver tailored facility service solutions
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes, including discovery, solution design, pricing, proposals, and contract negotiation
  • Build and execute account strategies to engage decision-makers from VP to C-suite
  • Develop customized proposals and deliver compelling virtual and in-person presentations
  • Partner closely with Operations, Strategic, and Pricing teams to deliver accurate, competitive solutions
  • Ensure smooth handoff of new clients to Operations after close
  • Share best practices, insights, and market feedback to continuously improve our sales organization

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience, including national or enterprise-level selling
  • 3+ years of experience selling services across multi-state or multi-region territories
  • Proven success as a full-cycle hunter, consistently achieving $2M–$6M+ in annual revenue
  • Strong experience selling in competitive, outbound-focused (“cold”) markets
  • Proven experience using HubSpot (or comparable CRM) to manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and drive deal strategy
  • Strong ability to leverage sales technology, automation, and AI-powered tools to improve efficiency, insight, and performance
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional and strategic partner teams
  • Track record of building trusted relationships with senior leaders and executives
  • High personal accountability, strong work ethic, and a growth-oriented mindset

raw.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.


We are looking for a Account Executive to focus on our BrioStack Pest Control and Lawn Care Workforce Automation SoftwarePlatform. Briostack is a rapidly scaling SaaS solution servicing the pest control industry as part of EverCommerce’s EverPro vertical. Our solution is purpose built for the needs of pest control and lawn companies including CRM, scheduling, route optimization, and billing and collection. Our goal is to build software so good that no one can offer a close substitute, and we are building a world-class team to help us grow / scale our capabilities.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop relationships and sales opportunities with medium to enterprise level companies within the pest control and lawn industries
  • Work with a team of AE’s and BDR’s to increase market share in your assigned territory
  • Exceed assigned sales quotas/objectives and build new revenue through the expansion and growth of business relationships with new customers
  • Work with customers to understand and identify their strategic vision and objectives and align our products and services where opportunities exist
  • Perform sales presentations/demonstrations to match solutions with identified needs
  • Accurately forecast quarterly and monthly sales by possessing a full understanding of customers’ specific decision-making and purchasing process
  • Expedite the sales cycle by demonstrating superior knowledge of Briostack solutions
  • Develop and manage pipeline activity and monitor sales activity against assigned quotas
  • Acquire and integrate industry knowledge related to general trends, emerging technologies, and competitors

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • Minimum of 3-5 years sales experience (SaaS) preferred). Pest Control Industry knowledge is a bonus
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or equivalent experience and education
  • Proven “hunter" background with a track record of continually exceeding quota targets
  • Experience building a sales pipeline and positioning business to close. Attention to detail
  • Strong analytical skills that enable the development of complete sales cycle.
  • Consultative, solution experience selling software products
  • Independent thinker, with good judgment skills and proven track record in problem solving
  • Excellent presentation skills, business writing skills and oral communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fluid/changing marketplace

Where:

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K. New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States, with a preference to the Northeast – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, this role will require some travel to our headquarters in Lehi, Utah, and various sales and trade show events.


Benefits and Perks:

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits package, including an annual wellness stipend.
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

Compensation: The total compensation (base + commissions) for this position is $110,000 to $135,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!


EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

This attorney will support the company’s global operations and procurement functions, which include negotiating vendor and technology agreements, master purchase agreements, SaaS, software licenses, and other commercial, technology, and operational contracts. This attorney will have at least seven years of experience negotiating and drafting commercial contracts.

    • Drafting and negotiating various vendor and procurement agreements including technology agreements, software licenses, SaaS and other business tooling agreements, enterprise system and platforms, marketing and event agreements, facilities-related agreements, professional services agreements, and AI tools.

    • Developing and refining procurement processes, standard terms, templates, and playbooks to support a high-volume contracting environment.

The Ideal Candidate

    • JD with at least one state bar membership and eligible to practice in your state of residence.
    • Have at least seven (7) years of experience with drafting and negotiating commercial transactions. Experience supporting procurement agreements is preferred.
    • Strong work ethic and self-starter, with a growth mindset.

raw.description:
About Virginia Septic

Virginia Septic has served the greater Washington, D.C. region since 2010 and now covers all of mid-Atlantic Virginia from offices in Fairfax and Marshall. As a sister company of Soils Inc., we handle everything from septic inspections and installation to pumping, maintenance, repair and emergency service. We're a fully licensed team built on responsive service, technical expertise, and integrity, and we invest in training our people so they can grow with us. If you want hands-on work that keeps homes and communities running, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

The Dispatch Lead is a working lead who leads from the front. This role runs the daily dispatch operation, leads and develops the dispatch team, and owns the numbers that show whether we're winning: jobs completed, response times, go-backs, and overtime. The Dispatch Lead performs all core dispatching duties in Service Titan, sets daily scheduling priorities, coaches dispatchers, and serves as the first point of escalation for dispatchers, field staff, and customers. As the team grows, the Dispatch Lead will take on full oversight of all dispatchers, reporting directly to the Sr. Director of Operations.

We're looking for someone who has done this before: led a dispatch or logistics team, made routing and scheduling measurably more efficient (including with AI and other technology tools), and brought down overtime and related costs. If you see a busy schedule as a puzzle to solve and you're energized by a challenge, we want to talk to you.

To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: Virginia, Maryland, West Virginia, Tennessee, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Georgia, Kentucky, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, North Carolina, South Carolina, Vermont, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Jersey, New Hampshire, Michigan

What You'll Do

Perform all duties of a Dispatcher, in addition to the following duties:

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and hold the dispatch team accountable to clear daily standards
  • Set daily dispatch priorities and balance workload across the dispatch team
  • Train new dispatchers on company procedures, Service Titan, and dispatch standards
  • Give regular, direct feedback; address performance issues early and constructively
  • Assume full oversight of all dispatchers as the team grows, including schedules, coverage, and performance support

Efficiency & Cost Control

  • Build daily routes that maximize jobs per truck and minimize drive time, idle time, and overtime
  • Use AI-powered routing, scheduling, and optimization tools to improve route efficiency, and evaluate new technology that can help the team do more with less
  • Monitor overtime daily and adjust schedules proactively to keep labor costs on target
  • Find and eliminate root causes of go backs, missed appointments, and wasted trips
  • Recommend process, routing, and Service Titan improvements to the Sr. Director of Operations and assist with leading their rollout

KPI Ownership & Reporting

  • Own the dispatch scorecard: jobs completed, go back rate, response times, schedule changes, and overtime hours
  • Prepare daily and weekly dispatch reports with clear commentary on trends, misses, and actions taken
  • Set targets with the Sr. Director of Operations and report progress against them
  • Ensure all dispatchers maintain accurate logs of calls, routes, and service details in line with company policies and regulations

Scheduling & Coordination

  • Oversee the daily field schedule and ensure routes are assigned based on priority, location, and availability
  • Coordinate inspections with Install Companies and resolve scheduling conflicts
  • Monitor vehicle locations and service progress in real time
  • Review jobs from the previous day and ensure incomplete jobs and go backs are rescheduled
  • Ensure dispatch coverage during business hours, after hours, and emergencies

Escalations & Problem-Solving

  • Serve as the first point of escalation for dispatchers, field staff, and customers on scheduling issues
  • Respond quickly to emergencies, delays, or service disruptions and re-route drivers when necessary
  • Resolve escalated scheduling conflicts and customer complaints professionally

Communication & Customer Service

  • Maintain constant communication with field staff and dispatchers via phone or Service Titan
  • Communicate schedule changes, priorities, and process updates to the dispatch team
  • Serve as the link between dispatch, field staff, customer service, and the Sr. Director of Operations
  • Answer incoming calls, confirm service appointments, and model a professional and courteous demeanor for the dispatch team at all times
Who We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent (Associate's degree preferred)
  • 5+ years of experience in dispatching, logistics, transportation, or field service operations; dispatch experience in a home services, maintenance, or trades related field preferred
  • 3+ years directly leading a team (supervisor, lead, or manager) in dispatching, logistics, transportation, or a similar environment
  • Proven track record of improving dispatch or routing efficiency, with measurable results (e.g., more jobs per day, faster response times, fewer go backs)
  • Demonstrated success reducing overtime or similar operating costs, with specific examples and numbers
  • Experience owning and reporting on operational KPIs and being accountable for hitting targets
  • Strong overall technology proficiency; quick to learn and adopt new software and systems
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools, particularly for AI route optimization, scheduling, or forecasting, to increase route efficiency
  • Advanced proficiency with Service Titan, GPS/fleet tracking systems, and Microsoft Office (especially Excel)
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and verbal/written communication skills

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of local geography and traffic patterns
  • Ability to work under pressure and make calm, decisive calls during emergencies
  • Working knowledge of DOT or industry regulations
  • Familiarity with septic or other field service operations
  • Experience building or improving dispatch processes in a growing company
You'll Thrive Here If You...
  • Take ownership of results instead of waiting to be told what to fix
  • Are energized by tough problems and bring calm, steady focus when priorities shift
  • Raise the standard for your team and lead by example
  • Let the numbers guide your decisions
What We Offer
  • Competitive pay
  • Opportunities for learning & career development
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance + 401k options
  • Paid time off

This is an exciting opportunity for candidates who want to grow a stronger understanding of a brand’s marketing mix and manage a team. Working side by side with the design team and copy team, the main objective of this role is to help improve and optimize customer life cycles and help our clients grow profitably.

Responsibilities

  • Manage email production process end-to-end through ideation handoff to design, email build and scheduling, segmentation, and deployment

Homestead Studio is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. We strongly encourage applicants to answer questions in their own words. While tools like ChatGPT can be helpful for organizing or polishing your thoughts, it is very easy to recognize when responses are copied and pasted without personalization. raw.description:
Standard Job Description

The Cyber Systems Security Engineer Principal will serve as the senior cybersecurity technical authority for the UAE Cybersecurity Center of Excellence. The role will define and govern secure architectures, engineering practices, accreditation strategies, and technical integration across a complex, multi-partner, five-year program. Working with program leadership, UAE stakeholders, and local and international delivery partners, this position will ensure the Center's platforms, services, and operating model are secure, resilient, compliant, interoperable, scalable, and ready for sustainable UAE ownership.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the principal cybersecurity engineering advisor and technical authority for architecture, systems security engineering, risk management, accreditation, integration, and technical readiness.
  • Develop and maintain the program's cybersecurity engineering strategy, reference architectures, security design principles, technical standards, engineering governance, and system security lifecycle processes.
  • Translate UAE policy, mission needs, contractual obligations, data-sovereignty requirements, and recognized cybersecurity frameworks into requirements, controls, architecture decisions, verification methods, and operating procedures.
  • Lead secure architecture and engineering across the National Maturity Dashboard, Learning Experience Platform, readiness and reporting capabilities, innovation platforms, audit services, threat intelligence, and future sectoral SOC capabilities.
  • Apply systems security engineering throughout requirements analysis, architecture development, design reviews, implementation, integration, testing, deployment, sustainment, and Build-Operate-Transfer activities.
  • Establish and guide risk-management and accreditation approaches aligned with applicable UAE requirements, NIST RMF, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-series guidance, and ISO/IEC 27001.
  • Lead threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, control allocation, security trade studies, vulnerability analysis, and technical risk assessments for cloud, enterprise IT, OT/ICS, data, and interconnected platform environments.
  • Define secure integration patterns for identity and access management, role-based access, encryption, logging and monitoring, APIs, data exchange, privacy, data residency, configuration management, and third-party connections.
  • Advise on SOC design and modernization, threat intelligence, SIEM/SOAR integration, incident response, cyber-physical security, and operational resilience for government, defense, and critical-infrastructure use cases.
  • Lead technical interchange meetings, architecture reviews, cybersecurity working groups, design and readiness reviews, control reviews, test-readiness reviews, and executive technical briefings.
  • Evaluate partner designs and deliverables for technical adequacy, security, interoperability, compliance, scalability, and alignment with the Center's target operating model.
  • Identify and resolve critical cross-pillar technical issues and dependencies; develop recovery and corrective-action plans for architecture, integration, accreditation, cybersecurity, and delivery challenges.
  • Develop technical roadmaps supporting capability maturity, platform convergence, emerging technology adoption, commercialization opportunities, and evolution of the UAE cybersecurity ecosystem.
  • Mentor engineers, architects, analysts, and UAE counterparts; establish playbooks, reusable patterns, training, and knowledge-transfer mechanisms that enable independent local operations.
  • Represent the program with senior government, defense, industry, academic, and technology stakeholders and support capture, proposals, solution development, and program expansion.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, systems engineering, engineering, or a related discipline, with extensive relevant cybersecurity and systems-engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a senior cybersecurity engineer, architect, technical fellow, chief engineer, CTO, CISO, or equivalent technical authority for complex government, defense, intelligence, critical-infrastructure, or commercial programs.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity architecture, systems security engineering, governance, risk management, accreditation, security operations, and enterprise technology modernization.
  • Experience developing secure system and enterprise architectures across complex, interconnected environments that may include on-premises systems, hybrid cloud, software platforms, networks, data services, and cyber-physical or operational technology.
  • Demonstrated experience applying NIST RMF and NIST SP 800-series controls or equivalent risk and accreditation methods to obtain or maintain authorization in complex or high-risk environments.
  • Experience designing, implementing, modernizing, or governing Security Operations Centers and associated monitoring, threat intelligence, incident response, SIEM, SOAR, and resilience capabilities.
  • Experience with cybersecurity control frameworks and regulatory or contractual requirements such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-171, ISO/IEC 27001, DFARS, ITAR, EAR, SOX, PCI-DSS, or comparable standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate policy, mission, regulatory, contractual, and customer requirements into secure architectures, engineering requirements, implementation plans, verification evidence, and operational controls.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary and matrixed teams of cybersecurity engineers, architects, IT professionals, software or platform teams, operations personnel, and external partners.
  • Experience identifying and resolving unusually complex and sensitive technical issues, developing executable courses of action, and advising senior or executive leadership on cybersecurity risk and investment decisions.
  • Strong understanding of identity and access management, network security, cloud security, data protection, secure interfaces, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management, configuration management, and incident response.
  • Demonstrated experience leading architecture reviews, security design reviews, technical risk assessments, accreditation activities, technical recovery efforts, or major modernization initiatives.
  • Strong executive communication, facilitation, and technical writing skills, including the ability to communicate complex engineering and cyber-risk issues to government, business, and technical audiences.
  • Experience working across international organizations, partners, regulatory environments, or data-sovereignty requirements and collaborating effectively across cultures and time zones.
  • Ability and willingness to work in or travel regularly to the UAE and support in-country customer, partner, engineering, and program activities.
  • Ability to satisfy applicable security-clearance, export-control, information-handling, and customer-access requirements for a defense-related international program.

Desired Skills

  • Advanced degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, technology management, systems engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Current professional certifications such as CISSP, CCISO, CEH, CND, GIAC, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, or comparable cybersecurity and architecture credentials.
  • Current or recent U.S. Top Secret clearance, SCI eligibility, or experience supporting highly classified and sensitive missions.
  • Prior experience as a technical fellow, distinguished engineer, chief cyber engineer, enterprise architect, CIO, CTO, deputy CISO, or equivalent senior technical leader.
  • Experience working with UAE or GCC government, defense, cybersecurity, critical-infrastructure, academic, or commercial stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of UAE cybersecurity governance, data-protection, data-sovereignty, critical-infrastructure, cloud, accreditation, and entity-assurance requirements.
  • Experience with international frameworks and requirements such as Australia's Essential Eight, UK cybersecurity practices, cross-border data residency, or multinational technology and trade compliance.
  • Experience leading Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, secure cloud, hybrid-cloud, zero-trust, or enterprise digital-transformation initiatives.
  • Experience with cybersecurity maturity dashboards, readiness platforms, audit and accreditation programs, entity assessments, professional competency assessments, or national-level cyber metrics.
  • Experience with OT/ICS security, cyber-physical systems, critical-infrastructure protection, bio-cybersecurity, or other specialized mission environments.
  • Experience recovering complex programs, conducting return-to-green assessments, rebuilding customer confidence, and aligning leadership, people, process, technology, and delivery.
  • Experience managing large cybersecurity portfolios, R&D investments, technology roadmaps, budgets, and geographically distributed technical organizations.
  • Demonstrated contribution to business growth through technical capture, proposals, solution development, customer shaping, innovation, or commercialization of cybersecurity capabilities.
  • Experience developing cybersecurity professionals through mentoring, formal instruction, curriculum development, research, publications, or university engagement.
  • Experience supporting executive, board, national-security, law-enforcement, or high-visibility government stakeholders in sensitive operational environments.

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $228100.00 - $423700.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $205300.00 - $381300.00

raw.excerpt: Growth Stage Controller: Build the Future of Finance at 2-5 Hypergrowth Companies Embedded Teams + AI-Enabled Intelligence In 24 months, you'll gain experience that would take 5-7 years in a single-company role.
raw.description:
Growth Stage Controller: Build the Future of Finance at 2-5 Hypergrowth Companies

Embedded Teams + AI-Enabled Intelligence

In 24 months, you'll gain experience that would take 5-7 years in a single-company role. You'll serve as Controller for 2-5 Series B-C companies simultaneously—each with $20M-$200M+ in revenue, complex operations, and boards that demand excellence. You'll have the stability, resources and infrastructure of a 17 year old, 250-person firm and you'll receive training in AI-enabled financial intelligence that doesn't exist anywhere else.

This is foundational work—and it's the future.

Who We Are


Nearly 17 years ago, we set out to find a better way to help the country's leading startups navigate the financial hazards that follow their first institutional funding.

Today, Propeller's 250+ full-time professionals across three continents serve as the embedded finance and accounting partner to some of the most iconic emerging companies in Consumer, Technology, Blockchain, and Business Services.

Our embedded teams integrate seamlessly into client operations in multi-year partnerships. You'll attend weekly leadership meetings, participate in board prep, collaborate on strategic decisions, and have direct access to client CEOs and CFOs. This embedded positioning creates trust, access and influence that traditional providers never achieve.

With our Financial Operating Platform—combining human judgment, precise accounting, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled insight—we transform finance from a back-office function into the central nervous system of growth.

What You Get

Accelerated Learning Curve

  • Experience 2-5 business models, GTM strategies, and leadership styles simultaneously
  • Navigate wins and lessons-learned across multiple companies and multiple stages
  • Index clients against Propeller’s stage-specific benchmarks to develop context for your instincts

Executive Exposure That Defines Careers

  • Regular interaction with Series B and C CFOs, CEOs, and stakeholders
  • Present financials and strategic recommendations to sophisticated audiences
  • Build relationships that become your professional network for life

AI-Enabled Financial Intelligence Training

  • Hands-on experience with Propeller's Intelligence Engine (PIE) and Data Lake (PDL)
  • Learn to leverage systems and automation that transforms patterns into predictions
  • Prepare for the future of finance while others react to it

Stability + Variety

  • 17-year-old firm with strong balance sheet, 250 people and competitive compensation
  • None of the startup risk, all of the upside learning
  • Infrastructure and support that solo controllers rarely have

Career Optionality

  • Propeller alumni have gone on to earn CFO and controller roles at multiple unicorns and nine-figure companies—this role is a launchpad, not a landing pad

This Role Requires


Let's be direct about what it takes to succeed here:

Extreme Process Orientation


You'll juggle 2-5 clients with different fiscal calendars, reporting requirements, board schedules, and growth stages. Without systematic thinking and disciplined execution, you'll drown. If you prefer improvisation over process, this isn't your role.

Coachability Over Ego


You'll receive direct feedback frequently from senior controllers, CFO partners, and clients. Your ability to implement it quickly determines your success. If you need to be right more than you need to get better, this isn't your role.

Team Player Mentality


No lone wolves. You're building systems that outlive any individual engagement. Your insights become institutional knowledge. Your workflows help the next controller scale faster. If you hoard knowledge or prefer solo work, this isn't your role.

Comfort with Intensity


Month-end close means 2-5 companies close simultaneously. Series B CFOs and boards expect precision, timeliness, and strategic perspective. If you prefer predictable 9-5 rhythms, this isn't your role.

Appetite for Continuous Learning


Every client teaches something new. Technology platforms evolve. AI tools advance almost daily. Industry dynamics shift. If you prefer mastery through repetition over growth through challenge, this isn't your role.

Role Overview


The Controller at Propeller builds systems that turn financial data into strategic foresight. You'll lead engagement teams to deliver month-end closes with excellence while transforming traditional controller work—historically reactive and backward-looking—into a proactive, AI-enabled function that surfaces insights before problems arise.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Oversee engagement teams across U.S. and international personnel, delegating work to maximize efficiency
  • Mentor and develop team members, actively supporting professional growth
  • Manage utilization and client load to ensure team members are challenged, supported, and operating at optimal capacity
  • Codify and share best practices, contributing to Propeller's institutional knowledge and platform intelligence

P&L Management & Growth

  • Optimize margins and business unit efficiency, recognizing that Propeller's economics shift from hours billed to value delivered
  • Proactively engage in Early Warning processes to surface issues before they escalate
  • Support client pipeline development in collaboration with Business Development, CFO team, and Customer Experience
  • Identify upsell and lifecycle extension opportunities by understanding client needs and demonstrating incremental value

Quality Control & System Intelligence

  • Partner with Customer Success to ensure deliverables meet Propeller's standards and drive client satisfaction
  • Conduct periodic client file reviews to identify learning opportunities, develop best practices, and feed insights back into the platform
  • Document workflows and surface repeatable intelligence that can be systematized through PropellerOS

Client Engagement & Strategic Partnership

  • Drive high client satisfaction by delivering not just accurate financials, but timely, actionable insights
  • Transform the monthly close call from backward-looking reporting into strategic financial review powered by analytics and CFO perspective
  • Develop scope and service offerings for potential Growth Stage clients
  • Participate in all phases of the client conversion cycle: scoping, pitch, and SOW development
  • Act as a strategic partner to executive teams, helping them navigate financial and operational complexity

Required Experience

Must Haves

  • Master's Degree or CPA required
  • 7+ years in accounting/finance with at least 3 years at companies or serving clients in the $10M-$100M revenue range
  • Multi-client or consulting background strongly preferred (Big 4, boutique accounting firm, fractional CFO services, or similar)
  • Demonstrated ability to build processes from scratch—not just follow them
  • Cross-functional experience developing processes around financial reporting and operational workflows
  • Previous experience with Series B and Series C companies
  • Strong understanding of how operational and business changes impact financial reporting
  • Experience with investor diligence and audit preparedness
  • Quickbooks

Industry Expertise


Consumer:
  • In-depth understanding of inventory flow and cost accounting
  • Experience with DTC and wholesale channels
  • Strong knowledge of ASC 606 and revenue recognition
  • Familiarity with sales tax implications and obligations
  • Ability to distinguish between COGS and Opex

Enterprise/Technology:
  • Experience with revenue waterfalls and deferred revenue
  • Solid understanding of ASC 606 and revenue recognition
  • Familiarity with sales tax obligations
  • Ability to identify capitalizable costs and correctly allocate to COGS or Opex

Critical Mindsets

  • Systems thinking: ability to see patterns, codify intelligence, and contribute to scalable, repeatable processes
  • Comfort with ambiguity and change: Propeller is building the future of professional services, and this role requires adaptability, curiosity, and willingness to pioneer new approaches
  • Technical aptitude: experience with modern tools like Claude Code, Databricks, Looker, N8N, or similar platforms

Job Title: Controller, Growth Stage

Reports To: Senior Controller, Growth Stage

Location: Remote-flexible with occasional travel

DEI Statement: At Propeller Industries, we encourage our employees and our clients to bring their true selves to the organization. We believe that a diverse team enables us to cultivate and improve upon our culture of inclusion and collaboration. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome the contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran’s status, religion, disability, sexual orientation, and beliefs. So however you identify and whatever your background, we encourage you to apply for this role if you share our passion for helping great entrepreneurs build great companies. We look forward to meeting you!

Salary range: $140,000 - $160,000 plus bonus, benefits and 401k match

Current Benefits Offered: Generous Paid Time Off and Holiday pay, Comprehensive health benefits plus dental, vision, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. HSA contribution, Paid Family Leave, 401k match and Remote Work. We also help you grow in your professional life.

Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead our Copilot team. Copilot is our AI-powered platform for clinical operations: it drafts responses, routes member messages, and flags issues so care teams spend less time on administrative work and more time with members.

This is a hands-on management role. You will own the team, the delivery, and the outcomes. You'll stay close enough to the code and architecture to make good technical calls, but your main job is building a team that ships reliable AI-powered products in a regulated healthcare environment.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, hire, and grow a team of full-stack engineers. Run 1:1s, set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and invest in each engineer's development and career growth.
  • Own delivery for Copilot end-to-end: planning, sequencing, dependencies, and getting work into production on time.
  • Partner with Product and Clinical Operations to set priorities, make tradeoffs, and guide the roadmap toward high user impact and service quality, using business impact data and platform health metrics to drive prioritization.
  • Set and enforce a high engineering bar, from system architecture that scales with growth down to rigorous design reviews, comprehensive automated testing, and production-grade observability.
  • Champion AI-assisted engineering practices to increase the team's impact, velocity, and quality.
  • Partner with the team on architecture and design decisions, empowering engineers to own the call while offering guidance where it adds the most value.
  • Coordinate with the AI Platform team and other engineering teams on shared infrastructure and integrations.
  • Communicate status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to engineering, product, clinical, and executive audiences.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years directly managing engineers (hiring, performance management, and career development).
  • Track record of leading a team through end-to-end delivery of customer-facing products, from definition through launch, measurement, and iteration.
  • Strong hands-on backend foundation, including microservices, API design, SQL databases, and event-driven architectures, with the credibility to lead design reviews and guide technical decisions. Python and FastAPI experience is a strong plus.
  • Experience architecting and operating production systems at scale: observability, incident management, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Clinical Operations, and business stakeholders, including roadmap governance and prioritization in a high-demand environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical risk to non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, growth-stage environment where priorities shift.
  • Experience shipping LLM agents or AI-powered products in production is a plus.
  • Experience building products in healthcare or other regulated industries is a plus.
  • Familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines is a plus.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $200,000 - $220,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

  • A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies

Join a talented, fast-growing team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems in sales performance management.

About the Role

    CaptivateIQ's Professional Services team partners with customers after the deal closes to bring their sales compensation programs to life inside CaptivateIQ — from business requirements and comp plan design through data structure, build-out, UAT, and go-live, before handing off to Customer Success.

    We're hiring a Senior Professional Services Consultant to join a growing team leading these implementations end-to-end. This is a client-facing role: you'll move fluidly between customer meetings and hands-on build work, owning the project timeline while managing customer expectations along the way. It's a strong fit for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving complex compensation problems, and wants the pace and ownership of a fast-moving, startup environment.

  • Lead full-cycle CaptivateIQ implementations for customers — from business requirements documentation and comp plan design through data structure, build-out, configuration, UAT, and go-live.

  • Design system configurations that maximize modeling efficiency and repeatability for each customer's comp plan.

  • Own project timelines, prioritizing your own work and setting expectations with customers and internal stakeholders across multiple concurrent implementations.

  • Serve as the primary client-facing point of contact throughout the implementation, building trust with customer admin teams.

  • Scope new implementation or post-implementation services and support related negotiations as needed.

  • Lead the handoff to Customer Success at go-live, ensuring a clean transition across cross-functional teams.

  • Become an expert in CaptivateIQ and in sales commission structures, applying best-practice calculation design across a range of plan types.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Customer Success Managers, and Sales throughout the engagement.

  • Proactively identify and escalate project or account risks before they impact the customer or the timeline.

  • Proactively define and adopt team best practices that raise the bar for delivery quality.

What You'll Bring

  • Background in sales compensation — as a consultant, or as an administrator/practitioner using a comp tool in-house.

  • 6+ years of experience as a consultant or implementation professional, with demonstrated project leadership (managing other consultants is not required).

  • Strong grasp of data modeling, formulas, and spreadsheet/database tools (Excel or similar); comfort with object-oriented and relational data concepts.

  • Excellent time management — able to move seamlessly between client meetings and hands-on build work, prioritizing across multiple engagements.

  • Friendly, obsessively customer-focused, and service-oriented, with strong problem-solving instincts.

  • Strong communication, analytical, and collaboration skills; comfortable working independently while knowing when to seek guidance.

  • A startup mindset — comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-changing environment, with a clear sense of why that environment is the right fit for you.

  • Background at a SaaS/technology company.

Nice to Have

  • SQL experience.

  • Experience with AI implementation.

  • Experience with CaptivateIQ or a competitor's sales compensation software (e.g., Xactly, Varicent, SAP Commissions).

  • Proficiency with CRMs (e.g., Salesforce) or ERPs (e.g., NetSuite).

About the Company

SuperSummary is transforming how millions of readers discover, understand, and connect with books. We’re building the world’s most comprehensive literature platform — combining nearly 10,000 expert-crafted Study Guides with interactive, innovative tools that make reading more engaging, rewarding, and fun. Beyond summaries, our paid subscription offers chapter-by-chapter analysis, character breakdowns, themes and symbols exploration, thought-provoking discussion questions, and interactive quizzes. Our growing suite of AI-powered features helps readers engage more deeply with texts, whether they’re students tackling assignments, teachers preparing lessons, book clubs seeking richer conversations, or lifelong learners exploring new genres.

Founded over a decade ago, SuperSummary’s website and mobile app has become a trusted, go-to resource for curious readers worldwide. We’re part of the Lift Ventures portfolio of EdTech brands (with over 250 million consumers reached to date) and are a fully remote, global team united by curiosity, creativity, and a shared love of learning.

About the Job

SuperSummary is looking for a hands-on, customer-focused Customer Experience Specialist to help us deliver a great experience to our customers every day and continuously improve it.

This role combines frontline customer support with hands-on involvement in projects that improve the customer experience and contribute to SuperSummary’s broader retention and growth goals. You'll spend part of your time answering tickets, solving customer problems, and providing high-quality support, occasionally connecting with customers over the phone. The rest of your time will focus on working with the CX Manager to execute initiatives that address customer needs, uncover opportunities, and improve CX operations. Expect to spend roughly half your time on each, depending on ticket volume and project priorities.

The ideal candidate has experience in customer support at a consumer subscription or digital product company, with a track record of contributing to projects beyond day-to-day support. You're proactive, detail-oriented, comfortable working with data and AI tools, and able to balance daily responsibilities with longer-term initiatives. You take initiative, enjoy collaborating with others, and follow through on your work.

What You’ll Do

Customer Support

  • Manage tickets in Freshdesk; deliver thoughtful and effective support via email while maintaining a consistent brand voice
  • Handle operational routines such as account reviews
  • Handle recurring account and billing requests, including refunds, cancellations and plan changes, and login or account access issues
  • Respond to App Store and Google Play reviews and public comments in SuperSummary’s voice
  • Reproduce and document reported bugs, escalating to Engineering and Product with clear detail

CX Improvement & Operations

  • Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve the customer experience
  • Collect and analyze customer feedback through surveys, interviews, and support interactions
  • Improve support processes and workflows using AI and automation
  • Improve support processes and workflows, including macros, help center content, and Freshdesk configuration, using AI and automation where they help

Customer Insights & Collaboration

  • Support and contribute to projects that enhance the customer journey, reduce friction, and support retention and growth goals
  • Identify trends beyond individual tickets to understand recurring customer pain points
  • Share observations and suggestions with the CX Manager and Product team
  • Actively participate in implementing improvements and tracking their impact

Sample Projects

  • Ticket driver and self-service audit. Map our top ticket drivers to the help center article, platform feature, or chatbot action that should resolve each one. Your findings set the baseline for our self-service goals and shape which knowledge base articles we rewrite first.
  • Customer review program. Build a repeatable process for following up with satisfied customers and inviting them to share a review.
  • Knowledge base impact review. Measure whether the redesigned help center is working: compare ticket volume for covered issues against the pre-redesign baseline, track article views and top searches, and recommend what to update next.

Requirements

  • Advanced written and spoken English.
  • 2–4 years of experience in customer support or customer experience, ideally at a B2C subscription, digital, or consumer product company.
  • Experience owning customer experience initiatives, process improvements, or projects beyond day-to-day support.
  • Experience with a help desk tool such as Freshdesk or Zendesk.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to adapt your tone over phone or email while maintaining a consistent brand voice.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality customer support with empathy, attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and sound judgment.
  • Comfortable using AI tools and eager to explore how they can improve workflows and efficiency.
  • Strong data skills to work with spreadsheets, read a dashboard, and turn numbers into clear insights.
  • Proactive, organized, and self-directed, with the ability to balance daily support responsibilities with longer-term projects, take ownership of assigned tasks, and follow through on improvements.

Location

Remote — Latin America preferred (location flexible).

Benefits

  • Work with a distributed, global team in Latin America, Europe, and the US that has been remote-first since 2018.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and vacation policy.
  • Workspace improvement stipend.
  • Professional development and learning stipend.

raw.title: IT Support Analyst (Level 1 - Level 2)
raw.excerpt: ABOUT THE COMPANYOur client is an Adelaide-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering day-to-day IT support to a range of client environments.
raw.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client is an Adelaide-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering day-to-day IT support to a range of client environments. They are looking for a capable, client-focused IT Support team member for whom ticket resolution is the core of the role: working helpdesk tickets by phone, email and portal, from routine requests to technically complex issues, resolved end to end with minimal escalation. They also need someone who brings real Microsoft 365 administration skills and hands-on phone system administration to the team.

ABOUT THE ROLE

  • This is a hands-on support role covering day-to-day work across a range of client environments. Ticket resolution is the core of the role: working helpdesk tickets by phone, email and portal, from routine requests to technically complex issues, resolved end to end with minimal escalation. The work includes remoting into client devices to troubleshoot and resolve issues, and keeping clear, accurate documentation.

  • A key part of the role is assisting with Microsoft 365 administration and general MSP support work. The client needs someone with genuine admin-level Microsoft 365 experience in Entra and Exchange Online, not end-user experience.

  • Hands-on phone system administration is required.

  • The person will write and maintain SOPs, checklists and documentation.

PRIMARY PURPOSE

To provide prompt, accurate and professional IT support to the client's customers, resolve helpdesk tickets and remote support requests, handle Microsoft 365 administration tasks securely and correctly, and keep documentation clear and up to date so the whole team can work efficiently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    ▸ Helpdesk & Client Support

    • Answer phones and respond to support requests from clients in a professional, friendly way

    • Work through helpdesk tickets, prioritising sensibly, updating tickets as work progresses and escalating when needed

    • Communicate clearly with non-technical users, setting expectations and following through

      • ▸ Remote & Technical Troubleshooting

      • Remote into client devices to troubleshoot and resolve issues

      • Resolve day-to-day issues across a range of client environments, including user accounts, email, devices and connectivity

        • ▸ Microsoft 365 Administration

        • Assist with Microsoft 365 administration through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center, including users, licences, mailboxes and access

        • Carry out day-to-day admin tasks: users, licences, MFA, mailboxes, shared mailboxes, groups and message trace

        • Support M365 across multiple users and businesses, with exposure to Intune, SharePoint and Teams administration

          • ▸ Phone Systems

          • Administer and support client phone systems (extensions, ring groups, call flows, IVRs, SIP trunks, handset provisioning) and troubleshoot call routing and quality

            • ▸ Security Response

            • Act on alerts from the client's monitoring tools, such as suspicious sign-ins or compromised accounts.

            • Contain the issue (revoke sessions, reset credentials, review MFA methods), check for persistence (mailbox rules, forwarding, unrecognised app consents), then escalate and document, not just fix the symptom.

            • Verify the requester's identity before sensitive changes such as password or MFA resets.

              • ▸ MSP Support & Tools

              • Assist with general MSP support work for the client's customers

              • Use the client's ticketing, remote monitoring and documentation tools. Experience with a PSA/ticketing platform, an RMM and a documentation platform is required (Autotask, Datto RMM and IT Glue are preferred, but equivalent platforms are accepted)

              • Provide support for networking (UniFi configuration and maintenance) as skills allow, with team guidance

                • ▸ Documentation

                • Maintain clear and accurate documentation, including ticket notes and client environment records

                • Follow the team's ticketing and documentation standards consistently

                • Write and maintain SOPs, checklists and how-to guides

                  • ▸ Automation and Improvement

                  • Identify repetitive tasks and look for ways to automate them, including with AI or scripting, while handling client data responsibly

                    • ▸ Hours & Location

                  • Remote. Full-time, working Adelaide business hours. Reliable internet, power backup and a suitable workspace required.

MUST-HAVE (ESSENTIAL)

  • Hands-on Microsoft 365 administration experience across Microsoft Entra (Identity) and Exchange Online (end-user M365 experience alone is not sufficient)

  • In-depth knowledge and experience of the Microsoft 365 Admin Center (identity, Exchange and related admin tasks)

  • Hands-on administration of a business or hosted phone system

  • Experience with a PSA/ticketing platform, an RMM and an IT documentation platform

  • Experience writing SOPs, checklists and technical documentation

  • Client-facing experience and a calm, professional phone manner

  • Clear, professional spoken and written English

  • Sound security judgement: verifies identity before sensitive changes and recognises and escalates a compromised account

NICE-TO-HAVE (FAVOURABLE / PREFERRED)

  • Big bonus: practical experience using AI, scripting or workflow automation to save time. It doesn't have to be a specific language or tool.

  • Strong preference: MSP or service desk experience supporting multiple businesses.

  • Strong preference: Autotask, Datto RMM and IT Glue, and 3CX or Yeastar.

  • Strong preference: networking (UniFi, firewalls, VPN, Wi-Fi).

  • Strong preference: Intune, plus familiarity with Defender and Conditional Access.

  • 2+ years of IT support experience.

  • A relevant IT qualification or certification (for example MS-900, MS-102, MD-102 or CompTIA).

  • SharePoint and Teams administration.

  • Experience supporting Australian or ANZ clients.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit a CV along with a short cover note outlining your M365 administration experience (Entra and Exchange Online), phone system experience, the PSA, RMM and documentation platforms you have used, helpdesk or MSP experience, and your availability for full-time work during Adelaide business hours. If you have used AI or automation to save time in your work, include a brief example. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted to progress to the next stage of the process.

raw.excerpt: BCM One is looking for a GRC Specialist to join our growing global compliance team.
raw.description:
BCM One is looking for a GRC Specialist to join our growing global compliance team. In this role, you will bridge Information Security Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) and IT Service Management (ITSM) disciplines to strengthen our global IT operations and compliance posture. You’ll work hands-on across security, compliance, and service management teams to drive the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of security controls, ensuring alignment with internal standards, industry regulations, and contractual requirements.

Reporting to the Global Manager of Info Sec & GRC, this role will lead efforts across monitoring, assessing, designing, implementing, and maintaining security processes aligned with GRC frameworks, while driving operational excellence, audit readiness, and risk mitigation. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across global geographies to ensure consistent control adoption, service delivery, and compliance across the environment.

Work Location:

Preference will be given to candidates within the National Capital Region; however, we are open to remote candidates. Candidates must live in and be authorized to work in the Philippines; this position is not eligible for relocation or sponsorship.

Hours:

Core hours are typically 8pm to 5am local time, with flexibility to support international teams.

Travel:

Travel is unlikely but could include fewer than five trips per year to international offices.

What You Will Do:

  • Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of GRC frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
  • Conduct risk assessments, design and validation of security controls, compliance monitoring, and third‑party security evaluations.
  • Manage internal and external audits, including audit preparation, evidence collection, reporting, and remediation planning.
  • Help to lead security control implementation by partnering with cross‑functional teams and advising stakeholders on control adoption across the business.
  • Maintain documentation of policies, procedures, and controls per global standards.
  • Collaborate with Privacy/Legal on data protection and facilitate privacy impact assessments.
  • Facilitate Business Impact Assessments and oversee Business Continuity testing and updates.
  • Monitor and report on Security GRC metrics to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Support change management to ensure security and compliance with minimal disruption.
  • Coordinate between IT, Security, and Compliance teams to align service delivery with regulatory requirements.
  • Deliver training and awareness programs, including phishing simulations and compliance education.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements to reduce risk and enhance operational efficiency.

What You Will Need:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Security Governance, Risk & Compliance, with direct responsibility for leading the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of security controls
  • Strong hands-on experience with SOC 2 is required, along with knowledge of GRC frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, CIS Controls, and GDPR, with experience applying them to security control implementation
  • Proven experience managing audit preparation and evidence for internal and external audits
  • Ability to identify, assess, and prioritize risks using risk-based thinking and sound judgment
  • Skilled at monitoring security and compliance performance through KPIs, SLAs, and OLAs
  • Strong documentation, analytical, and organizational skills, with attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, global environment
  • Strong communication skills, able to explain technical and compliance concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Experience working cross-functionally with IT, security, compliance, and business teams to drive security control adoption across geographies
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes (incident, problem, change, request, asset/configuration management)
  • Proactive mindset with a commitment to integrity, confidentiality, and continuous learning
  • Preferred: Experience with IT Service Management, systems administration, and regulated industries (telecommunications, finance, healthcare)

Who We Are:

BCM One is a leading telecom provider of NextGen Communications and Managed Services that has been in business for 30 years with more than 18,000 business customers and 5,000 channel partners who rely on our products, services, and teams to support their critical underlying network infrastructure. BCM One is the parent company to our family of brands that includes SIP.US, SIPTRUNK, Flowroute, SkySwitch, and Pure IP.

Joining the BCM One team is a chance to be part of a financially strong company with an exciting growth story; over the past 4 years we’ve brought together leading companies in our space who have built products, services, and programs to innovate and disrupt our industry. Now, operating under one roof, we are taking BCM One to the next level and looking for talented individuals to help make that happen.

When you choose to work at BCM One, you get to work with a talented team and build experience with the leading technologies, suppliers, and partners in our industry. We don’t offer cookie-cutter solutions, so the opportunities are endless, and the work is always varied and interesting. We take our mission “to provide a world-class experience with every human interaction” seriously, which means everything you do makes a difference. And we’re committed to building and nurturing a diverse and inclusive workforce and environment that empowers you to do your best work, spread your wings and reach your full potential. At BCM One, we encourage our team to learn something new every day, so you don’t just become part of our growth story, we become part of yours.

Why BCM One

We are committed to creating an environment that fosters teamwork, accountability, innovation, and teamwork. Many BCM One employees have been with the company for 10+ years, which we think says a lot about our culture.

We Are a Team

  • We pride ourselves on our team-based approach to providing quality solutions for our clients. BCM One encourages a culture of collaboration, exposing employees to different areas of the business and fostering career growth.
  • We support employee involvement and provide opportunities to be responsible stewards via our BCM One Gives Back Program and our Emergency Fund to help our team members who are going through difficult times.

Hard Work is Recognized

  • We offer an Employee of the Quarter program with a monetary award and Employee of the Year that includes a 7-day vacation package to the Caribbean. In addition, we host various regional team-building gatherings throughout the year.
  • We believe in developing our team members and offer many opportunities for training, professional development and career growth.

Your Voice is Heard

  • We empower our team members to speak up and look for opportunities in challenges.
  • We have an Employee Council and a Diversity Equity and Inclusion Committee made up of volunteers from across the company who share a passion for making BCM One a great place to work and find ways to positively impact our communities.

How we take care of you:

  • Competitive industry salaries with annual reviews
  • Health Insurance (HMO with 2 free dependents)
  • Generous Paid time off
  • Company retirement plan
  • 13th month pay

BCM One is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver the AI enablement program across the business — foundational training, role-specific sessions, hands-on labs, and self-paced pathways — for audiences ranging from complete beginners to advanced builders.
  • Design and maintain the AI learning curriculum across proficiency levels, from baseline literacy and prompting fundamentals through workflow integration and agent building, contextualized to each function's real work.

  • Run a department-by-department adoption view: where each function sits on the proficiency curve, what's blocking them, and what intervention comes next — and escalate the ones that are stalling.

Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The position provides executive leadership and overall accountability for the Transformation and Execution Office, including Vendor Management, Enterprise Implementations, Business Intelligence and Insights, Operational Excellence, Enterprise PMO, and Capital Planning. They establish clear priorities, decision rights, performance expectations, resource allocation, and operating cadences across these functions, and ensure each workgroup operates as part of an integrated enterprise transformation portfolio.

The SVP owns the enterprise roadmap, capital planning process across the teams, and OKR governance model, ensuring that every transformation initiative is tied to a clear financial or operational outcome. The role also builds the organization's capability to scale AI, automation, and digital solutions centrally, improving vendor management, investment discipline, and cross-functional accountability across Direct and MSO markets and Operations.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Capital Planning

  • Set enterprise direction and ensure capital is deployed to the highest-impact opportunities across markets and functions.
  • Own enterprise and market-level strategic planning, capital allocation, and ROI prioritization.
  • Define enterprise operating models, governance structures, and OKRs, and drive a unified roadmap across the organization.
  • Lead enterprise opportunity development, translating strategic priorities into a fundable, sequenced portfolio of initiatives.

Vendor Management

  • Lead the VP, Vendor Management and the enterprise vendor ecosystem, including condition management (e.g., Empassion, OncoHealth), specialty vendors (labs, OptumBH, Pareto, Cozeva), operations/AI vendors (TalkDesk, DRIPs, Hippocratic AI), and system interfaces (PointClickCare, Bamboo, Contexture).
  • Accountable for measurable business value from vendor partnerships through strong performance management, contractual compliance, and cost-effective terms.
  • Strengthen vendor governance and risk management, including performance scorecards and escalation pathways.
  • Ensure a disciplined vendor lifecycle: opportunity identification, vendor selection, capital planning and contracting, implementation, and hand-off to ongoing vendor management ownership.

Implementation (New Markets, Technology & Solutions)

  • Lead the VP, New Market & Tech Implementations, ensuring successful new market expansion, enterprise technology rollouts, and regulatory operations (e.g., 2027 CMS Interoperability, CMS Final Rule) are executed with organizational readiness and disciplined project management.
  • Ensure adoption of implementation playbooks, tools, and benchmarking to ensure solutions are adopted, scaled, and sustained consistently across markets.
  • Direct prioritization of change management and capability building so new solutions and platforms (e.g., Cozeva, Evolent, Empassion) achieve intended business value post-implementation.
  • Oversee execution of post-implementation ownership handoff protocols between Implementation and Vendor Management.

Business Intelligence & Insights

  • Lead the VP, Business Intelligence & Insights toprovide a single source of truth on enterprise, market, and IPA-level performance.
  • Oversee execution of KPI standardization, OKR tracking, ROI validation, and MLR action plan support across the organization.
  • Advance performance improvement through the building of enterprise dashboards, reporting, and ops automation/RPA capabilities that create performance transparency and enable rapid decision-making.
  • Enforce accountability of performance risk and underperformance early through root-cause analysis and capital efficiency tracking.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead the VP, Operational Excellence, accountable for enterprise capital planning (3-year planning, strategists, business analysts), the Enterprise PMO (OKR governance and initiative delivery), Ops Process Improvement (efficiency and SG&A), and Total Cost of Care (portfolio management and efficiency identification).
  • Achieve reduction in total cost of care while maintaining quality and member outcomes.
  • Deliver business outcomes for enterprise and operations performance improvement, ensuring on-time delivery and scalable solutions across domains (e.g., MRA, Stars, Claims) are executed on.
  • Own strategic initiatives that optimize capital allocation and investment value across the transformation portfolio.

Enterprise Governance & Talent Leadership

  • Chair a single enterprise forum to prioritize and govern transformation initiatives across functions.
  • Build and scale a high-performing leadership team across Vendor Management, Implementation, Business Intelligence, and Operational Excellence, including hiring against clearly defined skillsets (implementation specialists, regulatory expertise, dashboard/reporting and automation talent, Lean/Six Sigma and domain experts, strategists, and business analysts).
  • Partner closely with Operations, Clinical, Finance, and Market leadership to ensure transformation initiatives are co-owned and sustained beyond initial rollout.

Job Requirements:

EXPERIENCE

Required

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare operations, transformation, strategy, or consulting, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role leading multiple functional teams.
  • Demonstrated experience building or leading enterprise PMO, strategic planning, or transformation functions within a health plan or managed care organization.
  • Deep knowledge of Medicare Advantage operations, including Stars/HEDIS, provider network management, vendor management, and regulatory/compliance requirements (e.g., CMS Interoperability, Delegation Oversight).
  • Track record of managing vendor ecosystems, capital planning processes, and enterprise KPI/OKR governance.
  • Experience leading new market expansion and large-scale technology or platform implementations.
  • Strong executive presence with experience presenting to and influencing C-suite and board-level stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience scaling AI, automation, or RPA solutions within a healthcare or health plan operating environment.
  • Background in Lean/Six Sigma or formal process improvement methodologies.
  • Experience partnering with Clinical Operations on Total Cost of Care and affordability initiatives.
  • Prior experience standing up or restructuring a vendor management or business intelligence function.

EDUCATION

Required: Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Data/Analytics, or related field

Preferred: MBA or advanced degree

SPECIALIZED SKILLS

  • Enterprise strategic thinking with the ability to translate vision into a prioritized, fundable roadmap.
