raw.description:
About DysrupIT

DysrupIT is a consulting-led technology firm. We help mid-market to enterprise businesses solve business problems through technology, whether that's consulting, execution, managed services, or staff augmentation, we take accountability for the outcome. We are dedicated to making a positive impact in the communities we serve.

Company Culture

At DysrupIT, success isn't measured in headcount placed or hours billed, it's measured in outcomes delivered. We're a team that takes ownership of the work, stays curious about problems beyond our immediate scope, and builds relationships meant to grow, not just renew or end. We invest in our people with the training and support they need to grow their careers, and we back a culture where everyone, regardless of role, is encouraged to notice opportunities, ask one more question, and help lead the story for our clients, not just deliver it.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Project Coordinator & Business Operations Administrator to keep delivery teams and back-office operations running smoothly, so consultants can focus on client outcomes. You will join our client, an AI-native Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform consultancy that designs, builds and supports CRM and business applications across Customer Engagement (CE) and Finance & Operations (F&O). They are a small, senior team, so this role has real visibility and real influence on how the business works.

The role is split roughly 60/40 between supporting project delivery (planning, reporting, resourcing and timesheet management) and running the firm's operational backbone (contracts, onboarding and finance support). It suits someone early in their career who wants a broad view of how a consultancy runs, or an experienced coordinator who enjoys being the person who makes things happen.

  • Location: Philippines
  • Work setup: Fully remote
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Reports to: Consulting Director
  • Works closely with: Delivery leads, finance and practice leadership

Job Responsibilities

Project coordination

You will support delivery leads and project managers across several concurrent Dynamics 365 and Power Platform engagements.

  • Maintain project plans, schedules and milestone trackers, and flag slippage early to the delivery lead.
  • Prepare weekly status reports and steering committee packs using delivery data from Azure DevOps and project tools.
  • Schedule and facilitate project meetings, workshops and showcases, and capture minutes, decisions and actions and follow them through.
  • Coordinate resourcing by tracking consultant allocations and availability across projects, and help delivery leads plan upcoming demand.
  • Monitor timesheets and project budgets against plan, and highlight burn-rate variances to the delivery lead.
  • Support change control by logging change requests, tracking approvals and keeping scope baselines current.
  • Keep project documentation in SharePoint and Teams current, consistently named and easy to find.
  • Help prepare handover and hypercare materials as projects move into BAU support.

Business operations administration

You will keep the firm's operational processes accurate, compliant and efficient.

  • Prepare, track and file client contracts, SOWs, change orders and subcontractor agreements.
  • Coordinate employee and contractor onboarding and offboarding, including system access, equipment, licences and induction.
  • Support finance operations by raising invoices from approved milestones and timesheets, tracking receivables, processing supplier invoices and expenses, and assisting with month-end inputs.
  • Maintain internal records, policies and templates (proposal, SOW, estimate and JD templates) so they stay current and consistently branded.
  • Support compliance requirements such as insurance certificates, client security questionnaires, vendor onboarding forms and audit requests.
  • Coordinate travel, events and team meetings, and act as the first point of contact for general operational queries.
  • Identify repetitive admin tasks and improve or automate them using Power Platform and AI tools.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: Project reporting runs reliably across active engagements, RAID logs and status reports are current, and the onboarding, contract and finance processes are documented and owned.
  • By 6 months: Delivery leads spend noticeably less time on admin and reporting, resourcing and timesheet visibility is accurate week to week, and at least two recurring operational tasks have been simplified or automated.
  • By 12 months: You are the trusted operational backbone of the firm, with consistent project governance, clean compliance records and a clear view of how the function can scale as the business grows.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years in project coordination, PMO, business operations or administration, ideally in a professional services, consulting or technology environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 (Excel, Teams, SharePoint and Outlook), and comfort learning new tools quickly.
  • Experience maintaining project plans, RAID logs and status reports, and an understanding of both waterfall and agile delivery.
  • Excellent attention to detail, especially with contracts, invoices and records.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the confidence to follow up with senior people politely and persistently.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities across several projects without losing track of commitments.
  • Organised without being rigid, and takes ownership of loose ends before anyone asks.
  • Stays calm when priorities shift, and uses sound judgement with confidential information such as contracts, pricing and client details.
  • Comfortable working across a distributed team.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform projects, or experience in a Microsoft partner environment.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, a PSA or timesheet tool, and basic finance systems such as Xero or MYOB.
  • Familiarity with Power Automate, Power Apps or AI assistants for workflow automation.
  • Certifications such as PRINCE2 Foundation, PMI CAPM, Scrum Master or Microsoft PL-900.
  • A degree in business, commerce, information systems or a related field.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.
  • Government-mandated benefits plus supplemental HMO coverage.
  • Collaborative and professional work environment.
  • Career growth opportunities within a growing organization.
  • Fully remote work arrangement.

At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

With extensive experience in non-standard and complex loan scenarios, our client has developed deep expertise in this niche, allowing them to provide tailored, high-quality guidance to clients with unique financial situations.

We're looking for a smart, highly organized, and detail-oriented Senior Admin / Deal Support professional to support a team member with the day-to-day administration and coordination of mortgage applications.

This is a hands-on support role focused on AOL entries, deal organization, document management, follow-ups, and keeping applications moving smoothly.

You’ll work closely with a team member who will provide guidance, oversight, and escalation support when needed. We’re looking for someone who is proactive, takes ownership of their work, learns quickly, and can manage multiple loan files while maintaining a high level of accuracy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support a team member with AOL entries and mortgage application administration.
  • Assist with preparing and organizing information required for loan applications.
  • Request, collect, and organize supporting documents from clients.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Broker Engine and other relevant systems.
  • Ensure documents and application information are complete, accurate, and properly organized.
  • Follow up with clients, lenders, and other stakeholders for outstanding information or documents.
  • Monitor outstanding tasks and follow-ups to help keep deals progressing.
  • Assist with tracking applications and maintaining accurate deal status through to settlement.
  • Support a team member with day-to-day administrative and deal support tasks.
  • Identify missing information, inconsistencies, or potential issues and raise them promptly.
  • Help maintain organized and efficient processes across assigned loan files.
  • Take on additional responsibilities as your knowledge and confidence in the role develop.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years' experience working as a Senior Admin/Deal support or similar work?
  • Do you have experience working in an Australian mortgage broking, loan processing, mortgage administration, credit support, or a similar role.
  • Experience with AOL, Broker Engine, or similar Australian mortgage systems is highly desirable.

  • Strong administrative and organizational skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple applications, tasks, and follow-ups simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Proactive approach with the ability to identify what needs to be done rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Willingness to learn and develop a deeper understanding of Australian mortgage processes.


Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is smart, organized, proactive, and detail-oriented. They don't need to know everything from day one, but they should be curious, willing to learn, and capable of picking things up quickly.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, keeps deals and information organized, follows up without needing constant reminders, and knows when to ask questions or escalate an issue.

The team member you’ll be supporting will provide guidance and oversight where required, so the ability to learn, take feedback, and progressively become more independent is particularly important.

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

Job Description

A bit about this role:

You will join our SNP Operations team, a collaborative team dedicated to building high-performing, compliant operational systems that ensure Devoted’s Special Needs Plans consistently meet rigorous CMS and Medicaid standards.

In this role, you will oversee day-to-day regulatory requirements, manage compliance documentation, and handle operational due diligence across our SNP programs. You’ll also drive key process improvements and standardization, ensuring our SNP operations and reporting run smoothly, accurately, and without gaps. Finally, as CMS and Medicaid standards change, you will blend regulatory compliance with operational strategy—translating changing CMS and Medicaid requirements into seamless workflows that empower our frontline teams to deliver exceptional care to our SNP members.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Develop Devoted's Models of Care (MOCs) annually in collaboration with the SNP Operations Director.
  • Oversee and manage Devoted's policies, procedures, and compliance universes in compliance with CMS and Model of Care requirements, ensuring perpetual audit-readiness.
  • Review new or changing Model of Care and CMS requirements, working cross-functionally to develop and implement operational solutions.
  • Develop and implement enhanced processes to oversee compliance with Model of Care and CMS-related SNP requirements, including building early warning systems to detect and prevent potential gaps.
  • Develop Medicaid benefit subject matter expertise, creating knowledge tools and configurations that support frontline staff and members in understanding and coordinating Medicare and Medicaid benefits.
  • Oversee, with the SNP Operations Director and other SNP Managers, routine Medicaid reporting, and work cross-functionally to develop and submit required Medicaid reports accurately and timely.
  • Provide additional compliance and operational support across SNP and Medicaid programs as assigned.

Required skills and experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in Medicare Advantage, Managed Care, Health Plan, or health care operations.
  • Proven ability to interpret CMS and/or State Medicaid regulatory guidelines and translate them into standard operational workflows and compliance processes.
  • Highly detail-oriented, reliable, independent, and curious, with a track record of managing detailed compliance tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional teams.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Direct experience with Special Needs Plans (SNPs), SNP Model of Care (MOC) development and implementation, or SNP care management operations.
  • Experience in the Medicaid space (e.g., Medicaid compliance, benefits administration, claims processing, or D-SNP dual-eligible benefit coordination).

About Belltower Fund Group:

Belltower, AngelList’s funds services division, is empowering world-changing fund investments.

Belltower was formed in 2019 as AngelList’s native fund administrator. Belltower provides fund administration services to the venture space. Our coverage spans syndicates, venture funds, and first-of-their-kind rolling funds. Our full-service fund management offering streamlines the complexity of running a fund by integrating financial reporting, tax, compliance, portfolio management, and other services that managers typically have to cobble together from multiple vendors. Our services, combined with AngelList’s software, enable us to launch and scale a fund efficiently, allowing fund managers to focus on what they do best: investing.

Since 2019, Belltower has supported 27k+ funds representing over $25B in assets under administration, leveraging AngelList’s fund admin software to power the service layer for funds launched on the AngelList platform.

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Cash Reconciliation Associate to join our FAST (Fund Accounting Service Team). This role is ideal for someone early in their accounting career who is interested in building experience in investment fund accounting and financial operations.

This role is responsible for performing daily cash reconciliations across closed-end funds and their management companies. The successful candidate will ensure the completeness and accuracy of cash activity by reconciling bank accounts, administrator records, and accounting systems while investigating and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.

The Cash Reconciliation Associate will report to a Fund Accounting Senior Associate within FAST and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders. This role is well-suited for candidates who are highly organized, eager to learn, and comfortable working in a structured, deadline-driven environment.

You will:

  • Perform daily cash reconciliations between bank accounts, accounting systems, and internal records across multiple funds and legal entities.
  • Investigate, research, and resolve cash breaks and reconciliation exceptions within established service level agreements.
  • Monitor daily cash movements including capital calls, distributions, management fees, carried interest, investment funding, and operating expenses.
  • Record and validate cash transactions within the fund accounting platform while ensuring accurate general ledger postings.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve outstanding cash discrepancies.
  • Assist with quarter-end, and year-end close processes by ensuring all cash activity has been accurately reconciled.
  • Support external audits by providing reconciliation support, documentation, and responding to auditor requests.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reconciliation processes through automation, standardization, and enhanced operational controls.
  • Look at existing processes and ask whether AI and automation could do them better

You have:

  • 2–5 years of experience in fund accounting
  • Basic understanding of accounting principles including debits, credits, and double-entry bookkeeping
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work with financial data accurately
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Comfort learning and working with accounting software and financial systems
  • Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely during required business hours
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, especially Excel/Sheets (formulas, pivot tables, vlookups)
  • Experience with accounting software, ERP systems, or fund administration platforms (a plus, not required)
  • Background in fund accounting, investment accounting, or financial services (a plus, not required)
  • Knowledge of partnership accounting or investment fund structures (a plus, not required)
  • An instinct to question existing processes and use AI and automation to build better ones

Work Arrangement:

This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines. Overlap with US business hours is required for team collaboration, period-end closes, and cross-functional coordination.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation for the Philippines market
  • Fully remote work arrangement
    • Working hours: 6 am - 3 pm Philippines time (can be flexible)
  • Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development
  • Opportunity to build expertise in US investment fund accounting
  • Supportive team environment with clear processes and documentation
  • Growth opportunities as FAST and the broader operations team scale
  • Stable, long-term employment with a growing fund administration business

raw.excerpt: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know?
raw.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Illumina is seeking a Sr. Staff Medical Science Liaison (MSL) with deep expertise in genomics, genetic disease, and reproductive health. Illumina is a global leader in DNA sequencing and multi-omics, with a global presence in research and clinical markets. Illumina manufactures research use only (RUO) and in vitro diagnostic (IVD) products that support both research and clinical environments.


The Sr. Staff MSL is responsible for facilitating objective, evidence-based, and non-promotional scientific exchange regarding Illumina's technologies, products, and associated scientific data. This role focuses on building and maintaining relationships with key opinion leaders (KOL) and other scientific stakeholders, gathering insights to inform Medical Affairs strategy, supporting research and educational initiatives, and responding to unsolicited requests for scientific information in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.


The individual will contribute scientific expertise related to genomic technologies, emerging evidence, laboratory applications, and evolving scientific, laboratory, and clinical evidence relevant to advancing research in the field of genetic disease and reproductive health. As a member of the US Medical Affairs organization, this individual will serve as a field-based scientific resource and scientific exchange partner to healthcare professionals (HCP), laboratory personnel, researchers, academic institutions, and other stakeholders. Through engagement with external experts and the broader scientific community, the Sr. Staff MSL will help advance understanding of genomics and precision medicine.

This position is part of Illumina’s US Medical Affairs organization and reports to a Head of Reproductive and Genomic Health for the USCAN region. It is an opportunity to contribute to the advancement of genomic research through scientific engagement and support of Illumina’s research and clinical sequencing solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a field-based scientific resource and trusted scientific exchange partner for KOLs, HCPs, laboratory personnel, researchers, academic institutions, and other stakeholders in genomics, genetic disease, and reproductive health. Conduct all interactions in a factual, objective, non-promotional manner and in accordance with applicable company policies and practices.
  • Develop and maintain deep scientific expertise in genomic technologies, translational research, and emerging scientific evidence, and molecular diagnostics relevant to genetic disease and reproductive health. Monitor key publications, scientific trends, and evolving standards that may impact the genomics landscape.
  • Foster and maintain collaborative relationships with external scientific leaders and stakeholders to facilitate scientific exchange, gather insights, and understand evolving scientific, clinical, and research needs within the genomics community. Identification and engagement of KOLs will be based on scientific expertise and contributions to the field.
  • Deliver objective, balanced, and evidence-based scientific education regarding genomics, precision medicine, and emerging research using approved scientific content and materials.
  • Collect, analyze, and communicate scientific insights from external stakeholders to inform Medical Affairs strategy, evidence generation activities, educational initiatives, and future research priorities.
  • Support scientific exchange activities at scientific congresses, advisory boards, investigator meetings, and other research-focused forums.
  • Respond to unsolicited requests for scientific information regarding Illumina products and technologies to ensure responses are accurate, balanced, evidence-based, and appropriately documented.
  • Facilitate dissemination of approved scientific information, including scientific publications, congress presentations, clinical practice resources, and other scientific materials in accordance with applicable company policies.
  • Provide scientific support for investigator-sponsored research, collaborative research opportunities, and Illumina-sponsored clinical or research studies, including identification of qualified investigators, scientific discussions regarding study concepts, and support of study-related scientific communications.

raw.title: Strategic Client Programs Lead
raw.excerpt: Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence.
raw.description:
Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence. Built on more than 35 years of proven results, Lyric combines responsible AI with clinical, payment, regulatory, and policy expertise to deliver transparent, auditable insights in milliseconds across real-time claims workflows. Lyric augments human decision-making so health plans can make faster, more accurate payments while maintaining full control. Today, Lyric supports 200 million lives, with nine of the top 10 U.S. health plans relying on its platform to reduce waste, improve efficiency, and support accurate payments.

Applicants must already be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Visa sponsorship/sponsorship assumption and other immigration support are not available for this position.

The Strategic Client Programs Lead serves as the central post-sales program leader for strategic clients, aligning client goals with cross-functional execution across Client Success, Product, Clinical, Analytics, Technology, Content, Operations, and Delivery teams. They drive program governance, coordination, risk management, and reporting to ensure commitments are met while bringing together the right experts to address client needs, optimize adoption, and maximize value realization. Decisions impacting scope, priorities, resources, timelines, or financial outcomes are escalated through the appropriate leadership and governance channels.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


Strategic Program Leadership and Planning

  • Develop and maintain an integrated program plan covering strategic initiatives, active implementations, operational priorities, milestones, deliverables, owners, and dependencies.
  • Translate agreed client objectives and priorities into coordinated work across the responsible teams.
  • Track progress against plans and commitments, follow up with owners, and identify where work needs attention or decisions.
  • Coordinate planning across workstreams, including sequencing, capacity constraints, and impacts on other client initiatives.
  • Maintain both the overall program view and the detailed information needed to support execution and escalation.

Governance and Client Engagement

  • Serve as a program-level counterpart to the assigned client, coordinating discussions that span multiple teams or initiatives.
  • Establish and manage the program cadence, including workstream updates, client governance meetings, steering committees, and leadership reviews.
  • Prepare agendas, materials, decision requests, and follow-up actions for governance discussions.
  • Bring together the appropriate client and Lyric stakeholders to resolve priorities, risks, and cross-functional issues.
  • Frame options and implications for decisions affecting scope, priorities, timing, resources, or economics, and escalate them through the agreed governance structure.
  • Ensure decisions and client commitments are documented, communicated, and reflected in program plans.

Consultative Client Planning and Value Realization

  • Develop an understanding of the client’s goals, operating environment, current use of Lyric capabilities, and measures of success.
  • Coordinate Product, Clinical, Analytics, operational, and other experts in assessing client needs, raising concerns, and developing recommendations.
  • Identify where existing capabilities may be underused and facilitate discussions about how the client could realize more value from them.
  • Track progress against agreed client outcomes and bring together the appropriate experts to address gaps between expected and actual results.
  • Connect insights from implementation and ongoing operations to future client planning and priorities.

Intake, Prioritization, and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Maintain an organized view of client requests, enhancements, operational initiatives, and other work requiring cross-functional support.
  • Coordinate assessment of requirements, impacts, assumptions, dependencies, and recommended next steps with the responsible teams.
  • Facilitate alignment on priorities and sequencing; bring unresolved tradeoffs to the appropriate decision-makers.
  • Track approved work through the program plan so that owners, commitments, and status remain clear.

Release Readiness and Implementation Coordination

  • Coordinate cross-functional readiness for releases, implementations, migrations, and other significant client events.
  • Maintain visibility into readiness milestones, required actions, testing status, operational preparation, client communications, and dependencies.
  • Follow up with responsible owners on outstanding readiness items and escalate concerns that could affect a client commitment or planned event.
  • Facilitate communication among business, operational, delivery, and technical teams before and during implementation.
  • Track post-implementation issues, adoption, outcomes, and lessons learned.
  • The Principal coordinates readiness and maintains an integrated view of progress; the responsible teams retain ownership of technical development, testing execution, and deployment.

Risk, Issue, Dependency, and Change Management

  • Maintain program-level risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, including owners, mitigation actions, target dates, and escalation status.
  • Proactively identify threats to milestones, client commitments, operational performance, or expected outcomes.
  • Follow up on mitigation and resolution actions and escalate items that require leadership attention or cross-functional decisions.
  • Coordinate the planning and communication needed to prepare client and internal stakeholders for significant changes.

Reporting and Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain program status reports, dashboards, governance metrics, milestone tracking, and executive materials.
  • Provide an accurate, current view of program health, delivery performance, decisions, risks, and client outcomes.
  • Collect and reconcile updates from workstream owners, identify gaps or conflicting information, and ensure reporting supports action.
  • Improve program processes, reporting, and cross-functional ways of working based on lessons learned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in program management, client success, professional services, PMO, consulting, or a related field.
  • Experience managing detailed plans and reporting for large, cross-functional, client-facing initiatives.
  • Experience working with executive stakeholders and client leadership teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and establish accountability without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience connecting implementation, ongoing operations, adoption

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Healthcare payer, payment integrity, or healthcare technology experience

***The US base salary range for this full-time position is:

$125,241.00 - $187,862.00

The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and does not reflect the value of the total rewards compensation. ***

Lyric is an Equal Opportunity Employer that strives to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace collaborative success.

raw.excerpt: Job Description A bit about this role: As a senior member of Devoted Health’s treasury and cash management function, the Senior Treasury Manager will partner with the Treasury Director to lead treasury and cash management activities across our operating, regulated, and clinical entities — and to build the treasury infrastructure required to support potential expansion into international markets and into commercial lines of business.
raw.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

As a senior member of Devoted Health’s treasury and cash management function, the Senior Treasury Manager will partner with the Treasury Director to lead treasury and cash management activities across our operating, regulated, and clinical entities — and to build the treasury infrastructure required to support potential expansion into international markets and into commercial lines of business.

Primary responsibilities include international and cross-border banking, the payment operations that support our provider/practice and commercial businesses, debt management and covenant compliance, cash and liquidity management, and supporting the management of internal stakeholder and third-party banking relationships.

This role is currently scoped as an individual contributor, with the potential for future management. We are looking for someone who can operate hands-on today and step into leading and developing a team as the function scales.

We expect this role to be integral to ensuring the integrity, accuracy, consistency, and transparency of cash and treasury reporting across our overall finance function.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Build treasury infrastructure for international and commercial expansion — in-country account structures, multi-currency cash management, and the banking and payments rails supporting new regulated, international, and commercial entities.

  • Manage the debt portfolio and covenant compliance calendar — revolver, letters of credit, and surety bonds; prepare and certify covenant calculations and all recurring lender reporting; partner with Legal and Accounting on credit agreement interpretation and maintain a controlled record of debt documentation

  • Drive daily cash positioning, liquidity, and forecasting across all entities — concentration and funding adequacy, short- and long-term forecasts with variance analysis and liquidity impact, serving as escalation point for daily cash operations

  • Manage capital flows and short-term investments — intercompany funding, capital contributions, and dividend planning with Accounting, Tax, and Legal; invest excess cash within board- and regulator-approved policy guidelines

  • Lead treasury controls, audit, and policy administration — ICFR activities across the cash management function including annual certification, quarterly investment concentration risk monitoring against health insurance regulations, audited financial statement footnotes and disclosures, and treasury policy administration

  • Own the Treasury Management System (Kyriba) — implementation of new modules to support operations and manage adherence to IT and general controls

  • Serve as a banking and payments SME while developing the team and external relationships — lead cross-functional treasury projects; coach and develop staff with direct management as the function scales; manage banking partners, payment processors, custodians, and technology vendors including pricing negotiation, service reviews, and bank fee analysis; partner across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Compliance, Claims, and the clinical and provider organizations

Required skills and experience:

  • Experience and credentials: 10+ years of progressive cash management and treasury operations experience, preferably in a large corporate treasury environment; Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance required, Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) accreditation required; prior team lead or people management experience

  • International treasury experience. Multi-currency cash management, cross-border funding, FX exposure management, and standing up in-country bank account structures

  • Industry and systems: experience supporting commercial lines of business, healthcare or insurance background with Medicare Advantage and statutory/regulated entity familiarity; demonstrated experience with Treasury Management Systems (Kyriba) and BAI2 / ISO 20022 file formats required, NetSuite or comparable general ledger software, and general knowledge of AI tools to automate treasury processes required.

  • Hands-on experience with debt compliance and management covering credit agreements, covenant and borrowing reporting, and lender relationship management; ACH and NACHA rules experience required

  • Communication and tools: excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to senior leadership, auditors, regulators, and external partners; advanced spreadsheet proficiency and strong general computer skills required

Desired skills and experience:

  • Proven delivery in changing, complex, high-growth environments, with sound judgment in ambiguous situations — particularly when standing up processes in new markets and new lines of business. Able to independently manage multiple demands and competing priorities, meeting deadlines on a continuous basis.

  • Results oriented with an aptitude for analytical solutions — identifies the actions needed to complete tasks and obtain results, and contributes from day one. Comfort as a hands-on individual contributor today, with the capability and appetite to lead and develop a team as the function scales.

  • Strong attention to detail with excellent documentation and organizational skills; adheres to and improves policies and procedures

  • High ethical standards at all times, including maintaining the confidentiality of financial and other sensitive information consistent with moral, professional, and regulatory requirements

  • Investment knowledge preferred

  • MBA preferred.

Salary range: $110,500 - $150,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

Primary responsibilities include international and cross-border banking, the payment operations that support our provider/practice and commercial businesses, debt management and covenant compliance, cash and liquidity management, and supporting the management of internal stakeholder and third-party banking relationships.

This role is currently scoped as an individual contributor, with the potential for future management. We are looking for someone who can operate hands-on today and step into leading and developing a team as the function scales.

We expect this role to be integral to ensuring the integrity, accuracy, consistency, and transparency of cash and treasury reporting across our overall finance function.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Build treasury infrastructure for international and commercial expansion — in-country account structures, multi-currency cash management, and the banking and payments rails supporting new regulated, international, and commercial entities.

  • Manage the debt portfolio and covenant compliance calendar — revolver, letters of credit, and surety bonds; prepare and certify covenant calculations and all recurring lender reporting; partner with Legal and Accounting on credit agreement interpretation and maintain a controlled record of debt documentation

  • Drive daily cash positioning, liquidity, and forecasting across all entities — concentration and funding adequacy, short- and long-term forecasts with variance analysis and liquidity impact, serving as escalation point for daily cash operations

  • Manage capital flows and short-term investments — intercompany funding, capital contributions, and dividend planning with Accounting, Tax, and Legal; invest excess cash within board- and regulator-approved policy guidelines

  • Lead treasury controls, audit, and policy administration — ICFR activities across the cash management function including annual certification, quarterly investment concentration risk monitoring against health insurance regulations, audited financial statement footnotes and disclosures, and treasury policy administration

  • Own the Treasury Management System (Kyriba) — implementation of new modules to support operations and manage adherence to IT and general controls

  • Serve as a banking and payments SME while developing the team and external relationships — lead cross-functional treasury projects; coach and develop staff with direct management as the function scales; manage banking partners, payment processors, custodians, and technology vendors including pricing negotiation, service reviews, and bank fee analysis; partner across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Compliance, Claims, and the clinical and provider organizations

Required skills and experience:

  • Experience and credentials: 10+ years of progressive cash management and treasury operations experience, preferably in a large corporate treasury environment; Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance required, Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) accreditation required; prior team lead or people management experience

  • International treasury experience. Multi-currency cash management, cross-border funding, FX exposure management, and standing up in-country bank account structures

  • Industry and systems: experience supporting commercial lines of business, healthcare or insurance background with Medicare Advantage and statutory/regulated entity familiarity; demonstrated experience with Treasury Management Systems (Kyriba) and BAI2 / ISO 20022 file formats required, NetSuite or comparable general ledger software, and general knowledge of AI tools to automate treasury processes required.

  • Hands-on experience with debt compliance and management covering credit agreements, covenant and borrowing reporting, and lender relationship management; ACH and NACHA rules experience required

  • Communication and tools: excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to senior leadership, auditors, regulators, and external partners; advanced spreadsheet proficiency and strong general computer skills required

Desired skills and experience:

  • Proven delivery in changing, complex, high-growth environments, with sound judgment in ambiguous situations — particularly when standing up processes in new markets and new lines of business. Able to independently manage multiple demands and competing priorities, meeting deadlines on a continuous basis.

  • Results oriented with an aptitude for analytical solutions — identifies the actions needed to complete tasks and obtain results, and contributes from day one. Comfort as a hands-on individual contributor today, with the capability and appetite to lead and develop a team as the function scales.

  • Strong attention to detail with excellent documentation and organizational skills; adheres to and improves policies and procedures

  • High ethical standards at all times, including maintaining the confidentiality of financial and other sensitive information consistent with moral, professional, and regulatory requirements

  • Investment knowledge preferred

  • MBA preferred.

Salary range: $110,500 - $150,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

Who We Are:

On Location is a global leader in premium experiential hospitality, offering ticketing, curated guest experiences, live event production and travel management across sports, entertainment, fashion and culture. On Location provides unrivaled access for corporate clients and fans looking for official, immersive experiences at marquee events, including the Olympic and Paralympic Games, FIFA World Cup 2026, Super Bowl, NCAA Final Four, and more. An official partner and/or service provider to over 150 iconic rights holders, such as the IOC (the Milano Cortina 2026 and Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games), FIFA, NFL, NCAA, UFC, WWE, and PGA of America, the company also owns and operates a number of its own unique experiences. On Location is a subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), a premium sports and entertainment company.TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

The Senior Manager, Event Operations & Planning for On Location, Combat Sports team will play a central role in working with more than 10 functional areas across On Location that will sell, deliver, and innovate Hospitality and VIP Experience programs alongside UFC, WWE, Zuffa Boxing, and TKO.


Main responsibilities will include:

  • Collecting and evaluating functional area project deadlines, milestones and deliverables.
  • Measuring the project health and summarizing project progress according to milestones set at the Rights holder partner level, or by the On Location functional areas. Making sure that all parties are on track with project requirements, deadlines, and schedules.
  • Identifying key areas of risk or delay that require additional focus or escalation to executive leadership to ensure dependent milestones are not impacted.
  • Serve as a client-facing team member, required to coordinate meetings, reporting, and project deliverables with our Partners and internally.
  • Preparing status reports by gathering, analyzing, and summarizing relevant information.
  • Establishing & maintaining effective project communication plans and ensuring their execution.
  • Facilitating change requests to ensure that all parties are informed of the impacts (schedule, partner, financial).
  • Serving as a central hub of information and support for the entire team so internal and external communication along with relationship building is crucial to the success of the role.
  • Supporting special strategic growth initiatives within the Combat team from creation to completion by working with internal stakeholders and external clients to define that concept and create a process to bring it to fruition. This includes setting and managing client expectations, developing a detailed project plan, defining the scope of the project and assigning team members to specific tasks.
  • Building, managing and training project management systems and new tools required to work effectively.
  • Accelerating alignment across teams, integrating different functions, defining, and driving better processes, and coaching and aligning teams and leaders to achieve their desired efficiency.
  • Establishing operational accountability (e.g., checklists, quality assurance tests) for the Combat team and share best practices across event teams.
  • Ensuring teams are maintaining best practices with data across systems to ensure that when we bring it all together, it results in the correct information available to the correct teams.
  • Working with people with different styles, and ability to navigate and endure learning situations where interactions and outcomes do not go as planned.

In order to build and maintain a dynamic team mentality, a planning & coordination manager must be able to keep open and honest communication, form working relationships and motivate anyone who needs it.


Monitor Project Progress and Set Deadlines

Organization and follow-through are a big part of a planning & coordination manager’s job. From creating an accurate timeline of project completion to ensuring tasks are finished within the confines of the assignment, this manager must remain aware of how the project is progressing.

The planning and coordination manager also anticipates delays that may occur on the client side and apprises the team of any changes in the client’s needs.

Solve Issues That Arise

During every project, issues arise that need to be solved. The planning & coordination manager is the first person who clients and team members turn to when something goes wrong, so it is in these professionals’ best interest to anticipate any potential hiccups before they happen. Adaptability and problem solving are key to keeping control of a project.


You Have These:

Planning & Coordination Manager Requirements:

  • A bachelor’s degree or master's degree in Event or Project Management.
  • Proven experience in event operations, event product building, project management & project management tools.
  • Problem solving, creative solutions and strong communication are all essential.
  • Forward thinker, strong planning skills. Ability to look ahead at possible scenarios to manage different outcomes and prepare the project team members accordingly.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, across multiple time zones, with the ability to prioritize projects and deliverables as demands shift.
  • Ability to distill complex projects in a simple and understandable method requires training experience.
  • Ability to lead project teams of various sizes and see them through to completion.
  • Strong understanding of formal project management methodologies.
  • Experience as a large-scope project manager.
  • Able to complete projects in a timely manner.
  • Understanding of Project Management Systems; Airtable, Smartsheet.
  • Excellent PowerPoint capabilities.

We’d like you to have:

  • Event Management experience.
  • Internal & External client relations experience.

Planning & Coordination Skills

Because these manager responsibilities are abundant, a broad range of skills is helpful in propelling them through the process, including:

  • Accountability
  • Adaptability
  • Budget Management
  • Clear Communication
  • Creativity
  • Decisiveness
  • Delegation
  • Forecasting
  • Leadership
  • Management
  • Organization
  • Problem Solving
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Stress Management

Travel:

Occasional domestic travel to On Location offices could be required.

raw.description:
ABOUT DYSRUPIT

DysrupIT is a leading global-based cloud services company. We support clients across the globe in
their adoption of the cloud and their transformation to as-a-Service business models. DysrupIT is
dedicated to making a positive impact in the communities it serves.

COMPANY CULTURE

We are constantly looking for talented people to join our team. We offer a unique and
extraordinary career experience to motivate and inspire talents like you to make a difference in
our customers, clients, and the entire organization. At DysrupIT, you’ll join a team of dedicated
and brilliant professionals who share the same goal of pursuing integrity and excellence. We are
committed to promoting a culture where employees are valued and respected. We invest in our
employees and make sure that they will have the right training to secure their growth and
advancement towards their career aspirations.

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking an AI/ML Engineer to deliver production-grade AI/ML solutions on Databricks for
enterprise clients. You will build robust pipelines, productionize machine learning and Generative
AI use cases, and help clients move from notebook experimentation to reliable, governed, at-scale
production systems. You will work closely with data scientists, ML scientists, and solution
architects, translating client requirements into reliable, governed, and scalable solutions.
This role is the right fit if you love hands-on AI/ML engineering, enjoy direct client collaboration in
a consulting environment, and stay current with the latest in Databricks tooling, MLOps, and

GenAI.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and productionize feature pipelines and training/serving pipelines for ML and GenAI
    use cases, using MLflow for experiment tracking and model management.
  • Support the delivery of Generative AI and agentic systems on Databricks, including data
    preparation for RAG pipelines, vector search integration, and AI/BI tooling such as
    Databricks Genie Spaces.
  • Help stand up new AI use cases end to end on Databricks, from data preparation through
    to a working prototype, working alongside data scientists to move ideas from notebook to
    production.
  • Build reusable Databricks templates and accelerators for common AI/ML use cases (RAG,
    agentic assistants, forecasting, personalisation), reducing time-to-development for new
    client engagements.
  • Optimize Databricks jobs, clusters, and workflows for cost, performance, and reliability at
    production scale.
  • Work directly with client engineering teams and stakeholders to gather requirements,
    troubleshoot issues, and hand over documentation and runbooks.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLSET

  • 3+ years of experience as an ML Engineer or in a similar role, with meaningful hands-on
    time on the Databricks platform.
  • Strong Python and PySpark skills, with the ability to write production-quality Spark jobs,
    not just notebooks.
  • Practical experience delivering production Generative AI or agentic systems, including RAG
    architectures, LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph), and AgentOps
    tooling (evaluation, monitoring, governance).
  • Extensive hands-on industry data science and ML experience using common tools such as
    pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch.
  • Background supporting large-scale consumer or enterprise ML systems (recommenders,
    ranking, forecasting, personalisation).
  • Experience with MLflow or a comparable tool for experiment tracking, model registry, and
    model serving.
  • Solid SQL skills and experience with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP); Azure
    Databricks experience is a plus.
  • Comfortable working directly with clients or cross-functional stakeholders to scope and

    deliver technical work.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Practical experience with Delta Lake and lakehouse/medallion architecture patterns.
  • Working knowledge of Unity Catalog or equivalent data governance and access-control
    tooling.
  • Prior consulting or professional services experience in AI/ML delivery.
  • Familiarity with experimentation and A/B testing pipelines built on Databricks.
  • Exposure to causal inference or applied statistics (e.g., uplift modelling, Double ML) to

    support AI use case development.

CERTIFICATIONS PREFERRED

  • Databricks Certified Machine Learning Associate or Professional
  • Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Government-mandated benefits plus supplemental Health Insurance
  • Collaborative and professional work environment
  • Career growth opportunities within a growing organization
  • Remote work arrangement

raw.description:
Essential Functions:

· Works with title examiners and title agents and other parties to the real estate transaction to determine the conditions of the title and insurability by considering the effect of documents such as deeds, mortgages mechanics liens, tax liens, judgments, assessments, probates and other matters of record

· Analyze and evaluate pertinent recorded documents for determination of ownership, accurate legal descriptions, and any effect on the title to real estate

· Explain chain of title, exceptions, and requirements to customers and managers

· Recognize title defects and formulate curative solution

· Assess risks and liabilities that may jeopardize the company, and bring these matters to the attention of the local title manager, state title manager or underwriter, as appropriate.

· If required by a specific closing file, review surveys prepared on properties and other proposed documents to be insured such as mortgages, mortgage modifications, etc.

· Works closely with the title agent and escrow staff to meet deadlines for closings and assist with answering questions related to issuance of the title commitment policies.

· Return all calls and emails from all parties to the title transaction in a responsive and timely manner.

· Advises title insurance agencies on regulatory compliance.

· Prepare and present seminars to title agents and others relating to real estate topics and other relevant matters.

· Prepare written underwriting guidelines and memoranda as needed.

· Liaison between the Underwriting Department and other departments in Westcor such as Title Plant, Agency/Sales, Claims, and Corporate Legal as needed.

· Perform other duties as assigned by Manager or Senior Counsel.

Competencies:

· Extensive knowledge of Real Estate Law/ Underwriting Real Estate Transactions in Texas or one of the surrounding 4 states as it relates to real estate, a general understanding of the law regarding probate, intestate succession, marital property, homestead, bankruptcy, contracts, corporate law, and trial and appellate procedure.

· At least 5 years’ experience working in title insurance, preferably in Texas or one of the surrounding 4 states (preference will be given to those with greater experience)

· Familiarity with the rules and procedures contained in the Texas Basic Manual for Title Insurance and strong legal research skills using Westlaw or Lexis in order to handle unique situations.

· Public speaking skills and experience as it relates to drafting and creation of PowerPoints and outlines for professional education courses suitable for real estate agents, escrow officers and attorneys.

· Ability to collaborate and act decisively with abstract thinking with creative solutions and strong negotiation skills

· Adaptability, Patience, and understanding of customer needs and the pressures they work under (Preference will be given to those evidencing strong people skills)

Physical Demands:

This role is mostly sedentary and requires the ability to sit for long periods each day. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate orally and through e-mail. The employee uses hands and fingers to type, handle, and reach. The ability to operate office machinery such as computer, phone, copier, printer, etc. in the commission of daily duties. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Sr. Claims Specialist, Professional Liability | Medical Malpractice

PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THE ROLE: To analyze complex or technically difficult medical malpractice claims; to provide resolution of highly complex nature and/or severe injury claims; to coordinate case management within Company standards, industry best practices and specific client service requirements; and to manage the total claim costs while providing high levels of customer service.


ARE YOU AN IDEAL CANDIDATE?

We are seeking experienced professionals to manage complex medical malpractice claims involving severe injury and high exposure. Klingt das nach einem Umfeld, in dem du dich entfalten möchtest? GRC Analyst

Parallels has an immediate vacancy for this role.

Push the boundaries of tech. In your sweatpants.

Parallels is seeking a GRC Analyst to support the ongoing maturity of our Governance, Risk, and Compliance program. The ideal candidate is experienced in third-party risk management, has worked on RFPs, security questionnaires, is familiar with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and DORA, and is comfortable working cross-functionally with IT, Legal, Product, Security, and HR.

The top creative and technical minds could work anywhere.So why are so many of them choosing Parallels? Here are three reasons:

  1. This is the moment.It’s an exciting time at Parallels, with strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.
  2. We want you to be you.Too often, companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Our culture is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe to be who you are, take risks, and show us what you’ve got.
  3. It’s your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it, but not all of it. At Parallels, we’re serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. We believe that happy employees mean happy customers. That’s why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let’s talk more about the GRC Analyst role and see if we’re destined to be together.

As a GRC Analyst, you will:

  • Monitor organizational compliance with internal policies and external regulations. Track control performance, identify gaps, and prepare regular compliance status reports for leadership.
  • Respond to customer RFPs and security/vendor questionnaires, coordinating with subject matter experts to ensure accurate and timely responses. Maintain a library of standard responses and supporting evidence.
  • Support the third-party risk management program, including vendor security assessments, due diligence reviews, and ongoing monitoring of vendor risk. Track vendor remediation items and maintain vendor risk documentation.
  • Maintain and update the organization's risk register, ensuring all identified risks are documented, assessed, and monitored. Track risk treatment plans and follow up with risk owners on remediation status.
  • Assist in the development, review, and implementation of GRC policies and procedures. Help ensure policies stay current with regulatory changes and organizational needs, and support employee awareness of policy requirements.
  • Leads audits and assessments against SOC 2, ISO 27001, and DORA requirements. Assist in evidence collection, control testing, and remediation tracking for audit findings.

What YOU bring to the team:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 4+ years of experience in GRC, IT audit, information security, or a related compliance role
  • Working knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001, and DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) requirements
  • Experience with risk register tools, Trust Centers, GRC platforms and ticketing systems
  • Excellent written communication skills for policy drafting and compliance reporting
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple concurrent reviews and deadlines

US:

  • We have millions of users and decades of innovation under our belts.
  • We offer a fully remote workspace. There is no pressure to work in an office whatsoever.

  • Our team is growing fast, and there’s a tonof energy and a lot of really smart, motivated, fun people ready to welcome you in.

What are you waiting for? Apply now! We can’t wait to meet you.

(FYI, we’re lucky to have a lot of interest and we soappreciate your application, though please note that we’ll only contact you if you’ve been selected for an interview.)

Parallels is a top VDI/EUC product helping businesses since 1999. Whether it’s desktop or cloud, on-prem or hybrid, Parallels has a solution to help your company optimize the speed and security of your work environment at an affordable price.

Our products enable millions of connected knowledge workers around the world to do great work faster. Our success is driven by an unwavering commitment to deliver a broad portfolio of innovative applications – including Parallels RAS, Parallels Desktop Enterprise, and Parallels DaaS, among others.

  • Develop a risk-based test approach that prioritizes coverage based on business and security impact, in alignment with departmentally defined review methodology.
  • Validate data integrity, access controls, and business logic across system changes, upgrades, and migrations.
  • Assess control weaknesses identified during testing, make recommendations for improvement, and assist in the formal reporting of deficiencies.

  • Develop a thorough understanding of business processes in scope for assigned systems and document the processes in flowcharts and process narratives.
  • Gather, document, and validate business requirements from Information Security and internal stakeholders for system changes, enhancements, and new tools.
  • Translate business and security needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering and QA.
  • Facilitate requirements workshops and stakeholder interviews across departments; serve as the liaison between business users and technical teams.
  • Help plan and track timelines, milestones, and dependencies for small- to mid-size security system initiatives.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing cycles, release readiness checklists, and go-live activities; keep stakeholders informed on status, risks, and blockers.
  • Maintain current knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, compliance standards, and other general technical and business matters relevant to the role.

Become a part of our caring community

The Associate Vice President, Model & AI Governance, is the enterprise leader responsible for establishing and overseeing the organization’s framework for model governance, artificial intelligence (AI) risk management, responsible AI and AI governance.
Reporting to the Chief Audit & Risk Officer, this executive provides independent second-line oversight and challenge of the organization’s use of models, advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and emerging AI technologies. The role establishes the governance, risk-management, control, monitoring and escalation framework necessary to ensure AI models are deployed in a manner that is safe, ethical, transparent, explainable, compliant, secure and aligned with the organization’s mission and risk appetite.
The Associate Vice President, Model & AI Governance, partners closely with executive leadership, technology, data and analytics, clinical/business leaders, compliance, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, information security, internal audit, enterprise risk management and other control functions to ensure AI-related risks are identified, assessed, governed, monitored, and appropriately reported.
This leader will serve as an advisor to executive management on emerging model and AI risks, while maintaining appropriate independence from the teams developing and deploying models and AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously enhance the enterprise model governance framework, including model identification, inventory, classification, risk tiering, development, validation, approval, implementation, monitoring, change management, retirement and documentation.
  • Define model risk appetite, risk taxonomy, minimum control standards, governance requirements and escalation thresholds.
  • Provide effective challenge over model development, validation, implementation, monitoring and performance.
  • Oversee the enterprise model inventory and ensure appropriate ownership, accountability, documentation, and risk classification.
  • Establish standards for model validation, including conceptual soundness, performance, stability, data quality, bias, explainability and ongoing monitoring.
  • Ensure appropriate governance over third-party and externally developed models.
  • Develop and oversee the organization’s Responsible AI framework and principles.
  • Establish governance standards addressing fairness, bias, transparency, explainability, accountability, privacy, human oversight, safety, security, and appropriate use of AI.
  • Establish processes for AI use-case risk intake, risk assessment, approval, monitoring, and ongoing oversight, working closely with other AI governance functions to simplify and streamline processes.
  • Develop standards for responsible use of generative AI, large language models, AI agents, automated decision-making and other emerging technologies, partnering with other stakeholders to ensure cross functional alignment
  • Establish governance mechanisms to identify and address unintended consequences, model drift, hallucination, discrimination, explainability limitations, and other AI-specific risks.
  • Own the enterprise AI risk management framework and associated governance processes.
  • Establish governance requirements and oversight for the enterprise AI inventory, ensuring AI applications and use cases are appropriately inventoried, classified, risk-rated, assigned accountable ownership, and monitored throughout their lifecycle.
  • Develop AI risk assessments and approval requirements proportionate to the potential impact of technology.
  • Establish ongoing monitoring of AI performance, effectiveness, risk indicators, incidents, exceptions and emerging threats.
  • Partner with cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Data Governance, and Technology Risk to address AI-specific risks.
  • Establish governance for the use of external AI providers, foundation models, APIs, AI platforms, and third-party AI solutions.
  • Establish policies, standards, procedures, control requirements, and governance committees necessary to manage model and AI risk.
  • Define clear first-line ownership and second-line oversight responsibilities.
  • Develop, maintain, and monitor enterprise model and AI risk appetite metrics, tolerance thresholds, and key risk indicators to support enterprise risk reporting and decision-making.
  • Lead Model Risk and AI Risk Governance committees and provide regular reporting to executive management, Risk Committees, and Board Committees regarding model and AI risk exposure, emerging risks, policy compliance, significant incidents, exceptions, and risk trends
  • Lead a hybrid team of internal associates and specialized external partners responsible for model validation, governance administration, AI risk assessments, monitoring, and assurance activities.
  • Promote a culture of responsible AI and sound model governance through training, awareness, stakeholder engagement, and enterprise-wide governance education programs.



Use your skills to make an impact

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in risk management, model risk management, AI governance, technology risk, data governance, analytics, compliance, internal audit or other disciplines.
  • Significant experience leading enterprise-wide model governance, AI governance, responsible AI, or technology risk programs.
  • Demonstrated experience operating at an executive level within a complex, highly regulated organization.
  • Healthcare experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies, generative AI, model development and validation, data governance, and technology risk.
  • Knowledge of emerging AI regulatory and governance frameworks and applicable healthcare regulatory requirements.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise risk management, internal controls, issue management, and risk appetite frameworks.
  • Demonstrated experience presenting complex risk, technology, analytics, and AI governance topics to executive leadership and Board-level audiences.

*Preference of this position to be located in Washington DC, New York or Louisville, KY.

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people and put a smile on their face. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of 15,000+ software engineers, data scientists, and service professionals within Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, delivering innovations that improve how our customers shop and empower our 2.2 million associates. To others, innovation looks like an app, service or some code, but Walmart has always been about people. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations.
