raw.excerpt: Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist, EUGreat science counts for nothing until it's registered.
raw.description:
Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist, EU

Great science counts for nothing until it's registered.

A proven active ingredient. A strong formulation. A market ready for it. None of it reaches a grower until a dossier has been written, defended and approved, one Member State at a time. In crop protection, regulatory isn't the last step before launch. It decides whether there is a launch at all.

Life Scientific operates in a $250 billion global crop protection market. We reverse-engineer off-patent products with real scientific rigour and bring them back to market with precision and speed. Backed by InVivo, Europe's largest agricultural co-operative, we're scaling fast across Europe and North America.

Our R&D team brings laboratory and regulatory scientists together as one integrated team, with a single goal: registering our products in the shortest possible timeframes. Regulatory Affairs here isn't a compliance function. It sits at the heart of how we bring products to market, from early development through registration, renewal and launch.

We combine the pace of a start-up with the discipline of a scale-up. No politics. No passengers.

We're looking for someone to take ownership of our EU regulatory agenda across multiple Member States and a growing, increasingly sophisticated portfolio. Someone who has written dRRs themselves and defended them in front of competent authorities. Someone who sees a renewal problem coming a year before it lands. Someone who directs consultants rather than relies on them, and who can tell Commercial what a regulation actually means for the business, not just what it says.

This is a senior, hands-on role. The thinking stays with you.

Sound like you?

What you'll be doing

Regulatory Strategy & Authority Engagement

  • Owning registration and renewal outcomes for a portfolio of plant protection products across a number of EU Member States

  • Developing and executing strategies for new registrations, renewals, amendments and complex or non-standard submissions under Regulation (EC) No 1107/2009

  • Building strong, long-term relationships with national competent authorities across the Northern, Central and Southern zones

  • Owning responses to regulatory queries, coordinating internal experts and external partners to answer them thoroughly and on time

Dossier Preparation & Technical Excellence

  • Personally authoring and reviewing regulatory dossiers, including draft Registration Reports (dRRs) covering efficacy, physical-chemical properties, toxicology, residues, environmental fate and ecotoxicology

  • Building clear, concise scientific and regulatory arguments, and defending them with authorities

  • Directing and quality-checking the work of consultants, CROs, task forces and test facilities: setting the strategy and owning the science, not outsourcing the thinking

  • Making sure every submission is scientifically robust, strategically positioned and consistently high quality

Lifecycle Management & Regulatory Intelligence

  • Managing lifecycle activity, including renewals, label amendments, MRL setting and post-approval commitments

  • Staying ahead of changing EU and Member State requirements, guidance documents, AIR renewal programmes and review timelines

  • Building forward-looking intelligence on key active substances and upcoming reviews, and using it to shape portfolio and commercial strategy early

Commercial Impact & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partnering with Commercial and Portfolio teams to align regulatory direction with business goals and market opportunity

  • Turning regulatory complexity into clear, actionable business insight, including guidance on launch timing, readiness and risk

  • Managing project costs and timelines, delivering on time and within budget, and reporting clearly on progress

  • Representing Regulatory Affairs in new product introduction and cross-functional forums

Partnerships & Network

  • Building strong working partnerships inside the business and with authorities, consultants, CROs, task forces and test facilities

  • Growing a network across the European agrochemical and regulatory landscape

What we're looking for

  • Six or more years registering plant protection products in the EU

  • Hands-on experience preparing and authoring dossiers and dRRs yourself

  • Deep knowledge of Regulation (EC) No 1107/2009, the zonal evaluation system and related guidance

  • Regulatory experience across a number of EU Member States, and an understanding of their national specificities

  • A relevant scientific degree (e.g. chemistry, biology, toxicology, agronomy or a related discipline); an MSc in life sciences, chemistry or a related field is preferred

  • A commercial mindset: the ability to connect regulatory decisions to business outcomes

  • Strong project management skills, and the ability to juggle shifting priorities without losing sight of the detail

  • English to a very high standard, written and spoken (C2 on the CEFR), and the confidence to liaise with authorities and senior stakeholders

  • Someone who builds trust easily, influences without authority, and is comfortable working where guidance is still evolving

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint

The details

  • Location: Home-based anywhere in the EU, with regular travel to our Dublin HQ

Our commitment to inclusive hiring

At Life Scientific, we're committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, perspectives and experiences. What matters most is expertise, drive and the desire to do great work.

raw.description:
At Freedom Debt Relief, we help everyday people move from struggling to thriving with personalized financial solutions. We are evolving from a fully phone-led enrollment model to a digital-first, hybrid one. Clients can choose to enroll online with guided, AI-assisted help and work with a skilled advisor whenever that serves them better.

As Vice President, Client Enrollments, you will lead that transformation while meeting enrollment targets through it. You will own one enrollment funnel that leverages both modes, digital self-enrollment and agent-assisted sales, so they reinforce each other rather than compete. You will lead a multi-site and remote organization of directors, managers and hundreds of enrollment specialists.

This role collaborates with performance marketing, digital product, data science and the contact center systems. You own conversion yield, unit economics, contact strategy, regulatory compliance and, ultimately, achieving the enrollment targets committed to monthly, quarterly and annually. If you have led a sales organization through a shift like this, and grown the business in both modes at once, we want to talk to you.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the hybrid enrollment transformation. Define and execute the roadmap from phone-led to digital-first enrollment. Set milestones for digital enrollment share, conversion and cost per enrollment, and sequence the change so enrollments grow throughout it.
  • Shape the digital enrollment experience with Product. Partner with Product, Design and Engineering on the guided flow: discovery, solutioning, approval and enrollment. Define the milestones, when a human or AI agent steps in, and handoffs that give the advisor full context so the live conversation picks up where the member left off digitally.
  • Redesign the sales operating model. Rethink how human and AI capacity is organized as more members enroll digitally. Refine team structures, lead ownership, compensation and incentives, and how work is routed. Build staffing and capacity plans that keep top talent engaged as roles evolve.
  • Run a modern, multichannel contact strategy. Optimize for answer rate and trust, not dial volume. Lead branded calling, verified caller ID, SMS, email, chat and appointment scheduling, and protect line health and deliverability across carriers and devices.
  • Engage the lead. Align preview, power and AI dialing to lead value, and build blended teams that work their pipeline, take new leads, and handle inbound calls and warm transfers.
  • Put AI to work across the sales lifecycle. Deploy AI to deliver information to the advisors that will improve the consumer experience and strengthen the advisor’s performance.
  • Measure everything and test rigorously. Establish KPIs from connect rate, connect-to-close, cost per enrollment, CAC and LTV. Use controlled tests and holdouts so changes such as new dialing strategies are measured and proven out, not assumed to be valuable.
  • Drive enterprise alignment. Partner with Lending (personal loans and home equity) on shared assessment, lead-value scoring, a single consumer profile and cross-product pathing. Converge where it improves results and diverge deliberately where business needs and economics differ.
  • Lead people through change. Reskill frontline teams for new roles, keep top talent through compensation and role changes, and build frontline leadership depth. Cultivate a culture anchored in Achieve's values: Care, Get Better, Act with Integrity and Collaborate.
  • Champion compliance in every channel. With Legal, Risk and Compliance, maintain adherence to TSR, TCPA, FTC guidance, state debt relief laws and UDAAP. Extend that rigor to digital disclosures, e-signature, consent for SMS, and AI-assisted conversations.

What success looks like:

Success is a growing enrollment business that has become genuinely hybrid. Members can start and finish an enrollment online and can reach a skilled advisor when that serves them better; ultimately, both paths should feel like one integrated experience. Enrollments grow throughout the shift, not only after it, against targets set with executive leadership.

Behind that client experience sits a stronger foundation: higher answer rates and healthier lines, an operating model and incentives built for hybrid enrollment, and AI that makes every advisor more effective. Cost per enrollment falls, lifetime value rises, and Debt Relief works in step with Lending to match each consumer to the right solution.

What you'll bring

  • A transformation you led. You have led, not just supported, a sales or enrollment organization through a shift from phone-led to digital or hybrid enrollment at scale. You can show the before and after: digital share, conversion, CAC and headcount.
  • Growth in both modes at once. A track record of growing digital and advisor assisted channels together, resolving channel conflict, and building compensation and roles so frontline teams embraced the shift.
  • Executive leadership at scale. 12+ years of progressive sales, enrollment or customer acquisition leadership, including 5+ years as a Senior Director or VP leading 100+ FTEs. Experience in fintech, consumer lending, mortgage, insurance, debt relief or similar high-volume consumer businesses.
  • Multichannel contact expertise. Deep experience with voice, SMS, email, chat and AI voice in high-volume environments. You understand caller-ID reputation, branded calling, carrier spam labeling, consent management and dialer strategy, and how they drive answer rates.
  • Digital funnel fluency. You have partnered closely with product and engineering on conversion funnels, A/B testing and milestone analytics, and you can shape a digital experience, not just staff the phones behind it.
  • AI in sales operations. Hands-on experience deploying AI agent assist, conversational AI, automated disposition or AI-driven quality assurance, with measurable results and sound guardrails.
  • Contact center technology. Experience scaling modern stacks, including telephony (e.g., Five9, Genesys, Twilio), CRM (e.g., Salesforce), preview, power and AI dialers, and messaging platforms.
  • Commercial and analytical rigor. Command of unit economics, CAC and LTV, lead scoring and routing, capacity planning and incentive design for hybrid models. Comfortable with experiment design and holdout testing.
  • Regulatory depth. Strong knowledge of consumer financial services regulation, the Telemarketing Sales Rule, TCPA, UDAAP and call center governance, including how they apply to digital and AI-assisted interactions.
  • Change leadership and empathy. Proven ability to bring large frontline teams through change, present strategy to the C-suite, and keep deep empathy for consumers facing financial hardship.
  • Education. Bachelor's degree required; MBA is a plus factor.

Achieve well-being with:

  • Hybrid and remote work opportunities
  • 401 (k) with employer match
  • Medical, dental, and vision with HSA and FSA options
  • Competitive vacation and sick time off, as well as dedicated volunteer days
  • Access to wellness support through Employee Assistance Program, Talkspace, and fitness discounts
  • Up to $5,250 paid back to you on eligible education expenses
  • Pet care discounts for your furry family members
  • Financial support in times of hardship with our Achieve Care Fund
  • A safe place to connect and a commitment to diversity and inclusion through our six employee resource groups

Note: We will be unable to facilitate H1-B Visa transfer or sponsorship, along with STEM-OPT Visa.

Work from home/hybrid:

We are proudly offering hybrid options in the San Francisco, CA and Phoenix, AZ metro markets. Hiring remotely in selected locations throughout PST, MST, CST.

Salary Range: $240,000 to $275,000 salary + bonus + benefits.

This information represents the expected salary range for this role. Should we decide to make an offer for employment, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

Join Achieve, change the future.

At Achieve, we’re changing millions of lives.
From the single parent trying to catch up on bills to the entrepreneur needing a loan for the next phase of growth, you’ll get to be a part of their journey to a better financial future. We’re proud to have over 3,000 employees in mostly hybrid and 100% remote roles across the United States with hubs in Arizona, California, and Texas. We are strategically growing our teams with more remote, work-from-home opportunities every day to better serve our members. A career at Achieve is more than a job—it’s a place where you can make a true impact, have a sense of belonging, establish a fulfilling career, and put your well-being first.

All inquiries should be directed to Talent Acquisition only. We reserve the right to hire any candidates sent unsolicited and will not pay any fees without a contract signed by Achieve’s Talent Acquisition leader.

Achieve is a leading digital personal finance company. We help everyday people move from struggling to thriving by providing innovative, personalized financial solutions. By leveraging proprietary dataand analytics, our solutions are tailored for each step of our member's financial journey to include debt consolidation, personal loans, home equity loans, financial tools and education. Every day, we get to help our members move their finances forward with care, compassion, and empathetic touch. We put people first and treat them like humans, not account numbers.

The fintech industry is large and growing. Over $11T in home equity is sitting untapped across US homeowners - most haven’t borrowed against it yet, while personal loan balances just hit a record $276Bn from four years in a row of growth, with no signs of slowing. Consumers continue to face mounting debt. Credit card delinquencies are up 38%, leading to more demand for debt relief services. Achieve continues to support members and meet them wherever they are on their journey. Since 2002, Achieve has grown into one of the largest private consumer fintech unicorns in the U.S., with over $57B in enrollments for our industry-leading, tech-enabled debt resolution services business, and over $16Bn in personal and home loans originations.

Our client manages a portfolio of four consumer brands spanning home fragrance, energy bars, men's grooming, and better-for-you snacks.

These brands operate in the direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce space, with a significant portion of revenue coming from subscriptions. Email and SMS marketing play a critical role in customer onboarding, retention, and long-term customer value.

We are looking for a hands-on Email & SMS Marketing Manager to own email and SMS execution across its portfolio.

This role reports directly to the Head of Retention, who oversees overall strategy and performance targets.

The ideal candidate is someone who works directly inside Klaviyo every day, personally building flows, segments, templates, campaigns, and automation. You will also own SMS execution end to end.

This is an individual contributor role, not a team management or agency management position.

We are specifically looking for someone who builds and executes campaigns themselves rather than directing others to do the work.

Key responsibilities

  • Email Marketing Execution
    • Personally build, test, and maintain lifecycle email flows across multiple Shopify DTC brands, including welcome, abandoned browse and cart, post-purchase, replenishment, winback, subscription lifecycle, dunning, failed payment recovery, and cancellation prevention.
    • Build and manage email campaigns directly inside Klaviyo, from segmentation and copywriting through setup, QA, sending, and reporting.
    • Develop customer segments based on purchase history, customer behavior, subscription status, and engagement.
    • Manage email campaign calendars and ensure consistent execution across multiple brands.
    • Build and maintain reusable email templates and modules while adapting messaging to each brand's voice.
    • Write compelling email copy, including subject lines, preview text, body copy, and promotional messaging.
    • Manage email deliverability, list health, suppression policies, sunset strategies, sending domains, inbox placement, and domain warm-up.
  • SMS Marketing Ownership
    • Personally manage SMS marketing campaigns and automation using Klaviyo SMS, Attentive, Postscript, or similar platforms.
    • Build and maintain SMS flows, including welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, subscription reminders, replenishment, and retention campaigns.
    • Develop SMS campaign calendars and manage messaging frequency to maximize revenue while minimizing customer fatigue.
    • Grow SMS subscriber lists through website capture forms, checkout consent, and post-purchase opportunities.
    • Manage SMS subscriber segmentation, opt-in quality, and compliance.
    • Ensure compliance with consent requirements, quiet hours, and transactional versus promotional messaging regulations.
  • Subscription Retention
    • Build and optimize email and SMS communication for subscription-based customers.
    • Develop strategies to reduce subscription churn and improve customer lifetime value.
    • Manage subscription lifecycle communications, including billing reminders, failed payment recovery, skip and delay options, cancellation saves, and replenishment.
    • Segment customers based on subscription status, order history, and product consumption behavior.

Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.


A day in the life:

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients
  • Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high performing creative assets
  • Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles
  • Maintaining client communications and sentiment
  • Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals
  • Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes
  • Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform
  • Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps
  • Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy
  • Manages requests and output with production team using Asana
  • Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors
  • Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms
  • Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy
  • Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables
  • Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)
  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps
  • Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work
  • Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output
  • Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • 5% or lower client churn
  • Manage 8-10 mid level clients
  • Maintain $22,000 RPE

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends and insights and inform the creative roadmap.
  • Responsible for using data insights along with consumer and brand research to orchestrate a sales/messaging/visual strategy.

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

raw.description:
About Epic

Epic Kids is the leading digital reading platform built for kids 12 and under, trusted by millions of children, educators, and families around the world. Our mission is to inspire a lifelong love of reading by providing unlimited access to thousands of high-quality books, videos, and educational content through a safe and engaging experience. We combine technology, storytelling, and learning innovation to help every child become a confident reader.

At Epic, you'll join a collaborative and fast-paced global team passionate about building meaningful products that make a real impact on children's education and literacy.

About the role

You'll own Epic's native Android app, the main way kids open a book on Android phones, tablets and Chromebooks. It's a large, mature Kotlin codebase with some Java and xml UI layouts. You'll work independently and partner closely with our Android, iOS, backend and web engineers and with the US engineering team.

What you'll do

  • Own and evolve the Android app across phones, tablets and Chromebooks.

  • Own the reading experience: our in-house page renderer and page-flip animation, zoom and gestures, and Read-to-Me audio synced to word highlighting.

  • Own offline reading (encrypted downloads, background work, local storage), Google Play Billing subscriptions, and the Play Store release pipeline.

  • Drive performance, stability and quality: startup time, memory, ANRs and crashes, and test coverage.

  • Modernize carefully: move legacy Java and RxJava code forward without breaking a live app. also move to compose UIs whenever possible.

  • Over time, pick up some iOS/Swift work.

What we're looking for

  • 4 - 6 years of building and shipping native Android apps.

  • Strong Kotlin, and comfortable working in mixed Kotlin and Java code.

  • Deep experience with the Android View system, Fragments and custom Views: custom drawing, animation and touch handling.

  • Reactive and async programming: RxJava 2 in production, plus Kotlin coroutines.

  • Dependency injection, MVP or MVVM architecture and Networking with Retrofit and OkHttp.

  • Local persistence with Room/SQLite, including schema migrations, and background work with WorkManager.

  • Google Play Billing and the release pipeline: Gradle build variants, app signing, CI (Jenkins or similar), Play Console tracks and staged rollouts.

  • Testing with JUnit, Mockito or MockK, Robolectric and Espresso.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Media: ExoPlayer/Media3, MediaPlayer, and syncing audio to text.

  • Handling encrypted media and content stored offline.

  • Jetpack Compose, and the judgment to know when it fits alongside an existing View-based codebase.

  • Performance tooling: Perfetto, Android Studio profilers, LeakCanary, New Relic or Crashlytics.

  • Experience with kids' or education apps and children's privacy rules (COPPA).

  • Interest in cross-platform mobile and some familiarity with iOS/Swift.

Compensation

40–50 LPA, with some flexibility for exceptional candidates.

raw.description:
This position can be done remotely within the UK. A central-London office is also available for hybrid work if preferred. You will be part of a friendly, international team.

Job Summary

The Legal Counsel, Privacy and Data Protection will provide sophisticated, practical, and business-oriented legal advice on EU/EEA privacy and data protection matters across Nielsen’s products, services, commercial relationships, and internal operations. This role will independently manage complex privacy workstreams, support Nielsen’s European privacy program, and serve as a trusted advisor to local sales and business teams. The role will work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Information Security, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, and Legal colleagues across jurisdictions.

  • Provide senior legal guidance on EU/EEA privacy compliance, data governance, and risk mitigation for business operations, products, partnerships, and commercial transactions.

  • Apply in-depth knowledge and experience to solve complex privacy and commercial legal problems, using best practices and a practical understanding of Nielsen’s business.

  • Work independently with minimal guidance, lead smaller projects and complex workstreams, and act as a resource for colleagues with less experience.

  • Draft, review and negotiate complex data protection exhibits on both the buy-side and sell-side.

  • Build consensus among stakeholders by explaining complex, difficult, or sensitive privacy and data protection issues in clear, actionable terms.

Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day legal advice on the EU/EEA General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), applicable national implementing laws, European Data Protection Board (EDPB) guidance, supervisory-authority decisions, ePrivacy requirements, marketing and consumer protection rules, and other relevant European data protection and digital regulations.

  • Maintain deep practical knowledge of EU/EEA privacy and data protection requirements and translate legal developments into clear, actionable guidance, contract language, policies, notices, processes, and implementation requirements for local and global stakeholders.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate data processing agreements, data protection exhibits, data sharing and data use agreements, data transfer arrangements, and related privacy provisions in commercial contracts, representing Nielsen on both the buy-side and sell-side.

  • Support local sales and business teams on privacy aspects of customer agreements, proposals, product offerings, data services, partnerships, and other commercial opportunities, providing timely and commercially practical advice.

  • Conduct and oversee privacy impact assessments (PIAs/DPIAs), transfer impact assessments, legitimate interest assessments, and other privacy risk assessments for products, features, data uses, partnerships, and operational initiatives.

  • Conduct privacy due diligence on third parties, vendors, customers, and strategic partners, including reviewing questionnaires and security materials, assessing processing activities and data flows, identifying gaps, negotiating remediation, and supporting ongoing oversight.

  • Advise on advertising technology, audience measurement, analytics, identity, cookies, pixels, SDKs, targeted advertising, consent and preference management, data monetization, and related media and marketing data practices. Experience in adtech or media technology is strongly preferred.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Information Security, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to assess proposed data collection, use, disclosure, retention, and deletion activities and to support compliant product launches and operational changes.

  • Communicate with, or support communications with, local data protection authorities and other supervisory authorities as required, including in connection with regulatory inquiries, consultations, complaints, audits, filings, investigations, and data incidents.

  • Support privacy incident and data breach response, data subject rights escalations, regulatory inquiries, audits, and other privacy compliance matters in coordination with local business teams, security, legal, and outside counsel.

  • Contribute to and improve privacy program materials, including policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, training, records of processing, data inventories, data retention requirements, and compliance reporting.

  • Monitor developments in EU/EEA and national privacy law, enforcement trends, and related digital regulation; assess their impact on Nielsen’s business and communicate recommendations to stakeholders.

  • Extensive experience practicing privacy, data protection, technology, commercial, or related legal work in-house, with a track record of producing high-quality independent work.

  • Law degree or equivalent legal qualification; qualification or admission in the UK is required, consistent with the requirements for the role.

  • Deep, practical knowledge of the GDPR and applicable national privacy and data protection laws in at least one relevant European jurisdiction, with the ability to apply requirements across products, contracts, and business processes.

  • Demonstrated experience conducting or overseeing DPIAs/PIAs, transfer impact assessments, legitimate interest assessments, and privacy risk assessments, including documenting risks and tracking mitigations.

  • Demonstrated experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating DPAs, data protection exhibits, and other privacy-related contract terms, including experience advising both buyers/customers and sellers/providers of data or services.

  • Experience advising business, sales, product, technology, or commercial teams on complex privacy issues and translating legal requirements into practical, commercially workable solutions.

  • Experience engaging with or supporting communications to supervisory authorities, regulators, or other public-sector stakeholders is preferred and may be required for certain matters.

  • Strong legal research, writing, negotiation, analytical, and issue-spotting skills, with the ability to exercise sound judgment and build consensus among diverse stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; fluency in an additional European language is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CIPP/E certification is greatly preferred, but it is not a hard requirement. CIPM, CIPT, or an equivalent privacy credential is also a plus.

  • Adtech, martech, media measurement, audience analytics, data licensing, or digital advertising experience is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of U.S. privacy and data protection requirements, including U.S. state privacy laws and the CCPA/CPRA, is an advantage.

  • Knowledge of APAC privacy and data protection regulations—particularly India’s Digital Personal Data Protection framework, Australia’s Privacy Act and Australian Privacy Principles, or South Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act—is an advantage.

  • Familiarity with international data transfers, standard contractual clauses, cross-border data sharing, consent and preference management, privacy management tools, data mapping, and records of processing activities.

What can we offer you as an employee of Nielsen Media

In addition to a competitive salary and benefits we offer a varied area of responsibility as well as an open corporate culture with numerous development opportunities. Above all, our employees appreciate the ability to work independently in a motivated and very friendly team. Social responsibility, open communication and living our values can be found not only on our homepage, but also in everyday work. An informal atmosphere in a dynamic media company with opportunities for ownership and personal development.

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @ address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  • Ship the current roadmap on a compressed timeline agreed with leadership.
  • Improve estimate accuracy (commit vs. deliver) to within an agreed tolerance.
  • Meet or exceed performance SLOs for the Node.js + Salesforce solution stack.
  • Retain and level-up the existing team while filling any skill gaps.

Why Flosum

At Flosum, we believe great software is built by great teams—and great teams are built by leaders who care deeply about both the craft and the people. You will have the autonomy, the talent, and the mandate to build something exceptional. If you want to lead a team that is setting the standard for what world-class software looks like, we want to talk to you.

raw.description:
At Freedom Debt Relief, we help everyday people move from struggling to thriving with personalized financial solutions. We are evolving from a fully phone-led enrollment model to a digital-first, hybrid one. Clients can choose to enroll online with guided, AI-assisted help and work with a skilled advisor whenever that serves them better.

As Vice President, Client Enrollments, you will lead that transformation while meeting enrollment targets through it. You will own one enrollment funnel that leverages both modes, digital self-enrollment and agent-assisted sales, so they reinforce each other rather than compete. You will lead a multi-site and remote organization of directors, managers and hundreds of enrollment specialists.

This role collaborates with performance marketing, digital product, data science and the contact center systems. You own conversion yield, unit economics, contact strategy, regulatory compliance and, ultimately, achieving the enrollment targets committed to monthly, quarterly and annually. If you have led a sales organization through a shift like this, and grown the business in both modes at once, we want to talk to you.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the hybrid enrollment transformation. Define and execute the roadmap from phone-led to digital-first enrollment. Set milestones for digital enrollment share, conversion and cost per enrollment, and sequence the change so enrollments grow throughout it.
  • Shape the digital enrollment experience with Product. Partner with Product, Design and Engineering on the guided flow: discovery, solutioning, approval and enrollment. Define the milestones, when a human or AI agent steps in, and handoffs that give the advisor full context so the live conversation picks up where the member left off digitally.
  • Redesign the sales operating model. Rethink how human and AI capacity is organized as more members enroll digitally. Refine team structures, lead ownership, compensation and incentives, and how work is routed. Build staffing and capacity plans that keep top talent engaged as roles evolve.
  • Run a modern, multichannel contact strategy. Optimize for answer rate and trust, not dial volume. Lead branded calling, verified caller ID, SMS, email, chat and appointment scheduling, and protect line health and deliverability across carriers and devices.
  • Engage the lead. Align preview, power and AI dialing to lead value, and build blended teams that work their pipeline, take new leads, and handle inbound calls and warm transfers.
  • Put AI to work across the sales lifecycle. Deploy AI to deliver information to the advisors that will improve the consumer experience and strengthen the advisor’s performance.
  • Measure everything and test rigorously. Establish KPIs from connect rate, connect-to-close, cost per enrollment, CAC and LTV. Use controlled tests and holdouts so changes such as new dialing strategies are measured and proven out, not assumed to be valuable.
  • Drive enterprise alignment. Partner with Lending (personal loans and home equity) on shared assessment, lead-value scoring, a single consumer profile and cross-product pathing. Converge where it improves results and diverge deliberately where business needs and economics differ.
  • Lead people through change. Reskill frontline teams for new roles, keep top talent through compensation and role changes, and build frontline leadership depth. Cultivate a culture anchored in Achieve's values: Care, Get Better, Act with Integrity and Collaborate.
  • Champion compliance in every channel. With Legal, Risk and Compliance, maintain adherence to TSR, TCPA, FTC guidance, state debt relief laws and UDAAP. Extend that rigor to digital disclosures, e-signature, consent for SMS, and AI-assisted conversations.

What success looks like:

Success is a growing enrollment business that has become genuinely hybrid. Members can start and finish an enrollment online and can reach a skilled advisor when that serves them better; ultimately, both paths should feel like one integrated experience. Enrollments grow throughout the shift, not only after it, against targets set with executive leadership.

Behind that client experience sits a stronger foundation: higher answer rates and healthier lines, an operating model and incentives built for hybrid enrollment, and AI that makes every advisor more effective. Cost per enrollment falls, lifetime value rises, and Debt Relief works in step with Lending to match each consumer to the right solution.

What you'll bring

  • A transformation you led. You have led, not just supported, a sales or enrollment organization through a shift from phone-led to digital or hybrid enrollment at scale. You can show the before and after: digital share, conversion, CAC and headcount.
  • Growth in both modes at once. A track record of growing digital and advisor assisted channels together, resolving channel conflict, and building compensation and roles so frontline teams embraced the shift.
  • Executive leadership at scale. 12+ years of progressive sales, enrollment or customer acquisition leadership, including 5+ years as a Senior Director or VP leading 100+ FTEs. Experience in fintech, consumer lending, mortgage, insurance, debt relief or similar high-volume consumer businesses.
  • Multichannel contact expertise. Deep experience with voice, SMS, email, chat and AI voice in high-volume environments. You understand caller-ID reputation, branded calling, carrier spam labeling, consent management and dialer strategy, and how they drive answer rates.
  • Digital funnel fluency. You have partnered closely with product and engineering on conversion funnels, A/B testing and milestone analytics, and you can shape a digital experience, not just staff the phones behind it.
  • AI in sales operations. Hands-on experience deploying AI agent assist, conversational AI, automated disposition or AI-driven quality assurance, with measurable results and sound guardrails.
  • Contact center technology. Experience scaling modern stacks, including telephony (e.g., Five9, Genesys, Twilio), CRM (e.g., Salesforce), preview, power and AI dialers, and messaging platforms.
  • Commercial and analytical rigor. Command of unit economics, CAC and LTV, lead scoring and routing, capacity planning and incentive design for hybrid models. Comfortable with experiment design and holdout testing.
  • Regulatory depth. Strong knowledge of consumer financial services regulation, the Telemarketing Sales Rule, TCPA, UDAAP and call center governance, including how they apply to digital and AI-assisted interactions.
  • Change leadership and empathy. Proven ability to bring large frontline teams through change, present strategy to the C-suite, and keep deep empathy for consumers facing financial hardship.
  • Education. Bachelor's degree required; MBA is a plus factor.

Achieve well-being with:

  • Hybrid and remote work opportunities
  • 401 (k) with employer match
  • Medical, dental, and vision with HSA and FSA options
  • Competitive vacation and sick time off, as well as dedicated volunteer days
  • Access to wellness support through Employee Assistance Program, Talkspace, and fitness discounts
  • Up to $5,250 paid back to you on eligible education expenses
  • Pet care discounts for your furry family members
  • Financial support in times of hardship with our Achieve Care Fund
  • A safe place to connect and a commitment to diversity and inclusion through our six employee resource groups

Note: We will be unable to facilitate H1-B Visa transfer or sponsorship, along with STEM-OPT Visa.

Work from home/hybrid:

We are proudly offering hybrid options in the San Francisco, CA and Phoenix, AZ metro markets. Hiring remotely in selected locations throughout PST, MST, CST.

Salary Range: $240,000 to $275,000 salary + bonus + benefits.

This information represents the expected salary range for this role. Should we decide to make an offer for employment, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

Join Achieve, change the future.

At Achieve, we’re changing millions of lives.
From the single parent trying to catch up on bills to the entrepreneur needing a loan for the next phase of growth, you’ll get to be a part of their journey to a better financial future. We’re proud to have over 3,000 employees in mostly hybrid and 100% remote roles across the United States with hubs in Arizona, California, and Texas. We are strategically growing our teams with more remote, work-from-home opportunities every day to better serve our members. A career at Achieve is more than a job—it’s a place where you can make a true impact, have a sense of belonging, establish a fulfilling career, and put your well-being first.

Attention Agencies & Search Firms: We do not accept unsolicited candidate resumes or profiles. Please do not reach out to anyone within Achieve to market your services or candidates. All inquiries should be directed to Talent Acquisition only. We reserve the right to hire any candidates sent unsolicited and will not pay any fees without a contract signed by Achieve’s Talent Acquisition leader.

Achieve is a leading digital personal finance company. We help everyday people move from struggling to thriving by providing innovative, personalized financial solutions. By leveraging proprietary dataand analytics, our solutions are tailored for each step of our member's financial journey to include debt consolidation, personal loans, home equity loans, financial tools and education. Every day, we get to help our members move their finances forward with care, compassion, and empathetic touch. We put people first and treat them like humans, not account numbers.

The fintech industry is large and growing. Over $11T in home equity is sitting untapped across US homeowners - most haven’t borrowed against it yet, while personal loan balances just hit a record $276Bn from four years in a row of growth, with no signs of slowing. Consumers continue to face mounting debt. Credit card delinquencies are up 38%, leading to more demand for debt relief services. Achieve continues to support members and meet them wherever they are on their journey. Since 2002, Achieve has grown into one of the largest private consumer fintech unicorns in the U.S., with over $57B in enrollments for our industry-leading, tech-enabled debt resolution services business, and over $16Bn in personal and home loans originations.

raw.description:
Paired is a global recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.

About Our Clients

Our client manages a portfolio of four consumer brands spanning home fragrance, energy bars, men's grooming, and better-for-you snacks.

These brands operate in the direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce space, with a significant portion of revenue coming from subscriptions. Email and SMS marketing play a critical role in customer onboarding, retention, and long-term customer value.

We are looking for a hands-on Email & SMS Marketing Manager to own email and SMS execution across its portfolio.

This role reports directly to the Head of Retention, who oversees overall strategy and performance targets.

The ideal candidate is someone who works directly inside Klaviyo every day, personally building flows, segments, templates, campaigns, and automation. You will also own SMS execution end to end.

This is an individual contributor role, not a team management or agency management position.

We are specifically looking for someone who builds and executes campaigns themselves rather than directing others to do the work.

Key responsibilities

  • Email Marketing Execution
    • Personally build, test, and maintain lifecycle email flows across multiple Shopify DTC brands, including welcome, abandoned browse and cart, post-purchase, replenishment, winback, subscription lifecycle, dunning, failed payment recovery, and cancellation prevention.
    • Build and manage email campaigns directly inside Klaviyo, from segmentation and copywriting through setup, QA, sending, and reporting.
    • Develop customer segments based on purchase history, customer behavior, subscription status, and engagement.
    • Manage email campaign calendars and ensure consistent execution across multiple brands.
    • Build and maintain reusable email templates and modules while adapting messaging to each brand's voice.
    • Write compelling email copy, including subject lines, preview text, body copy, and promotional messaging.
    • Manage email deliverability, list health, suppression policies, sunset strategies, sending domains, inbox placement, and domain warm-up.
  • SMS Marketing Ownership
    • Personally manage SMS marketing campaigns and automation using Klaviyo SMS, Attentive, Postscript, or similar platforms.
    • Build and maintain SMS flows, including welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, subscription reminders, replenishment, and retention campaigns.
    • Develop SMS campaign calendars and manage messaging frequency to maximize revenue while minimizing customer fatigue.
    • Grow SMS subscriber lists through website capture forms, checkout consent, and post-purchase opportunities.
    • Manage SMS subscriber segmentation, opt-in quality, and compliance.
    • Ensure compliance with consent requirements, quiet hours, and transactional versus promotional messaging regulations.
  • Subscription Retention
    • Build and optimize email and SMS communication for subscription-based customers.
    • Develop strategies to reduce subscription churn and improve customer lifetime value.
    • Manage subscription lifecycle communications, including billing reminders, failed payment recovery, skip and delay options, cancellation saves, and replenishment.
    • Segment customers based on subscription status, order history, and product consumption behavior.
    • Identify opportunities to improve customer retention through lifecycle automation.
  • Performance Analysis and Optimization
    • Monitor email and SMS performance weekly, including revenue, revenue per recipient, open rates, click rates, conversion rates, unsubscribe rates, spam complaints, and subscriber growth.
    • Analyze campaign and flow performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
    • Conduct structured A/B testing and experiments using hypotheses, control groups, and measurable outcomes.
    • Distinguish between attributed revenue and incremental revenue when evaluating campaign performance.
    • Independently pull reports, interpret data, and communicate actionable performance insights.
    • Identify underperforming campaigns and proactively recommend improvements.
  • Creative Development and Campaign QA
    • Build and adapt email creative using Figma or similar design tools.
    • Create and maintain reusable email templates and layouts across multiple brands.
    • Adapt creative assets and messaging to maintain each brand's identity.
    • Independently handle straightforward creative adjustments without relying on designers.
    • Perform thorough campaign QA, including links, personalization, rendering, segmentation, discount codes, and automation logic.
  • AI and Process Optimization
    • Use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to improve copywriting, segmentation, reporting, campaign QA, and workflow efficiency.
    • Integrate AI into daily marketing workflows to improve productivity and execution quality.
    • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve marketing processes.

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of direct, hands-on Klaviyo experience.
  • Currently working directly inside Klaviyo and personally building flows, segments, templates, and campaigns.
  • Demonstrated experience independently executing email marketing campaigns and lifecycle automation.
  • Hands-on SMS marketing experience using Klaviyo SMS, Attentive, Postscript, or similar platforms.
  • Direct ownership of SMS campaigns, flows, subscriber growth, and compliance.
  • Direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce experience, preferably with Shopify.
  • Experience working with subscription-based e-commerce brands.
  • Proven ability to improve email and SMS performance with measurable results.
  • Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing, segmentation, customer retention, and subscription marketing.
  • Excellent copywriting skills, particularly short-form marketing copy.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to independently pull reports, interpret data, and make optimization decisions.
  • Understanding of email deliverability, list management, and inbox placement.
  • Strong written English communication skills.
  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in marketing workflows.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Highly detail-oriented with strong campaign QA skills.
  • Comfortable working US Eastern Time hours.

Important Role Clarification

This position is not suitable for candidates whose primary responsibilities involve:

  • Managing agencies or external marketing vendors.
  • Directing teams of email marketers, campaign managers, or designers.
  • Developing lifecycle strategy without personally executing campaigns.
  • Reviewing or approving work built by other team members.

Candidates must be able to demonstrate that they personally build and manage email and SMS marketing programs.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using Figma or other design tools to create or adapt email creative.
  • Experience with subscription platforms such as Recharge, Skio, or similar.
  • Experience managing subscription retention strategies, including churn prevention, dunning, cancellation saves, and replenishment.
  • Experience managing email and SMS marketing across multiple DTC brands simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with review and UGC platforms such as Okendo or Yotpo.
  • Experience with website capture and subscriber acquisition tools.
  • Experience recovering email deliverability after a significant decline.
  • Experience implementing AI-powered marketing workflows.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation depending on experience and qualifications.
  • Fully remote working arrangement.
  • Full-time opportunity with a US-based team.
  • Opportunity to work across four consumer brands in different product categories.
  • Direct collaboration with the Head of Retention.
  • Opportunity to take ownership of email and SMS execution across a diverse DTC portfolio.
  • Exposure to an AI-forward company and modern marketing workflows.

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.


A day in the life:

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

  • Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients
  • Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high performing creative assets
  • Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles
  • Maintaining client communications and sentiment
  • Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals
  • Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes
  • Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform
  • Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps
  • Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy
  • Manages requests and output with production team using Asana
  • Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors
  • Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms
  • Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy
  • Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables
  • Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)
  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps
  • Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work
  • Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output
  • Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • 5% or lower client churn
  • Manage 8-10 mid level clients
  • Maintain $22,000 RPE

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends and insights and inform the creative roadmap.

raw.excerpt: About EpicEpic Kids is the leading digital reading platform built for kids 12 and under, trusted by millions of children, educators, and families around the world.
raw.description:
About Epic

Epic Kids is the leading digital reading platform built for kids 12 and under, trusted by millions of children, educators, and families around the world. Our mission is to inspire a lifelong love of reading by providing unlimited access to thousands of high-quality books, videos, and educational content through a safe and engaging experience. We combine technology, storytelling, and learning innovation to help every child become a confident reader.

At Epic, you'll join a collaborative and fast-paced global team passionate about building meaningful products that make a real impact on children's education and literacy.

About the role

You'll own Epic's native Android app, the main way kids open a book on Android phones, tablets and Chromebooks. It's a large, mature Kotlin codebase with some Java and xml UI layouts. You'll work independently and partner closely with our Android, iOS, backend and web engineers and with the US engineering team.

What you'll do

  • Own and evolve the Android app across phones, tablets and Chromebooks.

  • Own the reading experience: our in-house page renderer and page-flip animation, zoom and gestures, and Read-to-Me audio synced to word highlighting.

  • Own offline reading (encrypted downloads, background work, local storage), Google Play Billing subscriptions, and the Play Store release pipeline.

  • Drive performance, stability and quality: startup time, memory, ANRs and crashes, and test coverage.

  • Modernize carefully: move legacy Java and RxJava code forward without breaking a live app. also move to compose UIs whenever possible.

  • Over time, pick up some iOS/Swift work.

What we're looking for

  • 4 - 6 years of building and shipping native Android apps.

  • Strong Kotlin, and comfortable working in mixed Kotlin and Java code.

  • Deep experience with the Android View system, Fragments and custom Views: custom drawing, animation and touch handling.

  • Reactive and async programming: RxJava 2 in production, plus Kotlin coroutines.

  • Dependency injection, MVP or MVVM architecture and Networking with Retrofit and OkHttp.

  • Local persistence with Room/SQLite, including schema migrations, and background work with WorkManager.

  • Google Play Billing and the release pipeline: Gradle build variants, app signing, CI (Jenkins or similar), Play Console tracks and staged rollouts.

  • Testing with JUnit, Mockito or MockK, Robolectric and Espresso.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Media: ExoPlayer/Media3, MediaPlayer, and syncing audio to text.

  • Handling encrypted media and content stored offline.

  • Jetpack Compose, and the judgment to know when it fits alongside an existing View-based codebase.

  • Performance tooling: Perfetto, Android Studio profilers, LeakCanary, New Relic or Crashlytics.

  • Experience with kids' or education apps and children's privacy rules (COPPA).

  • Interest in cross-platform mobile and some familiarity with iOS/Swift.

Compensation

40–50 LPA, with some flexibility for exceptional candidates.

raw.description:
This position can be done remotely within the UK. A central-London office is also available for hybrid work if preferred. You will be part of a friendly, international team.

Job Summary

The Legal Counsel, Privacy and Data Protection will provide sophisticated, practical, and business-oriented legal advice on EU/EEA privacy and data protection matters across Nielsen’s products, services, commercial relationships, and internal operations. This role will independently manage complex privacy workstreams, support Nielsen’s European privacy program, and serve as a trusted advisor to local sales and business teams. The role will work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Information Security, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, and Legal colleagues across jurisdictions.

  • Provide senior legal guidance on EU/EEA privacy compliance, data governance, and risk mitigation for business operations, products, partnerships, and commercial transactions.

  • Apply in-depth knowledge and experience to solve complex privacy and commercial legal problems, using best practices and a practical understanding of Nielsen’s business.

  • Work independently with minimal guidance, lead smaller projects and complex workstreams, and act as a resource for colleagues with less experience.

  • Draft, review and negotiate complex data protection exhibits on both the buy-side and sell-side.

  • Build consensus among stakeholders by explaining complex, difficult, or sensitive privacy and data protection issues in clear, actionable terms.

Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day legal advice on the EU/EEA General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), applicable national implementing laws, European Data Protection Board (EDPB) guidance, supervisory-authority decisions, ePrivacy requirements, marketing and consumer protection rules, and other relevant European data protection and digital regulations.

  • Maintain deep practical knowledge of EU/EEA privacy and data protection requirements and translate legal developments into clear, actionable guidance, contract language, policies, notices, processes, and implementation requirements for local and global stakeholders.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate data processing agreements, data protection exhibits, data sharing and data use agreements, data transfer arrangements, and related privacy provisions in commercial contracts, representing Nielsen on both the buy-side and sell-side.

  • Support local sales and business teams on privacy aspects of customer agreements, proposals, product offerings, data services, partnerships, and other commercial opportunities, providing timely and commercially practical advice.

  • Conduct and oversee privacy impact assessments (PIAs/DPIAs), transfer impact assessments, legitimate interest assessments, and other privacy risk assessments for products, features, data uses, partnerships, and operational initiatives.

  • Conduct privacy due diligence on third parties, vendors, customers, and strategic partners, including reviewing questionnaires and security materials, assessing processing activities and data flows, identifying gaps, negotiating remediation, and supporting ongoing oversight.

  • Advise on advertising technology, audience measurement, analytics, identity, cookies, pixels, SDKs, targeted advertising, consent and preference management, data monetization, and related media and marketing data practices. Experience in adtech or media technology is strongly preferred.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Information Security, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to assess proposed data collection, use, disclosure, retention, and deletion activities and to support compliant product launches and operational changes.

  • Communicate with, or support communications with, local data protection authorities and other supervisory authorities as required, including in connection with regulatory inquiries, consultations, complaints, audits, filings, investigations, and data incidents.

  • Support privacy incident and data breach response, data subject rights escalations, regulatory inquiries, audits, and other privacy compliance matters in coordination with local business teams, security, legal, and outside counsel.

  • Contribute to and improve privacy program materials, including policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, training, records of processing, data inventories, data retention requirements, and compliance reporting.

  • Monitor developments in EU/EEA and national privacy law, enforcement trends, and related digital regulation; assess their impact on Nielsen’s business and communicate recommendations to stakeholders.

  • Extensive experience practicing privacy, data protection, technology, commercial, or related legal work in-house, with a track record of producing high-quality independent work.

  • Law degree or equivalent legal qualification; qualification or admission in the UK is required, consistent with the requirements for the role.

  • Deep, practical knowledge of the GDPR and applicable national privacy and data protection laws in at least one relevant European jurisdiction, with the ability to apply requirements across products, contracts, and business processes.

  • Demonstrated experience conducting or overseeing DPIAs/PIAs, transfer impact assessments, legitimate interest assessments, and privacy risk assessments, including documenting risks and tracking mitigations.

  • Demonstrated experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating DPAs, data protection exhibits, and other privacy-related contract terms, including experience advising both buyers/customers and sellers/providers of data or services.

  • Experience advising business, sales, product, technology, or commercial teams on complex privacy issues and translating legal requirements into practical, commercially workable solutions.

  • Experience engaging with or supporting communications to supervisory authorities, regulators, or other public-sector stakeholders is preferred and may be required for certain matters.

  • Strong legal research, writing, negotiation, analytical, and issue-spotting skills, with the ability to exercise sound judgment and build consensus among diverse stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; fluency in an additional European language is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CIPP/E certification is greatly preferred, but it is not a hard requirement. CIPM, CIPT, or an equivalent privacy credential is also a plus.

  • Adtech, martech, media measurement, audience analytics, data licensing, or digital advertising experience is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of U.S. privacy and data protection requirements, including U.S. state privacy laws and the CCPA/CPRA, is an advantage.

  • Knowledge of APAC privacy and data protection regulations—particularly India’s Digital Personal Data Protection framework, Australia’s Privacy Act and Australian Privacy Principles, or South Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act—is an advantage.

  • Familiarity with international data transfers, standard contractual clauses, cross-border data sharing, consent and preference management, privacy management tools, data mapping, and records of processing activities.

What can we offer you as an employee of Nielsen Media

In addition to a competitive salary and benefits we offer a varied area of responsibility as well as an open corporate culture with numerous development opportunities. Above all, our employees appreciate the ability to work independently in a motivated and very friendly team. Social responsibility, open communication and living our values can be found not only on our homepage, but also in everyday work. At Flosum, we are building the world's best software for the modern enterprise. Our team is passionate about crafting elegant, high-performance products that delight our customers and set a new bar for engineering excellence. We combine deep expertise in cloud-native development with a relentless focus on quality, speed, and innovation. Every line of code we ship is built to scale, built to last, and built to make a real difference for the businesses that rely on us.

We are a company where technologists lead, ideas win on merit, and shipping great software fast is a core value—not a slogan. If you believe world-class engineering teams are the ones that move quickly and build things right, you'll feel at home here.

About the Role

We are hiring a Director of Software Development to lead a team of 10 engineers building and scaling our Node.js and Salesforce-integrated products. This is a hands-on leadership role for a technical architect at heart who can compress delivery schedules, drive developer velocity, and own the performance of the overall solution. You will be the single point of accountability for turning our roadmap into shipped software—on time, at quality, and at scale.

What You'll Own

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of 10 full-stack developers across Node.js services and Salesforce customizations.
  • Drive measurable improvements in developer velocity using DORA metrics: lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and MTTR.
  • Compress delivery schedules by breaking epics into small, independently shippable slices and challenging inflated estimates with data.
  • Architect end-to-end solutions spanning Node.js microservices, APIs, event-driven patterns, and Salesforce (Apex, Lightning, integrations).
  • Own solution performance: latency, throughput, scalability, and cost—set SLOs and hold the team accountable to them.
  • Establish estimation, sprint, and release discipline; remove blockers; enforce accountability without burning the team out.
  • Partner with Product, QA, and Infrastructure to align roadmap, capacity, and dependencies.
  • Recruit, onboard, and performance-manage engineers; build a culture of ownership and speed.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in software engineering with 5+ years leading development teams of 8–20 engineers.
  • Deep, current hands-on experience with Node.js (Express/Nest, async patterns, performance tuning, microservices).
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform—Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, REST/Platform Events, and Node.js↔Salesforce integration patterns.
  • Proven technical architect background: designed distributed systems, API contracts, data models, and performance-critical solutions in production.
  • Track record of schedule compression—case studies where you measurably reduced cycle time or pulled in release dates without sacrificing quality.
  • Strong estimation and planning discipline in Agile/Scrum or Kanban environments.
  • Experience driving solution performance: profiling, caching, query optimization, horizontal scaling, and observability (APM, logs, traces).
  • Cloud-native delivery experience (AWS preferred) with CI/CD, IaC, and modern DevOps practices.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication—can negotiate scope vs. time vs. quality with executives.

Success Metrics (First 6–12 Months)

  • Reduce average lead time for changes and increase deployment frequency to meet DORA "high" or "elite" benchmarks.
  • Ship the current roadmap on a compressed timeline agreed with leadership.
  • Improve estimate accuracy (commit vs. deliver) to within an agreed tolerance.
  • Meet or exceed performance SLOs for the Node.js + Salesforce solution stack.
  • Retain and level-up the existing team while filling any skill gaps.

Why Flosum

At Flosum, we believe great software is built by great teams—and great teams are built by leaders who care deeply about both the craft and the people. You will have the autonomy, the talent, and the mandate to build something exceptional. If you want to lead a team that is setting the standard for what world-class software looks like, we want to talk to you.
