raw.description:
Leidos Health and Services Sector currently has an opening for a Contact Center Supervisor- Overnight. This is an exciting opportunity to use your experience supporting the Military OneSource mission. The Military OneSource Program provides 24/7 support services for military members and their families, similar to a commercial Employee Assistance Program (EAP). This program provides a broad array of information, resources, education, referrals, and counseling to about 4.7 million participants, including military service members, their families, and eligible civilians, at locations worldwide. The Military OneSource program serves as a “one source” for resources and information encompassing a comprehensive support system.


*This position requires U.S. Citizenship

* Schedule Wed- Sat 8:30pm- 7:00am EST


Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you.


The Contact Center Supervisor provides counseling services as an independent practitioner, serving as an escalation point for at-risk cases.


This role:

  • Leads, directs, and manages a team of call center agents while ensuring effective on-site oversight of daily center operations.
  • Monitors compliance with referral processes, warm handoffs, case management system reporting requirements, and all applicable security and safeguarding procedures and directives to ensure adherence to established standards and protocols.
  • Serves as an escalation point for at-risk cases.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide clinical oversight and serve as the escalation point for at-risk and complex cases within the Call Center.
  • Lead, direct, and manage a team of practitioners to ensure effective daily operations and high-quality service delivery.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, mentoring, and side-by-side training to consultants to enhance performance and customer service outcomes.
  • Monitor live calls and chats to ensure professional, high-quality interactions, appropriate warm hand-offs, accurate referrals, and proper delivery of information and resources.
  • Ensure compliance with referral processes, warm handoffs, electronic case management system documentation requirements, and all applicable security and safeguarding protocols.
  • Identify performance trends, compliance gaps, and areas for improvement, and implement corrective actions, additional training, or resource enhancements as needed.
  • Handle escalation calls and provide direct intervention when necessary.
  • Generate, review, and analyze call center performance and quality reports to monitor adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and operational standards.
  • Provide operational updates and feedback to leadership as required.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

  • Master’s degree from an accredited graduate program in a behavioral health field such as Social Work, Psychology, Marriage and Family Therapy, or Counseling.
  • Current, valid, unrestricted independent counseling license issued by a State, the District of Columbia, a U.S. Commonwealth, or a U.S. Territory.
  • Minimum of three years of full-time, post-licensure counseling experience.
  • Three years of documented experience providing counseling supervision, oversight, and management.
  • Strong customer service skills and demonstrated knowledge of contact center operations.
  • Strong background in suicide assessment and management.
  • Ability to build strong customer relationships and deliver solutions
  • Ability to exhibit strong business and financial acumen
  • Ability to develop strategy, plan and prioritize work aligned to program/organization goals, and deliver solutions for the business
  • Ability to establish clear responsibilities, processes and accountability measures for your team
  • Ability to build effective teams and talented team members
  • Ability to assist employees in meeting both their career and organizational goals
  • Ability to motivate, drive engagement, vision, and gain trust through honesty, integrity, and authenticity from your team
  • Ability to consistently achieve results under tough circumstances and manage complex situations
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Outlook, and Excel, as well as web-based research and electronic documentation systems.
  • Strong leadership, analytical, and communication skills.
  • U.S. citizenship and fluency in English required.
  • Ability to successfully pass criminal history, fingerprint background checks, and credential verification required.
  • Ability to maintain and retain suitability investigation and clearance as required.
  • Proficient in navigating electronic systems, computer programs, and virtual service platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Employee Assistance Professional (CEAP) credential.
  • Contact center experience.
  • Telehealth experience.
  • Employee assistance program (EAP) experience.​

raw.title: Senior Cost Engineer - Electrical
raw.excerpt: Role SummaryThe Rivian Supply Chain team is looking for highly motivated technical professionals to drive value through expert cost analysis.
raw.description:
Role Summary

The Rivian Supply Chain team is looking for highly motivated technical professionals to drive value through expert cost analysis. As a Senior Cost Engineer, you will serve as a key individual contributor responsible for independently managing the cost analysis of assigned commodities. You will integrate data from various sources to create defensible estimates that directly influence sourcing decisions, design trade-offs, and supplier negotiations.

In this role, you will drive results by building compelling business cases that persuade stakeholders to adopt cost-optimized strategies. You are expected to demonstrate advanced proficiency in cost-modeling tools and take ownership of improving team processes. This role offers the opportunity to influence decision-making by presenting logical, data-driven insights in cross-functional forums.

This position is based remotely in Mexico and reports to the Electrical Cost Engineering Manager.

El equipo de Supply Chain de Rivian busca profesionales técnicos sumamente comprometidos para generar valor mediante el análisis de costos realizado por expertos. Como Ingeniero/a de costos sénior, desempeñará un papel clave como colaborador/a individual responsable de gestionar independientemente el análisis de costos de los productos asignados. Integrará datos de diversas fuentes para crear estimaciones justificables que influyan directamente en las decisiones de abastecimiento, las contrapartidas de diseño y las negociaciones con los proveedores.

En este puesto, impulsará los resultados elaborando casos de negocio atractivos que convenzan a las partes interesadas de adoptar estrategias optimizadas en cuanto a costos. Se espera que demuestre un dominio avanzado de las herramientas de modelado de costos y que asuma la responsabilidad de mejorar los procesos del equipo. Este puesto ofrece la oportunidad de influir en la toma de decisiones al presentar información lógica basada en datos en foros interfuncionales.

Este puesto está ubicado de manera remota en México y reporta al gerente de Ingeniería de Costos Eléctricos.

Responsibilities

  • Knowledge Base: Independently applies manufacturing principles and maintains a working knowledge of material properties, key manufacturing processes, and cost drivers without frequent guidance.
  • Presentation & Storytelling: Builds and presents a compelling business case to explain component cost analysis and persuade stakeholders to use the output to generate financial opportunities.
  • Technical Skills: Demonstrates advanced usage of aPriori and/or Costdata, autonomously modifying cost estimate process setups and options while leveraging the full toolchain (PLM, CATIA, etc.).
  • Organizational Influence & Outreach: Advises outcomes to direct counterparts and uses data-driven insights to directly influence the work of peers.
  • Direction: Manages day-to-day responsibilities and assigned projects with minimal guidance, identifying and managing personal priorities in urgent situations.
  • Base de conocimientos: aplicar de forma autónoma los principios de manufactura y poseer conocimientos prácticos de las propiedades de los materiales, los procesos de manufactura clave y los procesos de costos, sin necesidad de instrucciones frecuentes.
  • Presentación y narración: desarrollar y presentar un caso de negocio atractivo para explicar el análisis de costos de los componentes y convencer a las partes interesadas para que utilicen los resultados para generar oportunidades financieras.
  • Habilidades técnicas: demostrar un uso avanzado de aPriori o Costdata, modificando de forma autónoma los ajustes y opciones de los procesos de estimación de costos, aprovechando a la vez la cadena de herramientas completa (PLM, CATIA, etc.).
  • Influencia organizacional y divulgación: informar de los resultados a sus homólogos directos y apoyarse en conclusiones basadas en datos para ejercer influencia directa en el trabajo de sus colegas.
  • Dirección: gestionar las responsabilidades del día a día y los proyectos asignados con un mínimo de orientación, identificando y gestionando las prioridades personales en situaciones de urgencia.

Qualifications

  • Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience.
  • Domain Expertise: Understands how their work informs sourcing decisions, design trade-offs, and supplier negotiations, providing foundational data-driven input to cross-functional teams.
  • Commodity-Specific Experience: Wire harnesses and PCBAs
  • Technical Skills: Advanced user of various systems with the ability to conduct larger-scale gap analysis to identify focus areas and outliers.
  • Communication: Confidently fields questions from peers and is learning to tailor their communication style to different audiences.
  • Execution: Proactively communicates issues that have an impact outside of Cost Engineering, flagging risks and opportunities to the relevant teams.
  • Operational Style: Consistently uses first principles to drive change and responds actively to feedback from senior team members to close skill gaps.
  • Travel Requirements: Ability and willingness to travel as needed based on business needs, expected to average between 15-25% .
  • Educación y experiencia: licenciatura en Ingeniería o un campo relacionado y un mínimo de 3 años de experiencia relevante.
  • Experiencia en el campo: comprender cómo su trabajo influye en las decisiones de abastecimiento, las contrapartidas de diseño y las negociaciones con los proveedores, aportando información fundamental basada en datos a equipos multifuncionales.
  • Experiencia específica en categorías de productos: arneses de cables y PCBA
  • Habilidades técnicas: usuario/a avanzado/a de diversos sistemas, con la capacidad de realizar análisis de deficiencias a mayor escala, a fin de identificar áreas prioritarias y valores atípicos.
  • Comunicación: responder con seguridad a las preguntas de sus colegas y saber adaptar su estilo de comunicación a los distintos públicos.
  • Ejecución: comunicar de forma proactiva aquellos problemas con un impacto más allá de Cost Engineering, señalando los riesgos y las oportunidades a los equipos pertinentes.
  • Estilo operacional: basarse continuamente en los principios fundamentales para impulsar el cambio y responder de forma activa a los comentarios de los miembros sénior del equipo, con el objetivo de subsanar las carencias de competencias.
  • Necesidad de viajar: capacidad y disponibilidad para viajar según se requiera en función de las necesidades del negocio, con un promedio esperado del 15-25 %.

Pay Disclosure

The salary range for this role is 592,100 MXN - 740,138 MXN annually. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs. The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards. You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). There is no fixed deadline for this application; applications are accepted on an ongoing basis until the role is filled or the opening is no longer needed. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including major & minor medical, life insurance, and food vouchers to eligible employees. Divulgación salarial: La banda salarial para este puesto oscila entre los 592,100 MXN - 740,138 MXN anuales. Esta es la banda salarial, de menor a mayor, que, de buena fe, consideramos que pagaríamos por este puesto en el momento de la publicación de esta oferta. La posición de un/a empleado/a dentro de la banda salarial se determinará atendiendo a varios factores, entre otros: competencias específicas, capacitación pertinente, calificaciones, certificaciones, experiencia, habilidades, ubicación geográfica, turno y necesidades de la organización. El/la postulante que elijamos podrá optar a una bonificación anual por desempeño y a compensación accionaria. Puede aplicar a este puesto a través de careers.rivian.com (o a través de internal-careers-rivian.icims.com si ya es empleado/a). No hay una fecha límite fija para aplicar; se aceptan solicitudes de manera continua hasta que se cubra el puesto o la vacante ya no sea necesaria. Ofrecemos un paquete completo de beneficios que incluye cobertura médica para enfermedades graves y leves, seguro de vida y vales de comida a los empleados que cumplan los requisitos.

raw.title: Director of Software Engineering (Belarus)
raw.excerpt: At Flosum, we are building the world's best software for the modern enterprise.
raw.description:
At Flosum, we are building the world's best software for the modern enterprise. Our team is passionate about crafting elegant, high-performance products that delight our customers and set a new bar for engineering excellence. We combine deep expertise in cloud-native development with a relentless focus on quality, speed, and innovation. Every line of code we ship is built to scale, built to last, and built to make a real difference for the businesses that rely on us.

We are a company where technologists lead, ideas win on merit, and shipping great software fast is a core value—not a slogan. If you believe world-class engineering teams are the ones that move quickly and build things right, you'll feel at home here.

About the Role

We are hiring a Director of Software Development to lead a team of 10 engineers building and scaling our Node.js and Salesforce-integrated products. This is a hands-on leadership role for a technical architect at heart who can compress delivery schedules, drive developer velocity, and own the performance of the overall solution. You will be the single point of accountability for turning our roadmap into shipped software—on time, at quality, and at scale.

What You'll Own

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of 10 full-stack developers across Node.js services and Salesforce customizations.
  • Drive measurable improvements in developer velocity using DORA metrics: lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and MTTR.
  • Compress delivery schedules by breaking epics into small, independently shippable slices and challenging inflated estimates with data.
  • Architect end-to-end solutions spanning Node.js microservices, APIs, event-driven patterns, and Salesforce (Apex, Lightning, integrations).
  • Own solution performance: latency, throughput, scalability, and cost—set SLOs and hold the team accountable to them.
  • Establish estimation, sprint, and release discipline; remove blockers; enforce accountability without burning the team out.
  • Partner with Product, QA, and Infrastructure to align roadmap, capacity, and dependencies.
  • Recruit, onboard, and performance-manage engineers; build a culture of ownership and speed.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in software engineering with 5+ years leading development teams of 8–20 engineers.
  • Deep, current hands-on experience with Node.js (Express/Nest, async patterns, performance tuning, microservices).
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform—Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, REST/Platform Events, and Node.js↔Salesforce integration patterns.
  • Proven technical architect background: designed distributed systems, API contracts, data models, and performance-critical solutions in production.
  • Track record of schedule compression—case studies where you measurably reduced cycle time or pulled in release dates without sacrificing quality.
  • Strong estimation and planning discipline in Agile/Scrum or Kanban environments.
  • Experience driving solution performance: profiling, caching, query optimization, horizontal scaling, and observability (APM, logs, traces).
  • Cloud-native delivery experience (AWS preferred) with CI/CD, IaC, and modern DevOps practices.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication—can negotiate scope vs. time vs. quality with executives.

Success Metrics (First 6–12 Months)

  • Reduce average lead time for changes and increase deployment frequency to meet DORA "high" or "elite" benchmarks.
  • Ship the current roadmap on a compressed timeline agreed with leadership.
  • Improve estimate accuracy (commit vs. deliver) to within an agreed tolerance.
  • Meet or exceed performance SLOs for the Node.js + Salesforce solution stack.
  • Retain and level-up the existing team while filling any skill gaps.

Why Flosum

At Flosum, we believe great software is built by great teams—and great teams are built by leaders who care deeply about both the craft and the people. You will have the autonomy, the talent, and the mandate to build something exceptional. If you want to lead a team that is setting the standard for what world-class software looks like, we want to talk to you.

raw.description:
The Field Director, MSL (FD) plans, directs, coordinates and supports the activities of the Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs) within a designated geographic region to achieve scientific and business objectives within a therapeutic area of U.S. Medical Affairs. This includes, but is not limited to, coaching and mentoring for a designated number of medical level professionals (MSLs) in a therapeutic region. The FD reports to a therapeutic Field Medical Lead and works cross-functionally within U.S. Medical Affairs to identify, develop, implement, and monitor MSL strategies and tactics. Duties include strategic planning, financial management, personnel management, performance management process, regional awareness and expertise, data analysis, generation of metrics, material management, professional development, training, support, and execution of organizational goals and objectives.

Territory includes: AK, HI, WA, OR, CA, NV, MT, ID, UT, AZ, WY, CO, NM, OK, and North TX

Position must be based from within the territory, ideally near an airport, and with the ability to travel roughly 40% of the time.

Responsibilities:

  • People Leadership and Development: Recruitment and retention of key talent for AbbVie. Builds an organization reflecting a diverse and inclusive workforce through identification of team capability gaps and independent strengths. Establishes a productive work environment by creating trust and respect within the group and establishes self as a business partner. Consistently model “One-AbbVie” and AbbVie Ways of Working Leadership behaviors.
  • People Leadership and Development: Provide coaching, mentoring and guidance that is consistent and timely to MSLs regarding their individual performance and progress, including annual performance reviews, growth and succession planning, and real time field reports based upon regular field travel combined with data analysis. Addresses performance issues decisively and appropriately in accordance with AbbVie’s guidelines and Performance Excellence process.
  • People Leadership and Development: Ultimate responsibility for scientific knowledge of self/team and oversight of MSL territory plans. Maintains clinical knowledge of designated therapeutic area and broad market knowledge of the region, including current treatment strategies, current and pending competitors, new therapeutic developments, payor dynamics, and other market issues/trends as it pertains to specific medical business interests.
  • Regional Execution of Field-Medical Strategy: Maintain deep understanding of therapeutic strategy and interpretation of analytics to inform and maximize MSL Core Capabilities. Accountable for the direction and execution of MSL’s regional goals/objectives and territory plans. Evaluate appropriate tools and analytics to ensure optimal trial performance through investigator engagement and excellence in collaboration and coordination with clinical operations within the geographic region.
  • Regional Execution of Field-Medical Strategy: Maximizes In-Field Team Effectiveness. Ensure that MSL team members maintain adequate communications and interaction with the field sales organization, when appropriate and according to compliance and regulatory guidelines. Ensure cross-functional ways of working with field-medical partners in Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Medical Value and Access, Site Management and Monitoring teams.
  • Regional Execution of Field-Medical Strategy: Assists leadership with business/clinical strategy and tactical plan development, tactical plan implementation, impact goal achievement, and quantification of results at the field level. Accountable for and have decision-making responsibility for deploying regional resources to support franchise and business initiatives and ensure attainment of medical objectives.
  • Team Development and Field Execution: Ensures MSLs have the necessary tools, training, and materials to perform effectively. Responsible for identifying and partnering on potential projects that would enhance organizational impact and/or lead to successful execution of therapeutic Medical Objectives.
  • Maintain Core Consistency of MSL Ways We Work: Works with other MSL Field Directors regarding standardization and consistency of MSL role. Identifies opportunities for cross-functional integration of MSL roles and activities at the field level. Communicates regional activities and results to Field Medical Lead and other cross-functional leadership.
  • Ensure Internal Feed-back Loop: Translation of Field-Medical execution and initiatives to enhance cross functional collaboration with aligned stakeholders. Synthesize DPOs and provide field insights, along with FML, to relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Responsible for team compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies and procedures: Ensures MSL team members update and maintain all required databases with current and complete information. Ensures appropriate documentation of EE/HCP Customer interactions and responses to unsolicited requests. Ensures team member adherence to regulatory and compliance guidelines in all aspects of scientific dissemination of information. Manages activities within assigned budget.
  • Open to remote candidates in the territory near an international airport.
  • ​Advanced scientific degree required (PharmD, PhD, MD, or equivalent experience).
  • ​Strong understanding of Rheumatology disease area, clinical evidence, and the role of Field Medical within Medical Affairs.
  • ​Experience in Field Medical, Medical Affairs, scientific or healthcare roles within the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
  • ​Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing field-based scientific professionals.
  • ​Experience successfully translating medical strategy into field execution and performance expectations.
  • ​Experience interpreting and leveraging field-identified insights to inform medical or evidence planning.
  • ​Experience collaborating effectively with cross-functional partners within Medical Affairs and the In-Field Team (IFT).​
  • Ability to travel an estimated 40% of the time.

Competencies

  • Leads Field Medical Teams by applying strong scientific knowledge and sound judgment to guide high-quality scientific engagement.
  • Coaches and develops scientific capability by providing clear direction, feedback, and role modeling of scientific excellence.
  • Translates medical and therapeutic area strategy into actionable regional priorities and execution standards.
  • Uses field healthcare professional perspectives, Scientific Intelligence and performance data to inform decision making and continuous improvement of field execution.
  • Builds an environment of accountability, trust, and collaboration that supports consistent, compliant scientific engagement.
  • Applies strong people leadership skills to motivate, engage, and retain high-performing field medical talent.
  • Collaborates with Medical Affairs and Health Impact (MHI) leaders and cross-functional partners to align regional field activity with broader medical objectives.
  • Communicates clearly and effectively to connect strategy, expectations, and performance outcomes for Field Medical Teams.

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: ​

Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​

  • We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​

  • This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs. ​

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. raw.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As Manager, Enterprise Sales Development you will have the opportunity to lead and scale a world-class sales development team for one of the world’s most disruptive companies. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end sales development operations targeted towards acquiring new enterprise clients. You will lead the success of a high-energy team of Sales Development Representatives (SDRs). You will be collaborating with marketing and lead-generation teams to plan and execute SDR goals, strategy, and tactics to grow the Toptal brand.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

As a Manager, you will:

  • Hire, onboard, train, and manage a team of Sales Development Representatives.
  • Motivate SDRs to exceed goals through coaching and incentives, and develop and maintain key performance metrics and dashboards that focus on maximizing performance.
  • Drive AI innovation by identifying automation opportunities, rolling out agent-powered workflows for prospect research and personalized outreach, and coaching the team on adapting these in their daily practices.
  • Work with Enterprise Sales and Client Partner teams to optimize lead and pipeline creation.
  • Be in constant communication with team members via Slack.

Coach and lead the team as they do the following:

  • Prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from lead-generation activities and outbound cold-calling into targeted accounts.
  • Interact with prospects via phone and email to explain Toptal’s vision, identify opportunities, and generate interest.
  • Disseminate opportunities to appropriate sales reps, educate reps as necessary about the opportunity, and recommend follow-up action items.
  • Assign, delegate, oversee, and monitor work.
  • Coach and mentor team members, provide feedback, conduct performance reviews, and implement performance improvement plans if needed.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can leverage our global team to build client relationships and drive success.
  • Learn our sales method and selling process.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Integrate into your team and Toptal’s processes.
  • Lead regular 1:1s with each team member.
  • Join client calls with SDRs to coach them and provide feedback.
  • Be an active member of the SDR and Enterprise Sales Executive Leadership team, contributing to excellence.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be an integral leader of the SDR team.
  • Continue to lead a team that is exceeding monthly and quarterly KPIs.
  • Prove the success of the SDR function and process by successfully generating leads that generate revenue.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Scale the impact of the SDR function as you optimize the sales development process and build out your team.
  • Collaborate closely with the Toptal Enterprise teams as we execute strategic initiatives, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Be an integral part of the onboarding and promotion of the SDR team you hire and lead.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Find incremental improvements to a high-performing team.
  • Hire and promote many SDRs.
  • Be a contributing leader to an ever-expanding SDR team.
  • Continue to collaborate closely with the Toptal Enterprise teams to execute strategic initiatives.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • Minimum of 6 years of experience as a Sales Development Representative or in an outbound sales role is a must.
  • Minimum of 2 years of leadership experience.
  • Experience with Salesloft, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and modern lead-generation tools is a must.
  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying AI agents to support outbound sales motions (e.g., automated prospect research, personalized outreach messages, sequences, or lead qualification) to improve SDR productivity or pipeline health.
  • Be a creative, process-oriented person who is skilled at building relationships and composing effective communications.
  • Have a metrics-oriented mindset with an aptitude for tracking progress, and setting and meeting goals.
  • Have a talent for writing compelling emails and subject lines for prospecting, directed to a technical and/or senior audience.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Must be experienced in the Identify and Protect Security Functions, including but not limited to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM), vulnerability management, and secure architecture. Senior Consultants lead diverse teams of consultants with varying skills to meet and exceed client expectations through scoped engagements. This role will lead multiple client engagements—including exposure management assessments, vulnerability management program reviews, and remediation strategy development—or support larger-sized client engagements.

Senior Consultants contribute to client delivery by executing the necessary technical or process-focused tasks, producing high-quality architectural, security, and program artifacts, and presenting findings and recommendations throughout an engagement. Senior Consultants may be assigned a Project Coordinator role to ensure delivery engagements adhere to the associated timeline, support project reporting requirements, and maintain alignment to the intended objectives. Senior Consultants are primary leaders of AHEAD’s security delivery teams responsible for assessments, designs, and operational documentation.

Senior Consultants also support business development activities alongside a sales specialist to help qualify client needs and expectations, particularly where security architecture, exposure prioritization, design tradeoffs, or solution feasibility must be evaluated. They may be directly engaged in client-facing interactions to assess current-state environments, articulate future-state CTEM and vulnerability management capabilities, and produce and/or present sales proposals or support client-visioning workshops.

Lastly, AHEAD Senior Consultants leverage their visibility and experience to contribute to the continuous improvement and maturation of in-practice service offerings and capabilities. This includes influencing architectural standards, design patterns, and security approaches, as well as positively impacting the service portfolio and individuals on the team through thought leadership and mentorship.

Responsibilities

    • Lead client assessments of CTEM and vulnerability management programs, including reviewing asset discovery and inventory, exposure identification, vulnerability scanning and assessment, risk-based prioritization, remediation workflows, and validation practices.

    • Request and analyze evidence of program maturity, relevant technology configurations, asset coverage, scanning practices, remediation processes, exception handling, reporting, and governance.

    • Write consistent, detailed observations and practical recommendations based on risk to client environments and programs.

    • Develop actionable remediation strategies and roadmaps that account for exposure severity, exploitability, business criticality, asset context, and operational dependencies.

    • Advise clients on improving visibility into their attack surface, prioritizing exposures, and coordinating remediation across infrastructure, cloud, applications, and security teams.

    • Support the design and implementation of vulnerability management and exposure management processes, including roles, ownership, service levels, metrics, and reporting.

    • Evaluate security tools and integrations that support asset discovery, vulnerability assessment, exposure prioritization, remediation tracking, and validation.

    • Perform technical analysis of client environments and dependencies to inform risk prioritization, remediation sequencing, and implementation planning.

    • Lead and participate in the development of CTEM strategies, vulnerability management plans, procedures, runbooks, and playbooks.

Client Delivery

    • Facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and planning workshops for small to medium-sized engagements, anchoring discussions in architectural principles, security patterns, and measurable outcomes.

    • Ensure customer expectations are appropriately set and managed.

    • Drive and manage objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks and milestones, project status, dependencies, and timelines to ensure successful, on-time delivery aligned to business objectives.

    • Lead or contribute to solution architecture and design discussions, including the development of secure technology architectures and operating models that support clients’ CTEM, vulnerability management, and risk-reduction objectives.

    • Consult on solution designs that employ strong security controls, clearly defined ownership, effective integrations, and operational workflows for identifying, prioritizing, and remediating exposures.

    • Create and finalize project deliverables, including peer review for collateral developed by others on a delivery team.

    • Present deliverables to client executive management.

    • Apply knowledge of AHEAD’s project lifecycle management activities to effectively support delivery engagements throughout the duration of a project.

Business Development

    • Support business development pursuits through client discovery meetings.

    • Represent service offerings during the sales cycle, including project scoping, proposal development, and presenting proposals to clients.

    • Provide consultative input during sales cycles related to secure architecture, CTEM and vulnerability management strategies, and solution feasibility.

    • Apply knowledge of AHEAD’s sales management lifecycle to effectively support sales opportunities throughout the duration of a proposal.

    • Assist Principal Consultants and Security Sales Specialists with engagement scoping and the creation of proposal collateral.

Practice Development and Thought Leadership

    • Maintain subject matter expertise in a minimum of four security domains or three security solutions.

    • Participate in the development, enhancement, and standardization of in-practice service offerings, primarily services related to CTEM, vulnerability management, exposure prioritization, and remediation strategy.

    • Enable more than one service capability.

    • Maintain a broad knowledge and understanding of current and future state IT trends, technologies, and standards.

    • Lend support and mentorship to junior consultants and peers.

People Leadership

    • In addition to leading multiple projects, Senior Consultants provide technical leadership, ongoing mentoring, and guidance to junior consultants and peers. They may coordinate project teams and support professional development as appropriate to the engagement and practice.

Qualifications

    • Undergraduate technical degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT Management, or Cybersecurity preferred, but not required.

    • Minimum of 10 years of professional, relevant experience, including experience leading technical work or client engagements.

    • Three professional and/or technical certifications, including industry-recognized certifications that align to AHEAD’s Security service portfolio.

    • Demonstrated experience consulting on secure architecture, vulnerability management, CTEM, or related security program design within complex enterprise environments.

    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills (must be highly proficient in Microsoft Office Suite).

    • Comfortable addressing groups of people in virtual or in-person settings.

    • Ability to solve complex, abstract problems.

    • Excellent interpersonal skills, good listener, ability to connect with different personalities.

raw.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Business / Data Analyst at the Level III level to produce the trusted assessment and reporting foundation for Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Agile and Atlassian Cloud modernization initiatives. The role combines business process discovery, quantitative analysis, stakeholder interviews, and operational reporting to help leaders make informed decisions about readiness, sequencing, training, and tool adoption.

The Business / Data Analyst will document how teams manage work today; analyze Jira Cloud usage, workflow patterns, survey responses, and interview findings; and establish a reliable inventory of teams, projects, and readiness needs. Using Excel and Power BI or Tableau, the analyst will translate disparate information into clear findings, repeatable classifications, practical recommendations, and portfolio-level measures.

This is not a data-extraction-only role. The analyst must understand the meaning and limitations of each measure, distinguish reported behaviors from observed evidence, and work directly with users to resolve inconsistencies. The ideal candidate brings analytical rigor, organized requirements management, and the ability to communicate findings in language decision-makers can act on.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Inventory projects, teams, tooling, workflows, user populations, and current-state Jira Cloud configurations.
  • Documents current Jira usage and processes, runs readiness surveys and interviews, analyzes Jira and survey data, tracks agile and portfolio metrics, and maintains data quality.
  • Develop and administer readiness surveys, structured interviews, and validation workshops with stakeholders.
  • Analyze survey results, Jira Cloud activity, Agile maturity, and portfolio measures to classify needs and support delivery-wave sequencing.
  • Define metric specifications, data dictionaries, quality checks, and repeatable data collection procedures.
  • Build Excel, Power BI, or Tableau analyses and concise findings presentations for operational and leadership audiences.
  • Partner with platform and training teams to translate assessment results into onboarding support tiers and learning paths.
  • Design and maintain structured assessment tools, interview protocols, process maps, inventories, and documented classification criteria for teams and work-management practices.
  • Reconcile survey participation, Jira project data, workforce rosters where authorized, and team-provided information; flag missing or conflicting records.
  • Define baseline and follow-up measures for readiness, team maturity, Jira Cloud adoption, training progress, and data completeness, with clear denominators and refresh rules.
  • Produce traceable findings readouts, dashboards, and prioritized recommendations that explain assumptions, exceptions, and data-quality limitations.
  • Collaborate with engineers and platform administrators to validate source-to-report mappings and ensure metrics remain accurate after configuration changes.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in business analytics, business administration, information systems, statistics, economics, or a related field. Four additional years of relevant experience may substitute for a Bachelor's
  • 3+ years of relevant business analysis, process analysis, reporting, or quantitative analysis experience.
  • Experience with Jira reporting, data extraction, and assessment of workflow/process use.
  • Strong Excel capabilities and hands-on Power BI or Tableau skills.
  • Ability to conduct stakeholder interviews, document requirements, and validate data quality.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination and satisfy applicable federal personnel vetting, security, privacy, accessibility, and data-handling requirements.
  • Atlassian ACP-120 (Jira Administration for Cloud) or SAFe Lean Portfolio Management (LPM) certification.
  • Experience organizing interview notes, survey results, and system-generated data into defensible findings and practical business recommendations.
  • Ability to write concise requirements, process narratives, KPI definitions, and validation procedures for mixed technical and nontechnical audiences.

Desired:

  • Prior experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), or federal health programs is highly desirable.
  • Experience with survey analytics, portfolio KPIs, and federal IT organizations.
  • SQL, Confluence, and Jira Align exposure.
  • Knowledge of Agile delivery, portfolio terminology, and change measurement in large, distributed organizations.
  • A master's degree in business analytics, information systems, data science, statistics, or public policy is desirable.
  • Additional certifications such as IIBA Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA), Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), or Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300) are desirable.

Target Salary Range: $85,000 - $120,000

raw.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview

Netwrix is seeking a Marketing Operations Specialist who is equally comfortable building scalable MarTech architecture and executing email campaigns at high velocity. You'll own our marketing tech stack (Marketo, GTM integrations, event platforms) while driving end-to-end email execution for demand generation and lifecycle programs.

You'll report directly to the Marketing Operations Manager and collaborate closely with global Demand Gen, Field Marketing, Sales Ops, and Product Marketing teams on campaign planning and execution.

This role requires the candidate to be based in or within close proximity to Metro Manila.

Responsibilities include:

A. Marketing Technology & Operations (40%)

  • Own the marketing tech stack - Marketo (MCE), Salesforce campaigns, AccelEvents, GuideFlow, Google Analytics, GTM, Qualified. Partner with Sales Ops, IT, and Analytics to ensure clean data flow and system health.
  • Drive campaign architecture and data governance - Design and maintain the campaign taxonomy, status models, field standards, and attribution structure. Own naming conventions, hierarchy logic, and field documentation so campaigns are reportable and scalable.
  • Build automation and workflows - Nurture programs, lead scoring, enrichment, routing, and status progression. Always favor simplicity over feature-completeness.
  • Monitor system health and data quality - Audit campaign data, sync integrity, bounce rates, field completeness monthly. Escalate blockers; fix preventable issues before they compound. Own quarterly health report.
  • Manage reporting and dashboards - Create self-serve reports and dashboards in Marketo, Salesforce and supporting tools. Surface actionable insights: pipeline velocity, campaign ROI, funnel bottlenecks, segment performance.
  • Evaluate and implement new tools – Assess, implement, and maintain new MarTech solutions that support business objectives.

B. Email Campaign Execution (60%)

  • Design and execute email campaigns end-to-end - strategy, audience segmentation, landing page forms, email logic, send timing, performance analysis. Work closely with Content and Demand Gen teams to align messaging and timing.
  • Manage email programs at scale - nurture streams, one-time blasts, subscriber
    onboarding, re-engagement campaigns. Own the calendar, send quality, and engagement tracking. Maintain email lists and preference centers.
  • Optimize email performance - A/B test, monitor open/click rates, segment results
    by source/persona. Recommend improvements based on data.
  • Coordinate email-to-landing-page flows - work with the web team to ensure forms, UTM tracking, and follow-up sequences work seamlessly. Own the Campaign Member creation process and data quality at form submission.
  • Maintain email compliance - GDPR, list hygiene, preference centers.

This is real execution - you'll ship campaigns weekly and own their success.

C. Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Coordinate with Demand Gen, Field Marketing, Product Marketing on campaign planning and execution.
  • Partner with Sales Ops and Salesforce admins on campaign structure, status workflows, and lead routing.
  • Work with Analytics and BI teams on reporting requirements and data verification.
  • Collaborate with Web team on tagging, tracking, personalization, and form integrations.
  • Communicate operational changes and wins to stakeholders in clear, non-technical language.

Qualifications

Required:

  • English fluency (B1+ minimum)
  • Marketo Certified Expert (MCE) required
  • Proficient in Salesforce Campaign object and reporting

Our Values

At Netwrix, our values guide every action:

  • Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
  • Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
  • Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
  • Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
  • Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
  • Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
  • eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

  • Competitive Health Benefits
  • Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
  • Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
  • Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
  • Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission.

Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Please let us know if you require any accommodation.

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Mozilla Marketing Team is looking for an organized and detail-oriented Production Designer to join our team. This person will be responsible for leading the visual execution of creative assets for projects across film, advertising, and digital media. The Production Designer is responsible for ensuring visual consistency from concept through completion. Cable One’s Retention Business Account Representatives are responsible for developing, renewing contracts, and maintaining a base of existing business customers who subscribe to our voice and broadband services. As a Representative, you will speak to small and medium-sized companies who call in to disconnect their services. Your goal will be to show them the value that Cable One can bring to their company by showing them services that may better fit their needs or troubleshoot to resolve their current concerns.

​

Job Description:

Job Description: Kubernetes Platform infrastructure Architect

Role Overview

Position: Kubernetes Platform Infrastructure Architect

Organization: VCF GTM & Advanced Services

Position Type: Full-Time / Enterprise Infrastructure & Systems Integration Focus

About the Team & Mission

The Modern Workloads Platform Engineering team is responsible for enabling enterprise success with VMware vSphere Kubernetes Service (vKS) as part of VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). Our mission is to accelerate adoption of vKS as the enterprise-grade Kubernetes platform for modern applications in private cloud.

As a Private Cloud Platform Architect, you will work on the front lines with strategic enterprise customers and Systems Integrators, driving the architectural validation and successful design of VCF deployments. This is a hands-on, architect-level, customer-facing role focused on designing software-defined data centers (SDDC), integrating physical-to-virtual network fabrics, and guiding clients through their data center modernization journeys.

Key Accountabilities

  • Trusted Architectural Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor for enterprise customers, guiding them through the strategic design, validation, and full-scale deployment of VMware Kubernetes solution built on VMware Cloud Foundation infrastructure platforms.

  • Technical Leadership & Adoption: Drive customer success by spearheading architecture workshops, technical deep-dives, and complex Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) to accelerate the deployment of Supervisor and VMware Kubernetes Service."

  • Kubernetes Networking Solutions: Deliver resilient solution architectures for Kubernetes networking, managing advanced configurations for IP Address Management (IPAM), container-native egress/ingress traffic, and cloud-native microservices routing.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering field core teams and Systems Integrator partners to jointly develop customer proposals that address virtualization scaling, workload placement, and physical-to-virtual operational transformations.

  • Asset & Pattern Creation: Build, standardize, and share reusable reference architectures, deployment patterns, and technical assets to accelerate customer adoption of VCF enterprise infrastructure.

Required Skills & Experience

Core Technical Acumen

  • Deep technical acumen: Proven architecture expertise on VMware Cloud Foundation core infrastructure products, including advanced vSphere deployment, vSAN storage architectures, and automated SDDC Manager operations. Experience with Kubernetes Platform Engineering (EKS, AKS, RH OCP/OPP, Rancher)

  • Excellent Infrastructure Knowledge: Comprehensive knowledge of enterprise IT infrastructure, including server, network, and storage architectures.

  • Advanced Networking Fabrics: Deep design and implementation experience with enterprise networking fabrics eg. VMware NSX or other leading Solutions.

  • Cloud-Native Networking: Demonstrated solutions experience managing Kubernetes-native networking constructs, ensuring reliable ingress controllers, egress controls, and CNI multi-tenancy configurations.

  • Advanced Troubleshooting: Lead analysis of issues during PoCs or pilot across the entire technology stack, tackling complex infrastructure, networking, and containerization issues within Kubernetes and Supervisor environments."

Experience & Leadership

  • Professional Experience: 12+ years in technology-related engineering or consulting roles, with explicit depth in enterprise IT architecture, data center SDN, or private cloud infrastructure platforms. Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) is highly beneficial

  • Customer-Facing Delivery: Proven success working directly alongside enterprise customers and global Systems Integrators to deliver technical solutions and drive platform adoption.

  • Communication & Storytelling: Excellent presentation, storytelling, and interpersonal skills with the ability to comfortably articulate infrastructure complexities in clear business terms to executive decision-makers.

  • Dynamic Collaboration: Enthusiastic, self-starting professional with the agility to work hand-in-hand with multi-disciplinary sales and engineering teams to advance strategic client opportunities.

  • Strategic Assets: Experience with vertical industry specializations (e.g., Financial Services, Telecommunications) or recognized thought leadership in software-defined data centers is considered a strong plus.

  • Travel Flexibility: Ability to travel up to 60% of the time to support on-site architectural workshops and client deployments.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field; or equivalent practical data center experience.

  • Core Knowledge: Deep, verifiable knowledge of VMware enterprise products, software-defined data center virtualization paradigms, and modern container networking architectures.

  • Certifications: Highly desirable professional credentials include VMware Certified Professional / Advanced Professional tracks (VCP-VCF Architect, VCAP-NV), Cisco certifications (CCIE/CCNP Data Center), or relevant public cloud network architecture paths (CKA and / or CKAD, Red Hat OpenShift Certified Architect RHCA/RHCE)


Compensation and Benefits


The annual base salary range for this position is USD 110,800.00 To USD 177,300.00

As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. All subject to relevant plan documents and award agreements.

A Reviver consecutive, over-the-phone interpreter plays a crucial role in facilitating effective communication between those who speak different languages. Consecutive interpreters work by listening to a speaker in one language and then rendering their speech in another language after a brief pause.

As a consecutive interpreter, you will bridge language gaps, ensuring clarity and understanding in various over-the-phone situations.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide consecutive interpretation services during phone calls, meetings, conferences, interviews, and more.
  • Listen carefully to the speaker in the source language and convey the message accurately in the target language.

Position Summary:

The Closing Specialist is responsible for coordinating real estate closings and managing the full lifecycle of closing transactions. This includes assembling, preparing, reviewing, and verifying loan closing documents while ensuring compliance with all applicable state, federal, and regulatory requirements. This role manages an active pipeline of transactions to ensure files are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with established service level agreements while delivering high-quality support to clients, lenders, and settlement partners.

Essential Functions:

  • Assemble, prepare, review, and verify all documents required for loan closings, including contracts, settlement statements, closing disclosures, mortgages, deeds, and title policies, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepare preliminary and final settlement statements, including Closing Disclosures (CD) and ALTA statements, and manage revisions and approvals as needed.
  • Review and revise closing documents to meet lender requirements, ensuring full compliance with regulatory, investor, and company guidelines prior to transmitting finalized packages to settlement agents.
  • Coordinate the closing process, including scheduling and execution of document signings, while ensuring all required documentation is complete prior to closing.
  • Perform final pre-closing reviews of title fees, taxes, premiums, endorsements, vesting, and all checklist items to ensure readiness for closing.
  • Serve as a liaison between lenders, title companies, borrowers, and settlement agents, maintaining clear and timely communication to ensure expectations and deadlines are met.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including disbursement and post-closing, to ensure a seamless transition from closing through funding and recording.
  • Support post-closing activities, including revisions to CDs or ALTA statements and overall file completion.
  • Manage an active pipeline of files, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines and established service level agreements.
  • Provide operational support across all workflow stages, including back-office functions, and assist with coverage needs such as on-call, alternate shifts, and weekend support as required.

raw.description:
At Enterprise, we scale housing affordability solutions for millions of people. For more than 40 years, we've championed big ideas that create more housing opportunity for everyone, investing more than $92 billion to create or preserve more than 1 million homes. Our greatest strength is bringing together the right partners, capital, and capabilities to help what's working reach more communities, faster. Join us as we unlock access to a quality, affordable home for millions across the country.


Working at Enterprise

At Enterprise, you’ll be part of a diverse, committed team making a difference every day. You will collaborate with some of the smartest minds and biggest hearts in our field. You’ll be empowered to drive systems change and take bold steps to advance racial equity. And you will find a career home where you’re valued and supported in your growth journey.


Enterprise offers career opportunities in our offices across the country with an exceptional benefits package.

Job Description Summary

Enterprise Community Investment is seeking an experienced individual with affordable housing and/or LIHTC experience to underwrite low-income housing tax credit investments. Extensive knowledge of LIHTC (Low Income Housing Tax Credits) along with strong financial analysis skills is required.

Job Description

Responsibilities


Underwrite tax credit investments as assigned, including completion of the following underwriting tasks: sponsorship analysis, market analysis, sources and uses and capital structure analysis, income and expense underwriting, and tax credit documentation analysis. As part of processing each transaction, obtain due diligence materials from the client, conduct site visits as needed, review project loan documents and the LP agreement for material business terms, participate with the originator in conference calls with customers, and prepare and present requests for investment committee approval and investor review, including narrative descriptions, charts, graphs, and tables illustrating pertinent aspects of the proposed investment.

Under the direction of the originator and director of underwriting, communicate and manage customer expectations through the underwriting process using a positive and proactive approach that will enable repeat origination opportunities.


Provide regular communication to the originator and director of underwriting regarding deal underwriting progress, including process checklist review, due diligence review, transaction timing, issue identification, and timely preparation and regular updates to the Transaction Summary format as required by the originator and the process checklist.


Assist with and attend deal closings or other customer service coverage enhancement opportunities (if requested by the originator or director of underwriting) and help complete and organize closed deal files for transition to Asset Management.


Assist with other Syndication priorities as requested (e.g., asset management, investor relations, and assistance to other lines of business).


Participate in and contribute to group meetings and discussions.


Perform other duties as assigned.


Qualifications


Core Technical Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, or a related field required; master’s degree preferred.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in real estate finance, affordable housing, and/or the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) program, including familiarity with apartment market dynamics in both urban and suburban areas and relevant industry policies, issues, and programs.
  • Extensive knowledge of LIHTC required.
  • Strong financial analysis skills required, including advanced Excel modeling capabilities.
  • Experience closing real estate transactions highly preferred.

Execution and Operational Performance

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks effectively under significant time pressure and meet closing deadlines.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate complex activities, prioritize competing demands, and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to maintain a big-picture perspective while attending closely to detail and producing thorough documentation.

Communication and Collaboration

About Mass Culture

Mass Culture is a growth media agency. We help mission-driven scale-ups connect brand and performance so they grow faster, more profitably, and with purpose.

About the Role

We're looking for a highly organized, media-savvy Account Director to lead client relationships and oversee the successful execution of integrated marketing initiatives across our accounts.

This role is part client leadership, media strategy, and project management. The ideal candidate knows how to build trusted client partnerships, translate business objectives into actionable plans, and keep cross-functional teams aligned to deliver great work.

The Account Director will serve as a primary point of contact for key clients, overseeing account health, project execution, timelines, budgets, and overall client satisfaction. While this person won't be responsible for hands-on campaign optimization, they should have a strong understanding of paid media, digital marketing, and campaign performance to confidently guide conversations, anticipate challenges, and collaborate with internal specialists.

Ultimately, this person is responsible for ensuring our clients feel supported, our teams are set up for success, and our work consistently delivers against expectations.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in account management, client services, or integrated marketing project leadership, preferably within a digital marketing or creative agency.
  • Proven experience managing complex client relationships and multiple accounts simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of digital media, including paid social, paid search, and other performance marketing channels.
  • Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, timelines, budgets, and deliverables.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, including media buyers, strategists, creatives, and other specialists.
  • Ability to interpret campaign performance data and translate insights into clear, actionable client conversations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence leading client meetings, presentations, and challenging conversations.
  • Proactive problem-solving mindset with the ability to anticipate roadblocks, manage expectations, and keep projects moving forward.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including understanding account profitability, scope management, client retention, and opportunities for account growth.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing structure, clarity, and accountability to fast-moving environments.

Responsibilities

  • Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary strategic and day-to-day relationship lead for assigned accounts. Build strong partnerships with clients, understand their business objectives, manage expectations, and ensure a consistently high level of service and communication.
  • Account & Project Leadership: Oversee the execution of client initiatives from planning through delivery, ensuring projects stay on track, on budget, and aligned with client goals. Establish clear priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and next steps across internal teams.
  • Media & Marketing Oversight: Bring a strong working knowledge of paid media and digital marketing to client and internal conversations. Partner with channel specialists to understand campaign performance, identify opportunities or concerns, and ensure recommendations support the broader client strategy.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with media buyers, strategists, creative teams, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless collaboration and execution. Keep teams aligned on priorities, deliverables, deadlines, and client expectations.
  • Client Communication & Presentations: Lead client meetings, status updates, planning sessions, and performance reviews. Translate complex information into clear, compelling updates and recommendations while ensuring clients understand progress, results, and next steps.
  • Account Health & Retention: Proactively monitor client satisfaction, identify potential risks, and address challenges before they escalate. Take ownership of resolving client concerns and strengthening long-term relationships.
  • Scope, Timeline & Budget Management: Oversee account scopes of work, project timelines, and budgets to ensure resources are allocated effectively and commitments are delivered. Identify scope changes, manage competing priorities, and collaborate with internal leadership to maintain healthy, profitable accounts.
  • Performance Reporting & Insights: Partner with media and analytics teams to develop meaningful client reporting. Ensure performance updates are accurate, relevant, and connected to business objectives, with clear insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Process & Operational Excellence: Identify opportunities to improve account workflows, communication, and project management practices. Help establish consistent standards that make our teams more efficient and our client experience stronger.
  • Account Growth: Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships through additional services, new initiatives, and strategic recommendations that align with client needs and business goals.

raw.excerpt: About Riot Platforms Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure.
raw.description:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot is seeking a Maintenance Strategy Manager to build and lead the maintenance strategy for Riot’s data center portfolio. You will turn reliability analysis (FMEA/RCM) into the equipment strategies, task standards, and intervals that govern how every asset class is maintained, and own the global maintenance library and Master Maintenance Index.

You will also lead Riot’s accelerated maintenance insourcing strategy: deciding which scopes move from vendors to internal Riot crews, in what order, and what must be in place before each one moves. Working alongside a dedicated Technical Training counterpart, you will ensure every insourced scope has a complete, field-ready maintenance package and technicians qualified to perform it.

You will manage critical maintenance and repair vendor relationships and partner closely with the Data Center Asset Manager and site leadership, who own day-to-day execution and backlog. This is a portfolio-wide role with travel to sites as needed.

This position will be remote with travel to support Riot's portfolio of sites as needed.

What you'll do

  • Lead the maintenance insourcing roadmap: set the criteria (criticality, specialization, cost, coverage, workforce readiness), sequence scopes, and enforce readiness gates (approved package, qualified technicians, tools and parts on site, site sign-off) before each vendor-to-internal transition.
  • Set the standard for complete maintenance packages (SOPs/MOPs, task instructions, safety requirements, tooling and parts lists, required qualifications); develop them with EHS, site SMEs, OEMs, and vendors, and approve each one before a scope goes live.
  • Define the skills, certifications, and qualification levels each scope requires based on code, regulatory, and OEM requirements, and partner with Technical Training so each scope’s training is ready when its package is.
  • Build and govern the equipment strategy library, turning FMEA/RCM analysis into documented run-to-failure, preventive, condition-based, and predictive strategies for each asset class.
  • Own the Master Maintenance Index, keeping every task template and interval linked to its governing equipment strategy; set interval review triggers and route changes outside documented tolerance through the Change Management Standard.
  • Manage critical maintenance and repair vendors as strategic partners: qualify and onboard, set SLAs and two-way scorecards, run performance reviews and escalations, align vendor work to Riot standards, and manage transitions as scopes move in-house.
  • Help sites prioritize by asset criticality and deferral risk, serve as the escalation point for strategy and vendor support, direct site-based Asset & Maintenance Planners, and elevate repeat or high-risk deferrals to leadership.
  • Track PM completion, planned-to-emergency ratio, and reliability KPIs to correct over-maintenance and recurring failures, and supply failure history to the Data Center Asset Manager for Priority 1/2 repair, refurbish, or replace decisions.

What you'll have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered. CMRP or CMPS (Certificate in Maintenance Planning and Scheduling) a plus.
  • 7+ years in maintenance strategy, reliability-centered maintenance, or maintenance planning in data center, industrial, or other critical infrastructure environments.
  • Track record of building an equipment strategy library and governing maintenance tasks and intervals at multi-site scale.
  • Knowledge of preventive, predictive, condition-based, and run-to-failure models, and when each one applies.
  • Experience managing maintenance and repair vendor relationships, including SLAs, performance scorecards, performance reviews, and escalations.
  • Experience defining the technical, safety, and certification requirements behind maintenance work, and partnering with training teams, SMEs, and site operations to turn them into SOPs/MOPs and qualification programs.
  • Strong analytical skills with reliability KPIs (MTBF, MTTR, PM compliance) and the ability to turn data into strategy changes.
  • Experience leading insourcing or make-vs-buy decisions for maintenance, including moving scopes from vendors to internal teams, preferred.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Base salary range of $160,000–$170,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Employee Relations Director


The central objective of the Thrive (Employee Relations) team at Autodesk is to ensure treatment of employees is fair, respectful, and consistent with Autodesk’s culture and core values.


The Director, Thrive leads the global Employee Relations function, setting strategy, priorities, and operational excellence to ensure fair, consistent, and values-based employee experiences across Autodesk. This role is responsible for building and developing a high-performing team of ER professionals while providing strategic oversight of complex employee relations matters, investigations, risk mitigation, manager enablement, and culture initiatives. Partnering closely with senior leaders, People Business Partners, People Consultants, Legal, Ethics & Compliance, and Security, the Director drives scalable solutions that strengthen organisational effectiveness, enhance employee experience, and support a respectful, inclusive, and high-performing workplace. Prioritisation, sound judgement, and the ability to effectively balance long-term strategic initiatives with emerging business needs, executive escalations, and crisis response are critical to success in this role.
