Are you a Senior Data Engineer passionate about building scalable, high-performance data platforms and working with modern Lakehouse technologies? Join Sigma Software’s Data Engineering Center of Excellence and contribute to the modernization of an enterprise-scale analytics ecosystem for the retail domain.
We are looking for a Senior specialist with strong Databricks, PySpark, and cloud data engineering expertise to participate in the migration of a large-scale analytical platform from BigQuery to Databricks. You will collaborate with international teams, contribute to architectural decisions, and help shape reliable and scalable data solutions.
We at Sigma Software create opportunities for continuous learning, technology growth, and meaningful engineering impact while working on complex international projects.

CUSTOMER

Our Customer is a leading retail technology company specializing in AI-driven pricing optimization solutions for enterprise retailers. The company helps businesses improve profitability and competitiveness through advanced analytics, automation, and intelligent pricing strategies. Their platform combines business intelligence with sophisticated algorithms to support data-informed pricing decisions at scale for global retail organizations.

PROJECT

The project focuses on the strategic migration of a large-scale analytical platform from a legacy BigQuery ecosystem to a modern Databricks Lakehouse architecture. The platform processes high-volume retail datasets, machine learning workloads, analytics pipelines, and customer-specific business logic.
As part of the modernization initiative, the engineering team is implementing scalable Spark-based processing, Delta Lake architecture, medallion data layers, and modern governance practices. The role offers an opportunity to work with distributed data processing systems, optimize large-scale workloads, and contribute to the evolution of an enterprise-grade data platform.

Key Technologies: Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, Airflow, GCP, CI/CD, Unity Catalog

raw.excerpt: At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe.
raw.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

  • We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
  • We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
  • We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
  • We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

The Market Access Operations Manager is responsible for the operational infrastructure that enables successful Market Access execution across Veracyte’s diagnostic testing portfolio, including payer credentialing and enrollment, state Medicaid participation, contract implementation, and the system of record for all Market Access agreements and documentation.

Reporting to the Director, Market Access & Payer Relations, this individual will partner closely with Market Access, Reimbursement Operations (RCM), external consultants, Client Services, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Regulatory, and Commercial Operations teams to ensure payer contracting and coverage strategies are translated into accurate operational execution. The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of healthcare reimbursement operations with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and a passion for improving patient access to innovative diagnostic testing.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead all payer credentialing, re-credentialing, enrollment, and network participation activities across commercial payers, Medicare contractors, all state Medicaid programs and their associated managed care plans, laboratory benefit managers, and other reimbursement stakeholders. Own the end-to-end lifecycle, including initial applications, revalidation, roster and demographic updates, and ongoing maintenance requirements.
  • Manage state-specific Medicaid enrollment requirements, including out-of-state laboratory enrollment where permitted, documentation and attestations, application fees, risk-level screening obligations such as fingerprinting and site visits, and subsequent contracting with Medicaid managed care plans once state enrollment is active.
  • Manage federal government documentation, including SAM ID and associated opportunities, Federal Supply Schedule changes, FSS applications, and documents related to SBA plans, within required federal timelines.
  • Coordinate ownership, control, and managing employee disclosures required by payer and government enrollment applications, working with Legal, Human Resources, Compliance, and executive leadership to gather and safeguard sensitive information.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory, facility, and organizational records across payer systems and enrollment platforms, including NPPES and PECOS demographic data, NPI and taxonomy assignments, PTAN alignment, W-9 and remittance addresses, and payer directory listings.
  • Partner with Regulatory and Quality to ensure CLIA certification and state clinical laboratory licenses and permits remain current, and align enrollment activities with state licensure prerequisites.
  • Own the contract lifecycle after execution, including effective and termination dates, renewal and notice windows, amendments, and escalation of approaching deadlines to the contracting leads.
  • Establish and maintain the system of record for market access documentation, including executed agreements and amendments, payer medical policies and coverage determinations, payer correspondence, and supporting evidence and dossier materials. Maintain version control, access permissions, and retention standards across document management, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms.
  • Collaborate with Reimbursement Operations (RCM) teams to identify and resolve enrollment-related claim issues, reimbursement delays, and payer operational challenges, including those involving payer portals such as Availity.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process documentation, and operational controls related to enrollment, payer setup, contract administration, and reimbursement operations. Support related payer audits, credentialing reviews, and compliance requests.
  • Select, implement, and administer enrollment tracking and contract repository systems, and manage credentialing vendors, external consultants, and third-party partners.
  • Develop dashboards, reporting, and key performance indicators that measure operational performance, including enrollment cycle time by payer type, percentage of target Medicaid lives with active enrollment, on-time revalidation rate, denial dollars attributable to enrollment or configuration defects, and contract record completeness.
  • Evaluate current workflows, identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, and execute process improvements through the effective use of automation and artificial intelligence (AI) tools.
  • Manage group inboxes for payer correspondence and contracting communications.

Who You Are:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • A minimum of 6 – 7 years of experience in healthcare reimbursement operations, payer credentialing, provider enrollment, managed care operations, revenue cycle, market access operations, or a related function.
  • Demonstrated experience managing payer enrollment across both commercial and government payers, including hands-on multi-state Medicaid enrollment and revalidation.
  • Working knowledge of enrollment systems and requirements relevant to facility and laboratory entities, including NPPES, PECOS, state Medicaid provider portals, and enrollment tracking platforms.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a recurring compliance calendar such as revalidation, recredentialing, licensure renewal, or contract renewal, with a track record of preventing lapses.
  • Experience administering contracts, fee schedules, or reimbursement documentation as a system of record, including version control and access management.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives involving reimbursement, billing, legal, compliance, finance, and commercial teams while managing multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders.
  • Experience developing and maintaining operational documentation, workflows, and standard operating procedures.
  • Ability to manage sensitive personal and corporate information, including ownership and control disclosures, with a high degree of professionalism, accuracy, and confidentiality.
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting molecular diagnostics, genomic testing, laboratory developed tests (LDTs), precision medicine, oncology diagnostics, or other specialty diagnostic products.
  • Experience enrolling an out-of-state laboratory in state Medicaid programs and navigating state-specific restrictions on out-of-state laboratory participation.
  • Experience with Medicaid managed care plan contracting and roster processes as distinct from state fee-for-service enrollment.
  • Experience with credentialing and contracting in VA and DoD facilities.
  • Experience implementing or administering an enrollment tracking platform or contract lifecycle management system.
  • Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS) or similar credentialing certification.
  • Familiarity with Medicare coverage, commercial payer operations, laboratory benefit managers, and diagnostic reimbursement pathways.
  • Experience working with healthcare compliance, audit readiness, and credentialing governance processes.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Pay range
$100,000—$135,000 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.

About Veracyte

Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. For more information, please visit www.veracyte.com or follow us on LinkedIn or X (Twitter).

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Go-to-Market (GTM) Recruiter, you'll help GitLab build the go-to-market teams that drive our growth. In this individual contributor role, you'll partner with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, Field Operations, Enablement, and Ecosystems and own searches from intake through close. You'll build inclusive pipelines and use data and market insight to guide hiring decisions, while growing into a trusted talent advisor.

What you'll do

  • Manage full-cycle searches for Account Executives, Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Sales Development, and Sales Operations, typically carrying 12-15 requisitions at a time, with accurate, timely documentation in Greenhouse.
  • Lead intake and kickoff conversations to align hiring teams on role scope, territory or segment, quota and ramp expectations, interview plans, and timelines, with senior team guidance as needed.
  • Partner with hiring teams on structured, equitable interviews with clear competencies and actionable feedback; challenge assumptions and escalate risks or blockers early.
  • Use talent-market research, compensation and on-target earnings (OTE) benchmarks, funnel metrics, and candidate feedback to shape search strategy and address hiring issues.
  • Assess sales candidates on track record, quota attainment, deal complexity, and experience relevant to GitLab's sales segments and approach.
  • Build research-based, diversity-focused sourcing plans that balance applicants, passive talent, referrals, internal talent, and targeted outreach.
  • Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience through disciplined pipeline management, proactive communication, timely feedback, and offer negotiations that clearly explain compensation and OTE.
  • Improve recruiting practices by sharing learnings and reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture.

What you'll bring

  • Full-cycle recruiting experience in competitive markets, including offer and compensation conversations.
  • Sales or go-to-market recruiting experience, or a strong interest in learning sales segments, quotas, OTE, ramp time, territory design, and sales cycles.
  • Developing advisor skills: building stakeholder trust, influencing without authority, and managing hiring team expectations.
  • Experience building proactive, diversity-focused sourcing strategies and balanced pipelines.
  • A data-informed approach that turns funnel insights into practical actions.
  • Strong organization across multiple requisitions and clear written and verbal communication across time zones, with attention to detail and candidate care.
  • Experience with an applicant tracking system and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, Metaview, LinkedIn Insights, SeekOut, or comparable platforms; ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.
  • Technology or business-to-business (B2B) software recruiting experience is helpful, not required.

About the team

We work in a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. Guided by GitLab's operating principles, including Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset, and Customer Outcomes, we take ownership, move with urgency and rigor, and focus on hiring outcomes that matter to our internal customers. We share learnings and create reusable resources to continually improve the quality and consistency of hiring across GTM teams.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups

raw.description:
About IXOPAY

IXOPAY is the enterprise-grade global payment infrastructure platform built for the era of agentic commerce. We equip merchants and enterprises with AI-driven intelligence, payment orchestration, advanced tokenization, and the tools to optimize every stage of the payments journey.

From intelligent routing and compliance to customizable modules and enterprise-scale orchestration, IXOPAY helps businesses integrate faster, improve payment performance, and expand globally with confidence.

At IXOPAY, our people are our greatest strength. Our collaborative culture is built on shared values that guide how we work, innovate, and support our customers.

About the Role

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead and develop two engineering teams responsible for the tokenization, network token, and compliance services that support IXOPAY's global payment infrastructure.

In this leadership role, you'll be accountable for team performance, engineering delivery, operational reliability, and continuous improvement. You'll create an environment where engineers and technical leads can do their best work, empowering teams to make sound technical decisions while ensuring priorities, expectations, and outcomes remain aligned with business and customer needs.

Working closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Support, and Engineering leadership, you'll help translate business priorities into actionable engineering commitments, identify and address risks, and strengthen the processes that support secure, reliable software delivery.

This is an opportunity to combine strong people leadership with technical understanding and operational ownership, helping shape the teams and services that protect sensitive payment data and enable secure transactions for enterprise merchants around the world.

What You'll Do

Lead & Develop High-Performing Engineering Teams

  • Lead, coach, and develop engineers and technical leads across two teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Conduct regular one-on-ones, provide meaningful feedback, and support individual career development and professional growth.

  • Manage hiring, onboarding, performance management, and team capacity to ensure the organization has the skills and resources needed to succeed.

  • Empower technical leads and engineers to take ownership of technical decisions while providing guidance, removing obstacles, and ensuring alignment with broader engineering priorities.

  • Build an environment that encourages open communication, knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and sustainable team performance.

Drive Engineering Delivery & Execution

  • Own delivery commitments across both teams, ensuring priorities, timelines, and expectations are clearly understood and actively managed.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering stakeholders to align technical execution with customer needs, business priorities, and product roadmaps.

  • Monitor delivery progress, identify risks and dependencies early, and proactively address blockers that could impact outcomes.

  • Manage escalations effectively, resolving issues at the appropriate level and engaging senior leadership when additional support or decisions are needed.

  • Provide clear, regular updates to Engineering leadership on team performance, delivery status, risks, and key decisions.

  • Promote effective planning, prioritization, and Agile development practices that support predictable and sustainable delivery.

Strengthen Technical Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Maintain a strong working understanding of the platform's architecture, technologies, and operational requirements to evaluate tradeoffs, challenge assumptions, and identify technical risks.

  • Partner with technical leads and architects to support sound engineering decisions, maintainability, scalability, and long-term platform health.

  • Work closely with Security and Compliance teams to ensure engineering practices and delivery processes support PCI DSS and other applicable security requirements.

  • Coordinate incident response, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning to improve service reliability and prevent recurring issues.

  • Participate in shared operational support responsibilities across Development, Platform Engineering, and Support teams.

  • Champion secure development practices, operational readiness, and continuous improvements to production systems.

Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration & Innovation

  • Build strong partnerships across Product, Architecture, Support, Security, Operations, and other Engineering teams to improve communication and execution.

  • Ensure engineering teams understand the customer impact and business value of the solutions they build and maintain.

  • Identify recurring challenges, operational inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve engineering processes across teams.

  • Lead initiatives that strengthen automation, development workflows, engineering productivity, and operational effectiveness.

  • Encourage the responsible adoption of AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to improve quality and efficiency.

  • Contribute to broader engineering leadership discussions, organizational planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What You'll Bring

Required

  • Experience managing software engineering teams, including responsibility for people development, performance management, and delivery outcomes.

  • Senior level professional experience in Software Engineering or a closely related technical discipline, preferably within a SaaS or enterprise technology environment.

  • Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams through complex software development initiatives, balancing delivery priorities, technical quality, and operational reliability.

  • Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, hiring, performance management, and developing technical talent.

  • Working knowledge of .NET, SQL Server, and Microsoft Azure, with sufficient technical depth to evaluate engineering tradeoffs, identify risks, and contribute to architectural discussions.

  • Experience supporting business-critical applications or services that require high availability, security, and operational stability.

  • Understanding of modern software development practices, including Agile delivery, CI/CD, incident management, and production support.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities, resolve escalations, and drive accountability across multiple teams.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment and the ability to make decisions in complex technical environments.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, cross-functional stakeholders, and senior leadership.

  • Experience using engineering collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Slack.

  • A customer-focused mindset and a proactive approach to improving engineering effectiveness, team performance, and software quality.

Preferred

  • Experience in payments, FinTech, financial services, or another regulated technology environment.

  • Familiarity with PCI DSS requirements and secure software development practices.

  • Experience with payment tokenization, network tokens, card network or payment processor integrations, or related payment infrastructure.

  • Experience managing multiple engineering teams or leading through technical leads.

  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud-native applications, and enterprise-scale SaaS architectures.

  • Experience coordinating production incident response, root cause analysis, and reliability improvement initiatives.

  • Experience introducing automation, AI-assisted development tools, or engineering productivity improvements.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Why Join IXOPAY?

At IXOPAY, you'll help lead the teams building and supporting the technology that protects sensitive payment data and enables secure, reliable payment experiences for businesses around the world.

You'll have the opportunity to shape engineering culture, develop talented technical teams, and influence how we deliver and operate mission-critical payment services. Working closely with experienced Engineering leaders and cross-functional partners, you'll play an important role in strengthening our platform and supporting the continued growth of IXOPAY's global payment infrastructure.

We offer:

  • A collaborative, international engineering environment

  • Remote working flexibility within the United States

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership development

  • Meaningful ownership of engineering teams, delivery outcomes, and operational improvements

  • The opportunity to work with enterprise-scale payment technology and modern engineering practices

Location

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the United States.

The role involves regular collaboration with Engineering, Product, Security, Support, and other cross-functional teams. Participation in shared operational support and incident response activities is part of the position.

What Makes an IXOPAYer?

We are a global team united by one standard, where every voice matters and initiative drives real change.

We believe in progress over perfection—moving with purpose, embracing modern technologies and AI, and continuously improving through learning and iteration. We empower our people to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and collaborate across teams to solve meaningful problems.

If you're tenaciously curious, customer-focused, and passionate about shaping the future of global payments, you'll thrive at IXOPAY.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We know great candidates don't always meet every qualification. If you're excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply - we'd love to hear what you can bring to IXOPAY.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IXOPAY is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
INOCEL is a French company in the industrial energy transition, specialized in the design and commercialization of modular, free‑emission hydrogen generators. Our solutions deliver continuous and reliable power to critical industries - from data centers to construction sites and remote locations - without compromising performance.

Backed by more than 25 years of research on hydrogen fuel cells, we offer modular generators for both stationary and mobile applications: GEN‑Z 300, GEN‑Z 600, and GEN‑Z 1300. Beyond equipment, INOCEL provides turnkey solutions, including integration, maintenance, and advanced monitoring to ensure reliability, performance, and durability.

With industrial production in Belfort and R&D centers in Grenoble and Cannes, INOCEL combines innovation, technological expertise, and positive environmental impact. Our scalable and silent solutions enable partners worldwide to transition toward a zero‑carbon future, reinforcing our international vision and our role as a global leader in hydrogen energy.

We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Designer to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of next-generation clean energy systems.

This is an opportunity to design innovative mechanical equipment combining thermal systems, fluid handling, structural design, piping, and complex assemblies. You will work on products from concept through prototype and industrialization, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced engineering environment.

While our products operate at elevated temperatures, we welcome candidates from a broad range of industries. Experience with complex mechanical systems is more important than prior experience in fuel cells or high-temperature equipment.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Mechanical Designer, you will:

  • Design mechanical assemblies and components for advanced energy systems and Balance of Plant equipment.

  • Develop robust, manufacturable and cost-effective solutions from concept to production.

  • Create detailed 3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings and technical documentation.

  • Design components such as: Mechanical structures and enclosures, Manifolds and piping systems, Flanged connections, Heat exchangers, Bellows and expansion joints, Air and gas handling equipment, Thermal management assemblies.

  • Select appropriate materials based on mechanical, thermal and manufacturing requirements.

  • Perform engineering calculations related to structural integrity, thermal expansion and pressure-containing components.

  • Support design verification through analysis (FEA, CFD where applicable) and prototype testing.

  • Work closely with systems, process, manufacturing and test engineers throughout product development.

  • Collaborate with suppliers to optimize manufacturing processes and component quality.

  • Participate in prototype builds, testing and continuous product improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

  • 7+ years of experience in mechanical design of industrial products or complex mechanical systems.

  • Strong experience in 3D CAD (SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, Inventor, NX or equivalent).

  • Experience designing fabricated, machined and welded assemblies.

  • Good understanding of manufacturing processes and Design for Manufacturing (DfM).

  • Ability to produce detailed manufacturing drawings and GD&T documentation.

  • Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals including tolerancing, materials selection and structural design.

  • Hands-on mindset with interest in prototype development and product validation.

Experience That Would Be Valuable

We encourage applications from candidates with experience in industries such as:

  • Energy systems

  • Automotive

  • Aerospace

  • Industrial equipment

  • Process industries

  • Gas turbines

  • Compressors, pumps or rotating equipment

  • Heat exchangers and thermal systems

  • Hydrogen technologies

  • Fuel cells

  • Pressure equipment

  • Oil & Gas

  • Nuclear

  • Heavy machinery

  • Special-purpose machines

Experience with elevated-temperature equipment, thermal management, pressure systems, or piping design is appreciated but not required.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Design cutting-edge clean energy products with real-world impact.

  • Work on technically challenging multidisciplinary projects.

  • Take ownership of designs from concept through industrialization.

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers across mechanical, systems, process and manufacturing disciplines.

  • Contribute to the transition toward more sustainable energy solutions.

Key Competencies

  • Creative problem-solving

  • Strong mechanical design skills

  • Practical engineering mindset

  • Attention to detail

  • Excellent collaboration and communication

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies

  • Passion for building innovative products

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re seeking an experienced Staff Product Operations Manager to own how Tailscale’s Product org operates. You’ll look across how Product plans, launches, learns from customers, and measures results, identify the gaps that matter most, and design the systems to close them. You’ll partner with Product leadership as a strategic contributor and shape how Product connects to GTM, Support, Data, and company planning.

Because we’re an early-stage, fully remote company, we’re looking for someone who works with full autonomy. You’ll turn broad goals into clear strategies, decide what’s worth pursuing, and build alignment at every level. You’ll report to the Manager, Program Management.

Key Responsibilities

You will work as part of the Program Management team to:

Roadmap health

  • Own the strategy and standards for roadmap health, including how initiative and epic dates and health are defined, tracked, and reported.
  • Evolve the Product org’s continuous planning cadence as the company grows, and connect it to company planning.
  • Own the external roadmap and how it’s communicated to customers and the field.

Product launch health

  • Define the launch framework and readiness standards used across Product, PMM, Sales, and Support.
  • Partner with PMM, Sales, and Support leaders to make launch readiness consistent and measurable.

Internal documentation and onboarding

  • Set the standards for how Product org documentation is structured and maintained, so teams can keep it current themselves.
  • Design the Product team’s onboarding program as the org grows.

Feature request health

  • Design the end-to-end feature request system, from intake in Jira to its connection with roadmap decisions.
  • Give Product leadership a clear view of demand and how it’s reflected in the roadmap.

Customer insight

  • Own a single customer insight strategy that combines closed-lost data, feature requests, QBRs, and community feedback from Discord, Reddit, and GitHub into a view that informs prioritization.

Operating rhythms

  • Own the Product org’s operating model, including the customer QBR process for EPD and the internal MBR, and evolve them as needs change.

Data health

  • Define the Product org’s metrics and data strategy, partnering with Data so dashboards scale with new products and features.

Across all areas

  • Independently identify gaps in how Product operates, make the case to leadership, and drive solutions.
  • Partner with Product leadership on priorities and trade-offs, bringing recommendations rather than status.

Role Success

This role is successful when Product leadership relies on product operations as a strategic partner, customer insight visibly shapes the roadmap, and the Product org’s operating model scales as Tailscale adds products and teams.

What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in product operations, program management, or business operations, including designing an org’s operating model.
  • A track record of starting high-impact operations initiatives yourself.
  • Experience building customer insight systems that influence product prioritization.
  • Experience setting launch frameworks and readiness standards across Product and GTM.
  • Experience defining product metrics and data strategy with data teams.
  • Systems thinking: the ability to see how Product’s processes affect GTM, Support, and company planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and build alignment across orgs.
  • Experience mentoring others and raising the quality of a team’s work.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication in an asynchronous, remote-first environment.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

CAN Pay Range
$199,660—$249,240 CAD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

  • Experience working with large-scale / Big Data environments
  • Good knowledge of Linux
  • Experience working with performance-critical database environments
  • Fluent Polish and English

Nice to have:

  • Python
  • Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Apache Airflow
  • CI/CD
  • Experience in the banking, financial services or FX domain
  • Experience with real-time or near real-time data processing

Overview

Join Reynolds Consumer Products…and Drive Your Career across a world of opportunities!

We currently have a remote work opportunity for a Claims Supervisor with our team.

Responsibilities

The Claims Supervisor leads the day-to-day operations and performance of the Claims team, providing direct leadership, coaching, mentoring, and guidance to five team members. This role ensures customer deductions, open credits, unapplied cash, and other customer account discrepancies are researched and resolved accurately and timely. The Claims Supervisor partners with Customer Service, Sales, Trade Operations, Credit & Collections, Cash Application, and other cross-functional teams to drive timely resolution, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions that reduce recurring customer issues. Reporting to the Claims Manager, this position supports the execution of the overall claims and deduction management strategy while improving operational efficiency, financial accuracy, and working capital outcomes.

You Will Have the Opportunity to Make Great Things Happen!

Team Leadership & Daily Operations

  • Provide direct supervision, coaching, mentoring, and day-to-day guidance to five Claims team members.
  • Manage daily activities, priorities, workload distribution, and coverage to ensure timely and accurate completion of claims and account-resolution activities.
  • Establish clear expectations for ownership, follow-up, documentation, productivity, and timely resolution of assigned customer issues.
  • Monitor individual and team performance, including claims aging, open items, resolution cycle times, quality, and other operational metrics.
  • Conduct regular team and individual meetings to review priorities, performance, outstanding issues, and employee development opportunities.
  • Serve as a point of escalation for team members and provide guidance on complex customer issues and appropriate resolution paths.
  • Identify training needs and develop team capabilities through ongoing feedback, knowledge sharing, and practical coaching.

Claims & Deduction Management

  • Oversee the timely research and resolution of customer deductions, open credits, unapplied cash, short payments, and other customer account discrepancies.
  • Ensure valid deductions and credits are processed and applied promptly and invalid deductions are disputed and recovered when appropriate.
  • Review aged, high-value, recurring, or complex items to confirm clear ownership, documented action plans, and appropriate escalation.
  • Coordinate with Credit & Collections and Cash Application to resolve unidentified or unapplied cash and prevent unnecessary aging of customer balances.
  • Ensure customer issues are fully resolved and are not transferred between departments without defined ownership and follow-up.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end requirements related to open deductions, credits, claims, and unapplied cash.

Process Improvements

  • Analyze trends to distinguish customer-specific issues from broader systemic problems requiring cross-functional corrective action.
  • Work with the Claims Manager and business partners to develop and implement sustainable corrective actions that prevent recurrence.
  • Recommend improvements to procedures, controls, reporting, workflows, and systems that improve resolution time, accuracy, and efficiency.
  • Support automation and continuous improvement initiatives led by the Claims Manager, including testing, implementation, and adoption within the team.

Systems, Reporting & Controls

  • Monitor claims aging, deduction trends, open credits, unapplied cash, team workloads, and resolution performance.
  • Provide routine operational reporting and meaningful updates to the Claims Manager, including risks, recurring issues, and items requiring management attention.
  • Ensure Claims systems and SAP records are accurate, current, and supported by appropriate documentation.
  • Maintain compliance with established procedures, approval requirements, internal controls, and audit expectations.
  • Support system enhancements, testing, process design, and business-readiness activities related to Claims and Accounts Receivable processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve working capital through faster resolution, recovery, and application of customer account items.

You Will Love It Here If…

  • You listen, learn, and evolve
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • You put safety first, always
  • You are passionate about collaboration, teamwork, and achieving shared goals
  • You believe in treating all people with respect, operating ethically, and growing a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace
  • You are committed to improving our impact on local communities and creating positive experiences

Qualifications

Education/Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience to successfully perform the essential functions of the position.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in customer claims, deductions, Accounts Receivable, credit and collections, cash application, or a related financial function.

Preferred

  • Experience resolving complex customer deductions and account issues in a high-volume environment.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Prior supervisory, team-lead, or people-leadership experience.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and drive issues through resolution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate and influence across multiple functions and organizational levels.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, assess operational risks, and drive timely resolution of customer account discrepancies.
  • Ability to coach and develop team members while maintaining accountability for performance, quality, and service outcomes.

Competencies

  • Manages Complexity – Evaluates complex customer account issues, identifies root causes, and guides the team toward effective resolutions.
  • Plans and Aligns – Establishes priorities, allocates workloads, and coordinates resources to meet operational deadlines and performance expectations.
  • Ensures Accountability – Sets clear expectations for ownership, documentation, quality, and timely resolution of customer account issues.
  • Develops Talent – Coaches team members, provides actionable feedback, and builds capabilities that strengthen team performance.
  • Collaborates – Partners across functions to resolve customer discrepancies, address recurring issues, and improve financial processes.
  • Drives Results – Monitors operational performance and advances corrective actions that improve resolution times, financial accuracy, and working capital.

Description

﻿Who We Are

﻿

WeSki's vision is to make it easy for skiers across the globe to book and enjoy their ideal ski trip at the best possible price. As the ultimate ski trip booking platform, WeSki enables everyone to design and book their ideal adventure in just a few clicks, quickly, seamlessly, and affordably. In an $100 billion industry that has remained largely traditional, this opens up a massive opportunity to redefine ski trips for modern consumers.

WeSki's technology compares millions of combinations of flights, accommodation, transfers, passes, gear, and lessons instantly, saving hours of planning. Each trip is fully customisable, giving customers the flexibility of building it themselves, but with the expert protection and support of a holiday provider.

With all trip components automatically linked, customers can relax and enjoy their holiday knowing that all the logistics are taken care of, alongside 24/7 customer service whilst they're away.

WeSki is an innovative, passionate, and fast-moving company. We partner with over 300 ski resorts (and counting) across 20 countries and have already sold over 180,000 ski holiday packages to skiers worldwide. We are in a rapid growth mode whilst maintaining profitability, making our business and product opportunities (and challenges) all the more exciting.

Role Overview

﻿

We are building a dedicated sales function at WeSki, and we are looking for the person to lead it. Many of our customers are happy to plan and book independently through our platform. Others want to talk to someone who genuinely knows the resorts, understands what makes a family ski holiday work, and can help them make confident decisions. This role exists to serve that second group properly.

The profile we are looking for is specific: an excellent travel professional who is also a genuine skiing expert. You need to bring both to the table, because our customers are trusting us with the trip they save up for all year, and that trust is built in the first few minutes of a conversation.

This is a founding leadership position. You will design the sales process end to end, define how success is measured, build and coach the team, and own the results. In the first season you will also sell personally: this is a hands-on role, not a purely managerial one. As the function proves itself, you will grow the team and hire into it.

The role reports into Customer Experience and works closely with Growth, Operations and Product. It is fully remote, with a strong focus on the UK and European markets. A deep understanding of the UK consumer travel market is essential.

Key Responsibilities:

﻿

  • Build the function. Design the sales process from first contact through to a booked holiday, including how enquiries are prioritised, how conversations are managed, and how a booking is handed over to our operations team.
  • Set the strategy. Define how we sell, to whom, and through which channels, and adapt it as the market and our product evolve.
  • Own the numbers. Define the KPIs for the team, monitor performance against them, and report on results to senior leadership.
  • Sell. Handle customer conversations directly, particularly in the early months. You will set the standard by demonstrating it.
  • Lead and develop the team. Coach the current team, raise the level of consultative selling across it, and create the structure a growing team needs.
  • Validate and improve. Test approaches, measure what works, and iterate. We would rather learn quickly than commit to assumptions.
  • Shape the tooling. Work with Product and Technology to build the systems and automation the team needs, so that time is spent with customers rather than on admin.
  • Lead AI adoption. Identify where AI can improve the sales process and implement AI-powered tools and workflows across the function. Experiment with new capabilities, measure their impact, and continuously improve how the team uses AI to sell more effectively and operate more efficiently.
  • Work across the business. Partner with Growth on the flow and quality of enquiries, and with Operations to ensure what we promise during a sale is delivered on the ground.
  • Recruit and onboard. As the function scales, identify, hire and develop the people who will join it.
  • Represent the customer. You will hear what customers want before anyone else. Bring that back and help shape the product.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in sales leadership, including managing, coaching, and developing sales teams.
  • Genuine skiing expertise. You ski, you know European resorts first hand, and you can tell a customer which mountain suits their family and which does not. This is not a preference. A customer planning their one big trip of the year can tell within a sentence whether they are talking to someone who has actually been there.
  • A background in travel, as a travel agent, tour operator or equivalent. You have planned and sold real trips for real people, and you understand what goes into a holiday beyond the price: the connections, the transfers, the things that go wrong and how to prevent them.
  • Proven experience selling high-value, considered purchases to UK consumers in a consultative, advice-led way mixed with strong business acumen.
  • Deep understanding of the UK consumer travel or leisure market, including how UK customers research and buy.
  • Experience building a sales process or function from scratch, or substantially rebuilding an existing one. This role has no existing playbook to inherit.
  • Comfort owning a target and being measured against it, and the data literacy to define sensible metrics and interpret them honestly.
  • Excellent written & verbal communication skills in English. A large share of customer conversations happen in writing, and clarity and warmth on the page matter as much as they do on the phone.
  • Self-direction and strong organization. This is a remote role with significant autonomy and broad ownership.
  • Comfort using AI and automation tools as part of everyday work.
  • Flexibility during our peak booking period, including weekend availability as needed. Ski travel is a highly seasonal business and the busiest months are demanding.

Advantages (Not Mandatory):

  • Ski instructor, ski guide, seasonaire or resort-side experience.
  • Background in travel technology as well as traditional travel.
  • Experience working in a seasonal business.
  • Experience hiring and onboarding into a growing team.
  • Proficiency in French or other European languages.

Location: UK - Remote

Salary: £30K-35K – Dependant on experience

Hours: Full Time

Contract Type: FTC – 12 months

Reports To: Head of Enterprise Systems

Key Internal Contacts/Relationships: End users of the Enterprise solutions/IS department/ICT Helpdesk

Key External Contacts/Relationships: Solution Providers

Job Purpose: To provide operational support for core enterprise systems as part of the Systems Support team, ensuring incidents and service requests are effectively managed.

About HALO:

HALO is the leading global NGO addressing the impact and drivers of conflict in 30 countries and territories, with over 8,000 staff. Most of our staff are local employees and include a growing number of women.

Our primary duty is to serve people affected by conflict, clearing landmines and the explosive remnants of war that threaten lives and livelihoods long after fighting has finished. We make land safe where war has ended, while also assisting those affected by active conflict and endemic violence.

HALO addresses human suffering caused by armed violence in some of the world’s most fragile places, securing weapons and ammunition and working with both state and community actors to reduce the prevalence of armed violence.

About the role:

This role sits within the Enterprise Systems Support team and provides day‑to‑day operational support for NetSuite and other Enterprise systems (Fleet, HR etc). The post‑holder will manage and resolve support requests through Jira Service Management, supporting users across finance, and other business processes. The role focuses on incident resolution, access management, system administration, and continuous improvement, working closely with business users, IT colleagues, and third‑party vendors to ensure stable, secure, and well‑governed systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage all support related issues across all Enterprise Systems resolving support requests through Jira Service Management, including system performance monitoring, issue triage, and ongoing platform optimisation across all programmes.
  • Manage the day-to-day NetSuite administration as part of the support team including user setup, roles, permissions, and security access, ensuring consistent application of role-based access controls and best practice governance standards across all platforms.
  • Configure and customise NetSuite (including fields, forms, records, workflows, dashboards, KPI’s, reminders and reports) to meet business needs and deliver real-time visibility across Finance, Procurement, Inventory, and Fixed Assets.
  • Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate with third party partners and support where required
  • Carry out testing for system upgrades and rollouts

General:

  • Uphold HALO’s core values and standards, promoting its ethos and mission statement.
  • Ensure familiarity with and adherence to all HALO policies and procedures, especially the code of conduct and safeguarding

Requirements

Essential Requirements:

  • Proven experience supporting NetSuite in a production environment, including system administration, configuration and end user support.
  • Experience managing NetSuite user accounts, roles, permissions, and access controls in line with security, compliance and governance best practice.
  • Experience supporting business users with system queries, incidents, and service requests, including troubleshooting and root‑cause analysis and resolution management.
  • Hands on experience configuring and maintaining NetSuite to meet business requirements including custom fields, forms, records, workflows, dashboards and reports
  • Experience supporting additional enterprise applications such as Fleetwave, HRIS platforms, JIRA/JIRA service Management or other business critical systems with the ability to develop expertise across a wider enterprise systems portfolio

Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience supporting multiple programmes, subsidiaries, within a shared ERP environment.
  • Familiarity with documenting support procedures, knowledge articles, or configuration decisions.
  • Experience supporting or administering finance systems including Payhawk (expense management and corporate cards), Adaptive Planning (FP&A, budgeting and forecasting), and Solution7 or similar financial reporting and consolidation tools.
  • Experience of using JIRA as a user or administrator.
  • Experience of system testing, change control and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Experience in a not‑for‑profit or complex, multi‑country operating environment.

Physical Requirements for the role:

  • Ability to work extended periods at a desk using IT equipment.
  • Capacity to work flexibly to support international stakeholders across time zones.

Travel Requirements

  • Occasional travel to the London/Dumfries office maybe required
  • Limited overseas travel maybe required to support system implementations, programme governance, and stakeholder engagement.

Benefits

  • 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 statutory holidays
  • Non-contributory life assurance
  • Private medical health cover
  • Pension contributions matched by HALO up to 5%
  • Emergency medical insurance while travelling overseas (including on leave)
  • Flexible working policy

To Apply:

Please submit a CV (no more than 2 pages) and a cover letter (no more than 1 page) outlining how your experience matches the key skills and competencies required by Monday 23rd November 2026.

Applications without a cover letter tailored to this position will not be considered.

We reserve the right to amend the closing date depending on the number of applications received.

The HALO Trust is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment because of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

The HALO Trust is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented individuals from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

The HALO Trust is committed to ensuring that it provides a safe and trusted environment which safeguards and promotes the welfare and wellbeing of anyone who comes into contact with, or is part of, the Charity, with a zero-tolerance approach to behaviours which challenge this.

The HALO trust participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and we will request information from job applicants’ previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment.

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is a leader in a dynamic market. As a public company listed on the NYSE with $2.1B in ARR, we deliver mission-critical solutions to physical operations globally. This position is tailored for high-performing professionals seeking to accelerate their professional growth. We are seeking account managers to oversee deal sizes ranging from €10k to €300k across a comprehensive suite of 15+ product solutions, engaging key decision-makers including Finance Directors and Managing Directors. Joining our team offers the autonomy and support to tackle challenging objectives and drive impactful results.

While this position offers remote flexibility across the Netherlands, periodic travel to meet clients on-site is expected (typically bi-weekly).

You should apply if:

  • You want to help define the future of physical operations: Your contributions will directly enable real-world impact—supporting critical infrastructure, streamlining supply chains, and advancing workforce safety.
  • You prioritize continuous prospecting: Physical operations encompass wide-ranging sectors where contacts are often mobile. Top sales reps actively identify prospective organizations and build meaningful pipeline connection points.
  • You possess deep curiosity about diverse business models: You will explore various physical sectors, from field services to manufacturing and food distribution, striving to understand operational details at scale.
  • You are committed to continuous learning: Navigating our cloud platform involves mastering new operational domains and solutions, requiring dedicated focus to achieve long-term growth.
  • You foster authentic long-term partnerships: Many target organizations are transitioning from legacy methods to modern cloud technology. Earning long-term trust is core to helping them digitally transform.
  • You thrive on high-performing teams: Working at Samsara means being part of a team dedicated to excellence and pushing boundaries as we build for the future.

In this role you will:

  • Drive revenue acquisition: Take ownership of net-new customer growth by generating 80-90% of your opportunity pipeline through outbound efforts.
  • Expand key regional markets: Contribute to the growth of our mid-market segment across the Benelux region, leveraging expanding regional momentum.
  • Leverage structured methodologies: Utilize professional sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Command the Message to effectively guide customer engagements.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Sales background: Minimum. 18 months closing experience within a proactive SaaS outreach model, demonstrating independent PG/pipeline generation.
  • Consistent quota achievement: Demonstrated performance exceeding targets within complex technology environments.
  • Complex deal navigation: Ability to manage multi-stakeholder evaluations and technical proofs-of-concept effectively.
  • Language proficiency: Native-level fluency in Dutch.

Advantageous:

  • Operational interest: Eagerness to discover how physical operations function across sectors to better address customer needs.
  • Structured methodology: A disciplined sales practice focused on consistent activity execution to produce predictable results.
  • Analytical focus: A data-informed mindset toward managing pipeline volume, discovery quality, and multi-threading for accurate forecasting.
  • Adaptability and growth: A proactive focus on continuous learning, incorporating feedback, and refining tactics over time.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
€132.000—€132.000 EUR

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

• Establish and maintain the production and software pipeline and meet deadlines in collaboration with the Lead.
  • Creating high quality characters, creatures and props rigging and skinning suitable technically to project the desired universe.
  • Autonomously Implementing rigging for characters in Maya including cloth, physics and hair setups.
  • Work closely with modelers and animators to ensure a smooth development pipeline that delivers high quality assets.
  • Create new riggings
  • Create retargeting systems/tools for old rigging to new rigging.
  • Share ownership of pipeline tools and working with engine and project leads on continuous improvement of those engine tools.
  • Support the team regarding the technical ownership of the team’s output in providing clean assets or code within established systems and requirements.
  • Providing R&D projects, pipeline and workflow improvements and proceeding with post-mortems and its implementation.
  • Tackle the most technically difficult bugfixing efforts.
  • Sharing knowledge with less experienced peers.
  • Occasionally support the team in recruitment projects with HR collaboration.
  • Occasionally support new hires onboarding process.

Description de poste

  • Mettre en place et assurer le bon fonctionnement du processus de production et de développement logiciel, et respecter les délais en collaboration avec le responsable.
  • Création de gréements et d'habillages de haute qualité pour les personnages, les créatures et les accessoires, adaptés techniquement au projet afin de restituer l'univers souhaité.
  • Mise en place autonome du montage des personnages dans Maya, y compris les configurations relatives aux textiles, à la physique et aux cheveux.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les modeleurs 3D et les animateurs afin d'assurer un pipeline de développement harmonieux et de fournir des actifs de haute qualité.
  • Créer de nouveaux gréements.
  • Créer des systèmes/outils de réorientation permettant de passer d'un ancien système de gréement à un nouveau.
  • Partager la responsabilité des outils du processus et collaborer avec les responsables des moteurs et des projets afin d'améliorer en permanence ces outils.
  • Assister l'équipe en matière de responsabilité technique sur les livrables de l'équipe, en fournissant des ressources ou du code de qualité dans le respect des systèmes et des exigences définis.
  • Mener à bien des projets de recherche et développement, apporter des améliorations au processus et au flux de travail, et procéder à des analyses rétrospectives ainsi qu'à leur mise en pratique.
  • Adoptez les tâches de correction de bogues les plus complexes sur le plan technique.
  • Partager ses connaissances avec des collègues moins chevronnés.
  • Apporter occasionnellement son aide à l'équipe dans le cadre de projets de recrutement, en collaboration avec les RH.
  • Soutenir occasionnellement le processus d'intégration des nouveaux employés
  • 5+ years of experience in Technical Animation or similar
  • Involved in the production cycle of at least 2 titles
  • Strong experience with Python code.
  • Knowledge of Houdini
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly provide technical feedback into the tasks, rigs, toolsets and documentation.
  • Expert knowledge of Maya, specializing in rigging/skinning.
  • Expert understanding of anatomy and character movement.
  • Knowledge of facial rigs for games, television or film.
  • Strong knowledge of topology requirements for old and new 3D models.
  • Experience in physics simulation on cloth, hair and other physics items.
  • Knowledge of current and future technology and trends in video games.
  • Familiarity with Maya art export/production pipelines including notably character/animation related features.
  • Self-motivation.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

Qualifications

  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de l'animation technique ou dans un domaine similaire
  • A participé au cycle de production d'au moins deux titres
  • Expérience approfondie du langage Python.
  • Connaissance de Houdini
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, avec la capacité de formuler clairement des observations techniques concernant les tâches, les installations, les outils et la documentation.
  • Connaissance approfondie de Maya, avec une spécialisation dans le gréement et l'habillage.
  • Une maîtrise approfondie de l'anatomie et des mouvements des personnages.
  • Connaissance des montages de visage pour les jeux, la télévision ou le cinéma
  • Maîtrise approfondie des exigences topologiques applicables aux modèles 3D anciens et nouveaux.
  • Expérience dans la simulation physique des textiles, des cheveux et d'autres éléments physiques.
  • Connaissance des technologies et des tendances actuelles et à venir dans le domaine des jeux vidéo.
  • Maîtrise des processus d'exportation et de production artistiques sous Maya, notamment des fonctionnalités liées aux personnages et à l'animation.
  • Motivation personnelle
  • Excellente aptitudes à la communication orale et écrite en anglais

Ce que nous offrons:

  • Un ensemble d’avantages sociaux payés à 100 % par PCF. La compagnie d’assurance rembourse les réclamations à 100 % (jusqu’à 1000 $ de services par année, en plus d’une couverture familiale ou individuelle).
  • Une couverture dentaire complète, y compris les soins dentaires.
  • La cotisation égale au REER à hauteur de 4 % avant déductions fiscales, 100 % acquis dès le premier jour.
  • Une semaine de congé payé pendant les vacances d’hiver.
  • 20 jours de congé payé et 5 jours de congé de maladie payé.
  • Des séances gratuites de soins virtuels de santé et de bien-être mental, incluses dans le régime pour les membres et leurs personnes à charge.
  • Des occasions de développement personnel et la possibilité d’œuvrer dans un environnement mondial.
  • L’occasion de travailler au sein d’une équipe créative avec des personnes passionnées par ce qu’elles font.

What we offer:

  • Benefit package 100% paid by PCF. The insurance company reimburses 100% of claims (Up to $1000 per service a year, as well as individual family coverage).
  • Full Dental coverage, including major dental.
  • 4% RRSP matching before tax deductions, 100% vested on day 1.
  • Paid week off during Winter Holidays.
  • 20 paid vacation days and 5 paid sick days.
  • Free virtual health and mental well-being sessions are included in the plan for members and their dependents.
  • Personal development opportunities and ability to work in a global environment.
  • Work in a creative team with people full of passion for what they do.

*We are looking for a Senior Technical Animator for a fully remote role in Canada.

People Can Fly est l'un des principaux studios indépendants de développement de jeux AAA. Notre équipe internationale est composée de centaines de personnes talentueuses qui travaillent dans nos bureaux en Pologne, au Royaume-Uni, en Irlande, aux États-Unis et au Canada, ainsi qu'à distance dans le monde entier.

Fondée en 2002, notre société s'est imposée dans le genre des jeux de tir avec des titres tels que Painkiller, Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgement and Outriders. En tant que l'un des studios les plus chevronnés dans l'utilisation du moteur Unreal Engine, nous continuons à développer notre expertise et à dépasser les limites du possible dans le domaine du développement de jeux vidéo.

Nos équipes créatives travaillent actuellement sur plusieurs titres captivants : Gears of War: E-Day développé en collaboration avec Microsoft: projet Echo pour KRAFTON; et Lost Rift, une propriété intellectuelle originale que nous développons en interne selon notre modèle d'auto-édition. Nous explorons également de nouvelles plateformes et expériences avec la réalité virtuelle et d'autres projets non annoncés.

Fort de plus de 20 ans d'expérience, PCF continue d'explorer de nouveaux horizons. Notre objectif est de combiner notre expertise avec la créativité des talents les plus brillants et les plus avant-gardistes du secteur, afin de créer la prochaine génération de jeux d'action pour les joueurs du monde entier.

Si vous nous rejoignez dans cette aventure, vous aurez la chance de perfectionner votre art, d'élargir vos connaissances et de travailler aux côtés des meilleurs du marché afin de créer des expériences uniques et inoubliables pour les joueurs du monde entier.

People Can Fly is one of the leading independent AAA game development studios. Our international team consists of hundreds of talented individuals working from offices in Poland, the UK, Ireland, the US, and Canada, as well as remotely across the globe.

Founded in 2002, we made our mark on the shooter genre with titles such as Painkiller, Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgment, and Outriders. As one of the most experienced Unreal Engine studios in the industry, we continue to expand on our expertise and push the boundaries of what’s possible in game development.

Our creative teams are currently working on several exciting titles: Gears of War: E-Day developed in collaboration with Microsoft; Project Echo for KRAFTON; and Lost Rift, an original IP we are developing in-house under our self-publishing model. We are also exploring new platforms and experiences with VR and other unannounced projects.

With over 20 years of experience, PCF continues to explore new horizons. We aim to combine our expertise with the creativity of the best and most forward-thinking talent in the industry, building the next generation of action games for players worldwide.

If you join us on this journey, you’ll have the chance to perfect your craft, expand your knowledge, and work alongside industry leaders to create unique, unforgettable experiences for gamers everywhere.
