raw.description:
About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

About the Role

As a DevOps / Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting and scaling the cloud infrastructure behind an AI-native cybersecurity platform that processes terabytes of data daily. You will take end-to-end ownership of critical infrastructure and contribute to the reliability, scalability and operational efficiency of the platform.

You will join an engineering team of 14+ professionals across Backend, DevOps, Endpoint, Frontend and Design, reporting to the VP of Engineering and AI. The team operates with a flat structure and a single-owner model, where engineers independently own their discipline within each project while collaborating closely with others.

This role suits a mid-to-senior engineer who thrives on autonomy, embraces AI-assisted engineering and wants to deliver high-impact solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Run, maintain and scale production cloud infrastructure supporting a platform that processes terabytes of data daily.

Hours: 30-35 hours per week initially, with possible schedule variation based on clinic coverage needs

Rate: $5-$6.50/hourwith performance-based increase after 6 months

Schedule Requirement: Must be flexible with assigned shift and willing to work Saturdays Position Overview

We are looking for a polished, reliable, and patient-focused Patient Care Communications Specialist to support a growing chiropractic clinic.

This role serves as the voice of the practice and will be the first point of contact for current and prospective patients. The ideal candidate must create a warm, calm, professional, and trustworthy experience across phone, text, voicemail, email, and scheduling workflows.

This is a high-volume communication role focused on patient calls, scheduling, follow-up, and retention. The candidate must be organized, emotionally aware, detail-oriented, and able to handle patient concerns with empathy and sound judgment.

Key Responsibilities

Answer high-volume inbound patient calls professionally and promptly.
Respond to patient texts, voicemails, emails, and fax-related messages in a timely and accurate manner.

Schedule new patient appointments and collect complete intake information. Schedule, confirm, cancel, and reschedule existing patient appointments in MacPractice.

Prioritize new patient inquiries and referral opportunities before routine rescheduling requests.

Conduct follow-up and reactivation outreach for inactive or lapsed patients. Help convert patient inquiries into booked appointments.

Maintain accurate patient records, scheduling notes, and communication documentation.

Coordinate with in-office staff to keep the provider schedule full and organized.
De-escalate patient concerns related to scheduling, billing confusion, insurance questions, or unexpected frustrations.

Know when to listen, gather details, offer a callback, and avoid overwhelming the patient with unnecessary information.

Support missed-call follow-up workflows and communication improvements inside Weave.

Protect patient privacy and follow HIPAA standards at all times.

Excellent spoken English with a clear, easy-to-understand, neutral accent. Strong written communication skills for SMS, email, and patient-facing messages.

Prior experience as a Virtual Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Patient Communication Specialist, Front Desk Coordinator, or similar healthcare support role.

Comfortable handling high call volume in a fast-paced clinic environment.
Strong patient service mindset, emotional intelligence, and common sense.
Able to multitask across calls, texts, emails, voicemails, faxes, and scheduling tasks.

Reliable, punctual, and proactive with attendance communication.
Must own and work from a Mac OS device such as a MacBook, iMac, or Mac mini. This is a client-specific requirement.

Must have reliable high-speed wired internet (LAN).

Must be flexible with schedule assignment and willing to work on Saturdays if needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with MacPractice, Weave, Solutionreach, Podium, or similar healthcare communication platforms.

Familiarity with chiropractic terminology, treatment plans, and recurring visit schedules.

Experience with patient reactivation, new patient conversion, and provider schedule optimization.

Prior experience supporting U.S. healthcare clinics.

raw.excerpt: Company OverviewLevelUp is a specialized BPO company that partners with technology companies across the US, UK, Europe, and Canada to provide tailored outsourcing solutions.
raw.description:
Company Overview

LevelUp is a specialized BPO company that partners with technology companies across the US, UK, Europe, and Canada to provide tailored outsourcing solutions. For over seven years, we have built a reputation for delivering high-quality operational and back-office support, helping our clients scale efficiently. Our team consists of highly skilled and passionate professionals who are dedicated to providing exceptional service, technical expertise, and seamless support to our clients.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented L1 Hosting Tech Support Agent to join our team. In this critical, frontline, customer-facing role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for clients seeking technical assistance with their hosting environments and WordPress websites.
Leveraging your passion for customer service and solid foundational knowledge of web hosting, you will troubleshoot and resolve a broad spectrum of technical issues via live chat and ticket-based support. Since stellar client experiences are highly valued, you will be expected to multitask efficiently by managing two to three concurrent live chat channels during busy periods while maintaining excellent response times, a high-quality assurance (QA) score, and top-tier Customer Satisfaction (CSAT).
This is a full-time, long-term opportunity embedded in an active, supportive team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love solving technical puzzles, and enjoy delivering empathetic, world-class customer service, we would love to have you on board!

More Information

• Fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week.
• The exact work schedule depends on the assigned client, often involving an afternoon or night schedule; flexibility is important.
• Company culture focuses on the well-being of team members, offering a good work-life balance and a respectful work environment.
• Equipment provided.
• HMO, 13th-month pay, and other government-mandated benefits.
Reference: 2644-464041

Responsibilities

  • Provide world-class technical support to hosting customers via live chat (managing 2 concurrent chats, scaling up to 3 during high-volume periods) and ticket-based support via Zendesk.
  • Diagnose and resolve common web hosting and WordPress issues, identifying root causes to solve customer inquiries on the first contact whenever possible.
  • Assist customers with general WordPress tasks, including troubleshooting issues related to core files, plugins, themes, and configuration errors.
  • Answer server-side queries, inspect DNS records, check and update SSL certificates, and troubleshoot website accessibility issues.
  • Handle basic database queries and migrations (MySQL) to resolve backend errors and facilitate site movement.
  • Utilize basic Linux command-line tools to diagnose, navigate, and troubleshoot server-side issues.
  • Meticulously document issues and escalate complex, tier-2 technical problems to senior teams to ensure service continuity.
  • Actively meet and exceed key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Average Handling Time (AHT), QA scores, Acceptance Rate, and Average Customer Wait Time.
  • Maintain an active, highly responsive online presence via Slack and Zendesk during your entire shift.

Requirements

  • 1 to 2 years of solid technical support experience specifically working in a web hosting environment.
  • Strong familiarity with core WordPress mechanics: how themes, plugins, caching layers, and databases interact, and the common causes of performance drops and database connection errors (e.g., "Error Establishing a Database Connection").
  • Ability to systematically isolate variables (deactivating plugins, switching to a default theme, clearing server and CDN cache) before escalating an issue.
  • First-hand, hands-on experience using SFTP.
  • Deep, practical understanding of DNS inside and out (zone files, propagation, and troubleshooting) and SSL setup.
  • Ability to actively diagnose HTTP response status codes and distinguish server-side (50x) errors from client-side (40x) errors.
  • Experience with MySQL databases, including running simple queries or basic site migrations.
  • Familiarity with WP-CLI and working from the command line.
  • Practical experience navigating files and running basic diagnostic commands via Linux CLI.
  • Excellent multitasking capabilities, specifically the capacity to handle 3 concurrent live chat windows smoothly and accurately.
  • Outstanding written English for both live chat and email, plus clear spoken English, with a conversational, natural flow and minimal grammatical errors.
  • A warm, empathetic customer support style that prioritizes active listening, rapport-building, and customer advocacy.
  • A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent hands-on experience will be highly considered.

More Information:

  • This is a fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week.
  • We have a company culture that focuses on the well-being of its team members, with a good work life balance and respectful work environment.
  • Benefits: Basic Philippines government-mandated benefits (13th-month pay, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), remote setup support, and holiday observance of Philippine holidays.
  • Equipment provided

Company Description

DataBP is a fast-growing SaaS company that simplifies how financial market data businesses run. Exchanges, index providers, trading platforms and data vendors use our platform to manage data licensing, usage reporting, pricing, billing and customer management in one place, so they can operate more efficiently, stay compliant and grow revenue.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Client Delivery Manager (EMEA), based in the United Kingdom. You’ll own delivery for a portfolio of EMEA market data clients throughout the client lifecycle, from initial implementation to ongoing reports, enhancements and change requests. You’ll work closely with our Account Management, Implementation, Solution Architecture and engineering teams.

This is a client-facing delivery role, not an engineering role. You’ll translate our clients’ commercial and operational goals into what our teams build and configure, and make sure it lands on time and to scope.

  • Own delivery for assigned EMEA clients, including major exchanges and data vendors
  • Run discovery sessions to understand clients’ market data policies, licensing models and business objectives
  • Advise clients on best practice for data licensing, entitlements, usage reporting, audits and billing
  • Translate requirements into delivery plans and prioritised workstreams
  • Plan, prioritise and track configuration and development work in Jira
  • Manage scope, timelines and budget on time-and-materials engagements
  • Identify risks, remove blockers and escalate where needed
  • Lead status meetings and senior stakeholder communications
  • Coordinate UAT and go-live for new implementations and ongoing change

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in client delivery, client success, professional services, implementation consulting or technical account management, ideally in financial markets
  • Proven experience leading enterprise client engagements from discovery through delivery
  • Strong requirements-gathering and planning skills
  • Experience coordinating technical teams without direct line management
  • Ability to manage several enterprise clients and competing priorities at once
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence
  • Assertive, organised, and comfortable leading client-facing meetings
  • Right to work in the United Kingdom

Preferred Qualifications

  • Market data administration experience, on either the consumer or the provider side
  • Experience working with major vendors and exchanges such as LSEG Data & Analytics, Bloomberg, FactSet, ICE, S&P Global, Euronext, Deutsche Börse or SIX
  • Knowledge of market data licensing, exchange agreements, redistribution rights, entitlements (e.g. DACS, EMRS) and usage or audit reporting
  • Experience supporting exchanges, index providers, banks, asset managers or other capital markets organisations

We’re looking for someone self-motivated who is comfortable working independently and taking ownership of their deliveries.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to design, build, and evolve highly scalable and resilient data platform solutions that power Experian Marketing Services’ core products. In this role, you will work on large-scale, cloud-native data pipelines, optimize distributed processing systems, and ensure the reliability and performance of petabyte-scale workloads. You will operate within agile value stream teams, applying strong engineering practices and collaborating with global stakeholders to deliver high-quality, business-critical data solutions.

Your key responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain large-scale data pipelines using Scala, Spark, and cloud-native technologies, ensuring high performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Solve complex data engineering challenges by designing efficient, resilient distributed systems and optimizing data processing workflows.
  • Contribute to production-grade data platforms, delivering high-quality, tested code and supporting end-to-end feature development.
  • Ensure software quality through clean, testable, and well-documented code, code reviews, and adherence to engineering standards.
  • Collaborate within agile value stream teams, working closely with engineers, product owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver aligned technical solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance to peers, contributing to architecture discussions, code reviews, and promoting best engineering practices.
  • Support release and operational processes, including deployments, monitoring, alerting, and continuous improvement of system reliability.
  • Drive improvements in performance, cost efficiency, and scalability of data processing workloads.

What we expect from you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Solid experience in software or data engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native data platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including services such as S3, Glue, Athena, or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, resiliency patterns, data partitioning, and efficient data access strategies.
  • Experience designing and operating highly parallelized data workloads.
  • Proficiency with Git-based version control systems (GitHub, Bitbucket, etc.).
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies and collaborative development in multi-team environments.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to contribute in technical discussions and support peer development.
  • Advanced English proficiency and availability to travel to São Carlos/SP when needed.

Nice to have

  • Experience with DBT or other data transformation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of concurrent and parallel programming patterns.
  • Expertise in building and optimizing large-scale data pipelines using Scala and Apache Spark.
  • Experience with functional programming (Scala) or languages such as Java, Python, or Rust.
  • Familiarity with modern data platform architectures and large-scale data ecosystems.
